2.1.s: pātālavarṇanam
2.1.d: पातालवर्णनम्
2.1.m: Description of the Underworld.

2.1.s:
.. śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ..
oṃ namaḥ kamaladalanayanābhirāmāya ..
śrīrāmacaṃdrāya ..
svacchaṃ caṃdrāvadātaṃ kavikaramakarakṣobhasaṃjātaphenaṃ bakṣodbhūtiprasūktairvrataniyamaparaiḥ sevitaṃ vipramukhyaiḥ ..
oṃkārālaṃkṛtena tribhuvanaguruṇā brahmaṇā dṛṣṭapūtaṃ saṃbhogābhogagamyaṃ janakaluṣaharaṃ pauṣkaraṃ vaḥ punātu .. 1 .1
2.1.d:
॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
ओं नमः कमलदलनयनाभिरामाय ॥
श्रीरामचंद्राय ॥
स्वच्छं चंद्रावदातं कविकरमकरक्षोभसंजातफेनं बक्षोद्भूतिप्रसूक्तैर्व्रतनियमपरैः सेवितं विप्रमुख्यैः ॥
ओंकारालंकृतेन त्रिभुवनगुरुणा ब्रह्मणा दृष्टपूतं संभोगाभोगगम्यं जनकलुषहरं पौष्करं वः पुनातु ॥ 1 .1
2.1.m: Oṃ, homage to Śrī Gaṇeśa. / Oṃ, homage to Śrī Rāmacandra, who delights with eyes like lotus petals. / May Pauṣkara purify you—clear, pure as the moon, its foam stirred up by the alligators that are the hands of poets, served by foremost Brahmins intent on vows and restraints with hymns produced from the breast, purified by the sight of Brahmā, the guru of the three worlds, adorned with the syllable Oṃ, accessible through the expanse of enjoyment, removing the impurities of men. 1.

2.1.s:
jayati bhuvanadīpo bhāskaro lokakartā jayati ca śitidehaḥ śārṅgadhanvā murāriḥ ..
jayati ca śaśimaulī rudranāmābhidheyo jayati sakalamaulirbhānu māṃścitrabhānuḥ .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
जयति भुवनदीपो भास्करो लोककर्ता जयति च शितिदेहः शार्ङ्गधन्वा मुरारिः ॥
जयति च शशिमौली रुद्रनामाभिधेयो जयति सकलमौलिर्भानु मांश्चित्रभानुः ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: Victorious is the lamp of the world, the Maker of Light, the Creator of the universe; victorious is Murāri, possessing a dark body and bearing the Śārṅga bow; / victorious is the moon-crested god called by the name of Rudra; victorious is the ray-bearing, brightly shining Sun, whose crest is all. 2.

2.1.s:
namaskṛtyāprameyāya devāya brahmarūpiṇe ..
purāṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaduktaṃ brahmayoginā .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
नमस्कृत्याप्रमेयाय देवाय ब्रह्मरूपिणे ॥
पुराणं संप्रवक्ष्यामि यदुक्तं ब्रह्मयोगिना ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: Having bowed to the immeasurable deity who has the form of Brahman, / I shall proclaim the Purāṇa that was spoken by the sage Brahmā. 3.

2.1.s:
purāṇasaṃhitāṃ puṇyāṃ papracchū raumaharṣaṇim ..
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ purāṇārthaviśārada ..4..
2.1.d:
पुराणसंहितां पुण्यां पप्रच्छू रौमहर्षणिम् ॥
वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं पुराणार्थविशारद ॥4॥
2.1.m: They questioned the son of Romaharṣaṇa regarding the holy collection of the Purāṇa: / “You ought to speak to us, O scholar in the meanings of the Purāṇas!” 4.

2.1.s:
munīnāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ ..
praṇamya manasā prāha guruṃ satyavatīsutam.....
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
namaskṛtya jagadyoniṃ brahmarūpadharaṃ harim ..
vakṣye paurāṇikīṃ divyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm .. 6 ..
2.1.d:
मुनीनां वचनं श्रुत्वा सूतः पौराणिकोत्तमः ॥
प्रणम्य मनसा प्राह गुरुं सत्यवतीसुतम्॥॥॥। सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
नमस्कृत्य जगद्योनिं ब्रह्मरूपधरं हरिम् ॥
वक्ष्ये पौराणिकीं दिव्यां कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् ॥ 6 ॥
2.1.m: Hearing the speech of the sages, the Sūta, the foremost of reciters of the Purāṇas, / bowed mentally to his guru, the son of Satyavatī, and spoke: / The Sūta said: / “Having bowed to Hari, the womb of the universe, who bears the form of Brahman, / I shall tell the divine Purāṇic tale that destroys sins. 6.

2.1.s:
yacchrutvā pāpakarmāṇi sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim ..
puṇyaṃ pavitramāyuṣyamidānīṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ .. 7 ..
2.1.d:
यच्छ्रुत्वा पापकर्माणि स गच्छेत्परमां गतिम् ॥
पुण्यं पवित्रमायुष्यमिदानीं शृणुत द्विजाः ॥ 7 ॥
2.1.m: Hearing which, even one who has committed sinful deeds attains the supreme state. / Now listen, O twice-born, to that which is meritorious, purifying, and bestowing longevity. 7.

2.1.s:
bhaviṣyapurāṇamakhilaṃ yajjagāda gadādharaḥ ..
madhyaparva hyatho vakṣye pratiṣṭhādivinirṇayam .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
भविष्यपुराणमखिलं यज्जगाद गदाधरः ॥
मध्यपर्व ह्यथो वक्ष्ये प्रतिष्ठादिविनिर्णयम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: The entire Bhaviṣyapurāṇa which the Macer-Bearer proclaimed— / now I shall declare the Madhyaparvan, [containing] the determinations concerning consecration and the rest: 8.

2.1.s:
dharmapraśaṃsanaṃ cātra brāhmaṇādipraśaṃsanam ..
āpaddharmasya kathanaṃ vidyāmāhātmyavardhanam.. 9 ..
2.1.d:
धर्मप्रशंसनं चात्र ब्राह्मणादिप्रशंसनम् ॥
आपद्धर्मस्य कथनं विद्यामाहात्म्यवर्धनम्॥ 9 ॥
2.1.m: the praise of dharma here, the praise of Brahmins and the rest, / the declaration of dharma in times of distress, and the increase of the greatness of knowledge; 9.

2.1.s:
pratimākaraṇaṃ caiva sthāpanācitralakṣaṇam ..
kālavyavasthāsargādipratisargādilakṣaṇam .. 2.1.1.10 ..
2.1.d:
प्रतिमाकरणं चैव स्थापनाचित्रलक्षणम् ॥
कालव्यवस्थासर्गादिप्रतिसर्गादिलक्षणम् ॥ 2.1.1.10 ॥
2.1.m: the fashioning of images, installation, and the characteristics of painting; / the arrangement of time, the marks of creation, secondary creation, and so forth; 10.

2.1.s:
purāṇalakṣaṇaṃ caiva bhūgolasya ca nirṇayam ..
nirūpaṇaṃ tithīnāṃ ca śrāddhasaṃkalpamantaram .. 11 ..
2.1.d:
पुराणलक्षणं चैव भूगोलस्य च निर्णयम् ॥
निरूपणं तिथीनां च श्राद्धसंकल्पमन्तरम् ॥ 11 ॥
2.1.m: the characteristics of a Purāṇa, the determination of geography, / the ascertainment of lunar days, the intention of the ancestral rite, and intervals of time; 11.

2.1.s:
mumūrṣorapi yatkarma dānamāhātmyameva ca ..
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca yugadharmānuśāsanam .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
मुमूर्षोरपि यत्कर्म दानमाहात्म्यमेव च ॥
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च युगधर्मानुशासनम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: what is to be done even for one about to die, and the greatness of gifts; / what was, what is to be, and what will be, and the ordinance of the duties of the yugas; 12.

2.1.s:
uccāvacāvadhānaṃ ca prāyaścittādikaṃ ca yat ..
ṣaṣṭyādhikāṣṭasāhasranavaślokaśatodbhavam .. 13 ..
2.1.d:
उच्चावचावधानं च प्रायश्चित्तादिकं च यत् ॥
षष्ट्याधिकाष्टसाहस्रनवश्लोकशतोद्भवम् ॥ 13 ॥
2.1.m: attention to high and low matters, expiations, and the like; / originating in eight thousand nine hundred and sixty verses, 13.

2.1.s:
paṃcataṃtrasamāyuktaṃ pratitaṃtre ca viṃśatiḥ ..
paṃcottaraṃ tathādhyāyāḥ purāṇe'smindvijottamāḥ .. 14 ..
2.1.d:
पंचतंत्रसमायुक्तं प्रतितंत्रे च विंशतिः ॥
पंचोत्तरं तथाध्यायाः पुराणेऽस्मिन्द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 14 ॥
2.1.m: endowed with five treatises, twenty in each treatise, / and twenty-five chapters in this Purāṇa, O foremost of the twice-born. 14.

2.1.s:
trayāṇāmāśramāṇāṃ ca gṛhastho yonirucyate ..
anye'pi sūpajīvanti tasmācchreṣṭho gṛhāśramī .. 15..
2.1.d:
त्रयाणामाश्रमाणां च गृहस्थो योनिरुच्यते ॥
अन्येऽपि सूपजीवन्ति तस्माच्छ्रेष्ठो गृहाश्रमी ॥ 15॥
2.1.m: And of the three stages of life, the householder is said to be the source; / others also subsist upon him; therefore, the householder is the foremost. 15.

2.1.s:
ekāśramaṃ gṛhasthasya trayāṇāṃ mūrtidarśanam ..
tasmādgārhasthamevaikaṃ vijñeyaṃ dharmaśāsanam .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
एकाश्रमं गृहस्थस्य त्रयाणां मूर्तिदर्शनम् ॥
तस्माद्गार्हस्थमेवैकं विज्ञेयं धर्मशासनम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: The one stage of life of the householder shows the embodiment of all three; / therefore, the state of the householder alone should be known as the ordinance of dharma. 16.

2.1.s:
parityajedarthakāmau yau syātāṃ dharmavarjitau ..
sarvalokaviruddhaṃ ca dharmamapyācarenna tu ..17..
2.1.d:
परित्यजेदर्थकामौ यौ स्यातां धर्मवर्जितौ ॥
सर्वलोकविरुद्धं च धर्ममप्याचरेन्न तु ॥17॥
2.1.m: One should abandon wealth and desire that are devoid of dharma; / and one should not practice even dharma if it is contrary to all the world. 17.

2.1.s:
taḍāgasya ca sānnidhye taḍāgaṃ parivarjayet ..
prapāsthāne prapā varjyā maṭhasthāne maṭhaṃ tyajet ..18..
2.1.d:
तडागस्य च सान्निध्ये तडागं परिवर्जयेत् ॥
प्रपास्थाने प्रपा वर्ज्या मठस्थाने मठं त्यजेत् ॥18॥
2.1.m: In the vicinity of a pond, one should avoid [digging another] pond; / at the site of a water-booth, a water-booth should be avoided; at the site of a monastery, one should shun [building another] monastery. 18.

2.1.s:
dharmātsaṃjāyate hyartho dharmātkāmo'bhijāyate ..
dharmādevāpavargo'yaṃ tasmāddharmaṃ samāśrayet .. 19 ..
2.1.d:
धर्मात्संजायते ह्यर्थो धर्मात्कामोऽभिजायते ॥
धर्मादेवापवर्गोऽयं तस्माद्धर्मं समाश्रयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
2.1.m: For from dharma arises wealth; from dharma desire is born; / from dharma alone comes this liberation; therefore, one should resort to dharma. 19.

2.1.s:
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca trivargastriguṇo mataḥ ..
sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti tasmāddharmaṃ samāśrayet .. 2.1.1.20 ..
2.1.d:
धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च त्रिवर्गस्त्रिगुणो मतः ॥
सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चेति तस्माद्धर्मं समाश्रयेत् ॥ 2.1.1.20 ॥
2.1.m: Dharma, wealth, and desire are considered the triad of aims having the three qualities: / sattva, rajas, and tamas; therefore, one should resort to dharma. 20.

2.1.s:
ūrdhvaṃ gacchaṃti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhaṃti rājasāḥ ..
jaghanyaguṇavṛttisthā adho gacchaṃti tāmasāḥ .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
ऊर्ध्वं गच्छंति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठंति राजसाः ॥
जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छंति तामसाः ॥ 21 ॥
2.1.m: Those established in sattva go upward; those of rajas remain in the middle; / established in the conduct of the lowest quality, those of tamas go downward. 21.

2.1.s:
yasmindharmaḥ samāyukto hyarthakāmau vyavasthitau ..
iha loke sukhī bhūtvā pretyānaṃtyāya kalpate..22..
2.1.d:
यस्मिन्धर्मः समायुक्तो ह्यर्थकामौ व्यवस्थितौ ॥
इह लोके सुखी भूत्वा प्रेत्यानंत्याय कल्पते॥22॥
2.1.m: He in whom dharma is integrated, and wealth and desire are properly situated, / having become happy in this world, is fit for infinity upon dying. 22.

2.1.s:
tasmādarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca yuktvā dharmaṃ samāśrayet ..
dharmātsaṃjāyate kāmo dharmādarthobhijāyate..23..
2.1.d:
तस्मादर्थं च कामं च युक्त्वा धर्मं समाश्रयेत् ॥
धर्मात्संजायते कामो धर्मादर्थोभिजायते॥23॥
2.1.m: Therefore, having harmonized wealth and desire, one should take refuge in dharma; / from dharma desire is born; from dharma wealth is born. 23.

2.1.s:
evaṃ dharmasya madhye'yaṃ caturvargaḥ pradarśitaḥ ..
evaṃ ca dharmakāmārthaṃ mokṣasyāpi ca mānavaḥ ..
māhātmyaṃ vānutiṣṭhecca sa cānaṃtyāya kalpate .. 24 ..
2.1.d:
एवं धर्मस्य मध्येऽयं चतुर्वर्गः प्रदर्शितः ॥
एवं च धर्मकामार्थं मोक्षस्यापि च मानवः ॥
माहात्म्यं वानुतिष्ठेच्च स चानंत्याय कल्पते ॥ 24 ॥
2.1.m: Thus within dharma this fourfold aim has been shown; / and likewise, whether a person performs for dharma, desire, or wealth, / or follows the greatness of liberation, he is fit for infinity. 24.

2.1.s:
tasmādarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca muktvā dharmaṃ samācaret ..
dharmātsaṃjāyate sarvamityāhurbrahmavādinaḥ .. 25 ..
2.1.d:
तस्मादर्थं च कामं च मुक्त्वा धर्मं समाचरेत् ॥
धर्मात्संजायते सर्वमित्याहुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥ 25 ॥
2.1.m: Therefore, setting aside wealth and desire, one should practice dharma; / from dharma everything arises: so proclaim the teachers of Brahman. 25.

2.1.s:
dharmeṇa dhāryate sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ..
anādinidhanā śaktirnaiṣā brāhmī dvijottama .. 26 ..
2.1.d:
धर्मेण धार्यते सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् ॥
अनादिनिधना शक्तिर्नैषा ब्राह्मी द्विजोत्तम ॥ 26 ॥
2.1.m: By dharma all this world, mobile and immobile, is sustained; / this power, without beginning or end, is none other than Brāhmī, O foremost of the twice-born. 26.

2.1.s:
karmaṇā prāpyate dharmo jñānena ca na saṃśayaḥ ..
tasmājjñānena sahitaṃ karmayogaṃ samācaret .. 27 ..
2.1.d:
कर्मणा प्राप्यते धर्मो ज्ञानेन च न संशयः ॥
तस्माज्ज्ञानेन सहितं कर्मयोगं समाचरेत् ॥ 27 ॥
2.1.m: Dharma is attained through action and through knowledge, without doubt; / therefore, one should practice the yoga of action accompanied by knowledge. 27.

2.1.s:
pravṛttiśca nivṛttiśca dvividhaṃ karma vaidikam ..
jñānapūrvā nivṛttiḥ syātpravṛttirvartate'nyathā .. 28 ..
2.1.d:
प्रवृत्तिश्च निवृत्तिश्च द्विविधं कर्म वैदिकम् ॥
ज्ञानपूर्वा निवृत्तिः स्यात्प्रवृत्तिर्वर्ततेऽन्यथा ॥ 28 ॥
2.1.m: Active engagement and renunciation: twofold is Vedic action; / renunciation must be preceded by knowledge; active engagement proceeds otherwise. 28.

2.1.s:
nivṛttiṃ sevamānastu yāti tatparamaṃ padam ..
tasmānnivṛttaṃ saṃsevyamanyathā saṃsaretpunaḥ..29..
2.1.d:
निवृत्तिं सेवमानस्तु याति तत्परमं पदम् ॥
तस्मान्निवृत्तं संसेव्यमन्यथा संसरेत्पुनः॥29॥
2.1.m: One who attends to renunciation goes to that supreme state; / therefore, renunciation is to be practiced; otherwise one wanders in saṃsāra again. 29.

2.1.s:
śamo damo dayā dānamalobhastyāga eva ca ..
ārjavaṃ cānasūyā ca tīrthānusaraṇaṃ tathā .. 2.1.1.30 ..
2.1.d:
शमो दमो दया दानमलोभस्त्याग एव च ॥
आर्जवं चानसूया च तीर्थानुसरणं तथा ॥ 2.1.1.30 ॥
2.1.m: Tranquillity, self-restraint, compassion, charity, freedom from greed, and detachment, / uprightness, freedom from malice, and resorting to holy places; 30.

2.1.s:
satyaṃ saṃtoṣa āstikyaṃ śraddhā cendriyanigrahaḥ ..
devatābhyarcanaṃ pūjā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..31..
2.1.d:
सत्यं संतोष आस्तिक्यं श्रद्धा चेन्द्रियनिग्रहः ॥
देवताभ्यर्चनं पूजा ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः ॥31॥
2.1.m: truth, contentment, faith in the hereafter, devotion, and restraint of the senses, / the worship of deities, and especially the honoring of Brahmins; 31.

2.1.s:
ahiṃsā satyavāditvamapaiśunyaṃ sukalpatā ..
śaucācāraścānukaṃpā sarvavarṇe'bravīnmuniḥ..32..
2.1.d:
अहिंसा सत्यवादित्वमपैशुन्यं सुकल्पता ॥
शौचाचारश्चानुकंपा सर्ववर्णेऽब्रवीन्मुनिः॥32॥
2.1.m: non-violence, truthfulness in speech, absence of backbiting, competence, / clean conduct, and sympathy—the sage has spoken [of these] for all social classes. 32.

2.1.s:
śraddhāpūrvāḥ smṛtā dharmāḥ śraddhāmadhye tu saṃsthitāḥ ..
śraddhāniṣṭhāḥ pratiṣṭhāśca dharmāḥ śraddheva kīrtitāḥ .. 33 ..
2.1.d:
श्रद्धापूर्वाः स्मृता धर्माः श्रद्धामध्ये तु संस्थिताः ॥
श्रद्धानिष्ठाः प्रतिष्ठाश्च धर्माः श्रद्धेव कीर्तिताः ॥ 33 ॥
2.1.m: Dharmas are remembered as preceded by faith, and situated within faith; / having their basis and foundation in faith, dharmas are proclaimed to be faith itself. 33.

2.1.s:
prājāpatyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ śrutaṃ sthānaṃ kriyāvatām ..
sthānamaindraṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ saṃgrāmeṣvapalāyinām ..34..
2.1.d:
प्राजापत्यं ब्राह्मणानां श्रुतं स्थानं क्रियावताम् ॥
स्थानमैन्द्रं क्षत्रियाणां संग्रामेष्वपलायिनाम् ॥34॥
2.1.m: The realm of Prajāpati is heard of for Brahmins who perform rituals; / the realm of Indra is for Kṣatriyas who do not flee in battles; 34.

2.1.s:
vaiśyānāmamṛtaṃ sthānaṃ svadharmamanuvartatām ..
gāṃdharvaṃ śūdrajīvānāṃ paricāreṇa vartatām .. 35 ..
2.1.d:
वैश्यानाममृतं स्थानं स्वधर्ममनुवर्तताम् ॥
गांधर्वं शूद्रजीवानां परिचारेण वर्तताम् ॥ 35 ॥
2.1.m: the immortal realm is for Vaiśyas who pursue their own duty; / the realm of the Gandharvas is for Śūdra souls who live by service. 35.

2.1.s:
aṣṭāśīti sahasrāṇāṃ munīnāmūrdhvaretasām ..
smṛtaṃ sthānaṃ tu yatsthānaṃ tadeva guruvāsinām .. 36 ..
2.1.d:
अष्टाशीति सहस्राणां मुनीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् ॥
स्मृतं स्थानं तु यत्स्थानं तदेव गुरुवासिनाम् ॥ 36 ॥
2.1.m: That realm which is remembered for the eighty-eight thousand sages of upward-drawn seed / is the very realm for those who reside with their guru. 36.

2.1.s:
saptarṣīṇāṃ tu yatsthānaṃ śrutaṃ tadvai vanaukasām ..
prājāpatyaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ sthānamuktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā .. 37 ..
2.1.d:
सप्तर्षीणां तु यत्स्थानं श्रुतं तद्वै वनौकसाम् ॥
प्राजापत्यं गृहस्थानां स्थानमुक्तं स्वयंभुवा ॥ 37 ॥
2.1.m: The abode of the seven sages, it is heard, belongs indeed to the forest-dwellers; / the abode of Prajāpati was declared by the Self-born to belong to the householders.

2.1.s:
yatīnāṃ yatacittānāṃ tadeva vanavāsinām ..
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ yatsthānaṃ tasmānnāvartate punaḥ .. 38 ..
2.1.d:
यतीनां यतचित्तानां तदेव वनवासिनाम् ॥
हिरण्यगर्भं यत्स्थानं तस्मान्नावर्तते पुनः ॥ 38 ॥
2.1.m: That belonging to the forest-dwellers belongs likewise to ascetics of restrained minds; / from that abode which is Hiraṇyagarbha's, one does not return again.

2.1.s:
yogināmamṛtaṃ sthānaṃ vyomākhyaṃ paramākaram ..
ānaṃdamaiśvaraṃ nāma sā kāṣṭhā paramā gatiḥ .. 39 .. ..
sṛṣṭivarṇanam
2.1.d:
योगिनाममृतं स्थानं व्योमाख्यं परमाकरम् ॥
आनंदमैश्वरं नाम सा काष्ठा परमा गतिः ॥ 39 ॥ ॥
सृष्टिवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
The immortal abode of the yogins is called the Ether, the supreme mine [of bliss]; / it is named bliss of Īśvara; that is the culmination, the supreme goal.
Description of creation

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
idānīṃ vistaraṃ caiva vibhāgaṃ rūpamaiśvaram ..
vakṣye kalpānusāreṇa manvataraśatānugam .. 1 ..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इदानीं विस्तरं चैव विभागं रूपमैश्वरम् ॥
वक्ष्ये कल्पानुसारेण मन्वतरशतानुगम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / Now I shall explain in detail, according to the kalpa, the divisions and the sovereign form [of the divine], / following hundreds of manvantaras.

2.1.s:
āsīttamomayaṃ sarvamaprajñātamalakṣaṇam ..
tatra caiko mahānāsīdrudraḥ paramakāraṇam .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
आसीत्तमोमयं सर्वमप्रज्ञातमलक्षणम् ॥
तत्र चैको महानासीद्रुद्रः परमकारणम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: All was composed of darkness, unknown, devoid of distinguishing marks; / and there was one great Rudra, the ultimate cause.

2.1.s:
ātmanā svayamātmānaṃ sañcitya bhagavānvibhuḥ ..
manaḥ saṃsṛjate pūrvamahaṃkāraṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
आत्मना स्वयमात्मानं सञ्चित्य भगवान्विभुः ॥
मनः संसृजते पूर्वमहंकारं च पृष्ठतः ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: Having reflected within Himself by Himself, the all-pervading Blessed One / first brought forth the mind, and after it, the ego.

2.1.s:
ahaṃkārātprajānāti mahābhūtāni pañca ca ..
aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ proktā vikārāścaiva ṣoḍaśa .. 4 ..
2.1.d:
अहंकारात्प्रजानाति महाभूतानि पञ्च च ॥
अष्टौ प्रकृतयः प्रोक्ता विकाराश्चैव षोडश ॥ 4 ॥
2.1.m: From the ego He brings forth the five great elements; / eight primary causes have been declared, and sixteen modifications.

2.1.s:
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gaṃdhastathaiva ca ..
prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaścodānavyānau tathaiva ca .. 5 ..
2.1.d:
शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गंधस्तथैव च ॥
प्राणोऽपानः समानश्चोदानव्यानौ तथैव च ॥ 5 ॥
2.1.m: Sound, touch, form, taste, and likewise smell, / and likewise the vital breaths prāṇa, apāna, samāna, udāna, and vyāna.

2.1.s:
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva guṇāḥ proktāstu te trayaḥ ..
tasmādbhāgavato brahmā tasmādviṣṇurajāyata ..6..
2.1.d:
सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव गुणाः प्रोक्तास्तु ते त्रयः ॥
तस्माद्भागवतो ब्रह्मा तस्माद्विष्णुरजायत ॥6॥
2.1.m: Sattva, rajas, and tamas are declared to be those three qualities; / from that divine source Brahmā was born, and from it Viṣṇu was born.

2.1.s:
brahmaviṣṇumohanārthaṃ tataḥ śaṃbhustu tejasā ..
aśarīro vāsudevo hyanutpattirayonijaḥ ..7..
2.1.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमोहनार्थं ततः शंभुस्तु तेजसा ॥
अशरीरो वासुदेवो ह्यनुत्पत्तिरयोनिजः ॥7॥
2.1.m: Then Śambhu, for the purpose of deluding Brahmā and Viṣṇu, by His splendor / [became] the bodiless Vāsudeva, without birth, not born from a womb.

2.1.s:
vyāmohayitvā tatsarvaṃ tejasā'mohayajjagat ..
tasmātparataraṃ nāsti tasmātparataraṃ na hi .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
व्यामोहयित्वा तत्सर्वं तेजसाऽमोहयज्जगत् ॥
तस्मात्परतरं नास्ति तस्मात्परतरं न हि ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: Having thoroughly bewildered all that, He deluded the world by His splendor; / there is nothing higher than Him, indeed there is nothing higher than Him.

2.1.s:
brahmā viṣṇuśca dvāvetāvudbhūtau bhagavatsutau ..
kalpekalpe tu tatsarvaṃ sṛjate'sau janaṃ jagat .. 9 ..
2.1.d:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च द्वावेतावुद्भूतौ भगवत्सुतौ ॥
कल्पेकल्पे तु तत्सर्वं सृजतेऽसौ जनं जगत् ॥ 9 ॥
2.1.m: These two, Brahmā and Viṣṇu, arose as sons of the Blessed One; / kalpa after kalpa, He creates all that—the people and the world.

2.1.s:
upasaṃharate caiva nānābhūtāni sarvaśaḥ ..
dvāsaptatiyugānyeva manvantara iti smṛtaḥ .. 2.1.2.10 ..
2.1.d:
उपसंहरते चैव नानाभूतानि सर्वशः ॥
द्वासप्ततियुगान्येव मन्वन्तर इति स्मृतः ॥ 2.1.2.10 ॥
2.1.m: And He dissolves the diverse living beings on all sides; / seventy-two yugas are recorded as a manvantara.

2.1.s:
caturdaśa tu tānyevaṃ kalpa ityabhidhīyate ..
dinaikaṃ brahmaṇaḥ proktaṃ niśi kalpastathocyate .. 11 ..
2.1.d:
चतुर्दश तु तान्येवं कल्प इत्यभिधीयते ॥
दिनैकं ब्रह्मणः प्रोक्तं निशि कल्पस्तथोच्यते ॥ 11 ॥
2.1.m: Fourteen such [manvantaras] are designated a kalpa; / one kalpa is said to be a day of Brahmā, and likewise [a kalpa] is declared in His night.

2.1.s:
evaṃ māsaśca varṣaśca tathā cāṣṭaśataṃ dvijāḥ ..
evaṃ buddhīndriyasyāsya viṣṇośca nimiṣaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
एवं मासश्च वर्षश्च तथा चाष्टशतं द्विजाः ॥
एवं बुद्धीन्द्रियस्यास्य विष्णोश्च निमिषः स्मृतः ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: Thus a month and a year, and thus one hundred and eight [years], O twice-born; / such is recorded as the blink of Viṣṇu, the faculty of intellect.

2.1.s:
brahmādistaṃbaparyaṃtaṃ nimeṣaśca dhruvasya vai ..
nimeṣajīvanaṃ sarvaṃ sarvalokacarācaram .. 13 ..
2.1.d:
ब्रह्मादिस्तंबपर्यंतं निमेषश्च ध्रुवस्य वै ॥
निमेषजीवनं सर्वं सर्वलोकचराचरम् ॥ 13 ॥
2.1.m: From Brahmā down to a clump of grass is indeed a blink of Dhruva; / the life of all the moving and unmoving in all the worlds is a mere blink.

2.1.s:
bhūrloko'tha bhuvarlokaḥ svarlokaśca prakīrtitaḥ ..
janastapaśca satyaṃ ca brahmalokaśca saptamaḥ .. 14 ..
2.1.d:
भूर्लोकोऽथ भुवर्लोकः स्वर्लोकश्च प्रकीर्तितः ॥
जनस्तपश्च सत्यं च ब्रह्मलोकश्च सप्तमः ॥ 14 ॥
2.1.m: Bhūrloka, then Bhuvarloka, and Svarloka are proclaimed; / Janas, Tapas, and Satya, and Brahmaloka as the seventh.

2.1.s:
pātālaṃ vitalaṃ taddhi atalaṃ talameva ca ..
pañcamaṃ viddhi sutalaṃ saptamaṃ ca rasātalam .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
पातालं वितलं तद्धि अतलं तलमेव च ॥
पञ्चमं विद्धि सुतलं सप्तमं च रसातलम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: Know Pātāla, Vitala, Atala, and Tala, / Sutala as the fifth, and Rasātala as the seventh.

2.1.s:
eteṣu saptavikhyātā adhaḥpātālavāsinaḥ ..
teṣāmādau ca madhye ca aṃte rudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
एतेषु सप्तविख्याता अधःपातालवासिनः ॥
तेषामादौ च मध्ये च अंते रुद्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: Dwelling below in the nether worlds are these seven well-known regions; / at their beginning, middle, and end, Rudra is proclaimed.

2.1.s:
grasate jāyate lokānkrīḍārthaṃ tu maheśvaraḥ ..
brahmalokaparīpsūnāṃ gatirūrdhvaṃ prakīrtitā .. 17 ..
2.1.d:
ग्रसते जायते लोकान्क्रीडार्थं तु महेश्वरः ॥
ब्रह्मलोकपरीप्सूनां गतिरूर्ध्वं प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 17 ॥
2.1.m: Maheśvara swallows and gives birth to the worlds for the sake of sport; / for those who desire to attain Brahmaloka, an upward path is proclaimed.

2.1.s:
pṛthivīṃ cāṃtarikṣaṃ ca diśaśca vidiśastathā ..
samudrāṇāṃ girīṇāṃ ca adhastiryakprasaṃkhyayā .. 18 ..
2.1.d:
पृथिवीं चांतरिक्षं च दिशश्च विदिशस्तथा ॥
समुद्राणां गिरीणां च अधस्तिर्यक्प्रसंख्यया ॥ 18 ॥
2.1.m: Earth and intermediate space, the directions and the intermediate directions, / of the oceans and mountains, by calculation below and obliquely—

2.1.s:
samudrāṇāṃ ca vistāraṃ pramāṇaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu ..
sthāvarāṇāṃ ca śailānāṃ devānāṃ ca divaukasām .. 19 ..
2.1.d:
समुद्राणां च विस्तारं प्रमाणं च ततः शृणु ॥
स्थावराणां च शैलानां देवानां च दिवौकसाम् ॥ 19 ॥
2.1.m: hear then the extent and measurement of the oceans, / and of the immovable mountains, and of the gods who dwell in heaven,

2.1.s:
catuṣpadānāṃ dvipadāṃ tathā dharmaikabhāṣiṇām ..
sahasraguṇamākhyātaṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ prakīrtitam .. 2.1.2.20 ..
2.1.d:
चतुष्पदानां द्विपदां तथा धर्मैकभाषिणाम् ॥
सहस्रगुणमाख्यातं स्थावराणां प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 2.1.2.20 ॥
2.1.m: of four-footed and two-footed beings, and of those who speak of virtue alone; / a thousandfold nature is declared of immovable things;

2.1.s:
sahasraguṇaśīlāśca ityāha bhagavānmuniḥ ..
ṛṣistu prathamaṃ kurvanprakṛtiṃ nāma nāmataḥ .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
सहस्रगुणशीलाश्च इत्याह भगवान्मुनिः ॥
ऋषिस्तु प्रथमं कुर्वन्प्रकृतिं नाम नामतः ॥ 21 ॥
2.1.m: and their dispositions are thousandfold, so said the blessed sage. / The sage first making what is called Prakṛti by name,

2.1.s:
tasyā brahmā prakṛtyāstu utpannaḥ saha viṣṇunā ..
tasmādbuddhyā prakurute sṛṣṭiṃ naimittikīṃ dvijāḥ .. 22 ..
2.1.d:
तस्या ब्रह्मा प्रकृत्यास्तु उत्पन्नः सह विष्णुना ॥
तस्माद्बुद्ध्या प्रकुरुते सृष्टिं नैमित्तिकीं द्विजाः ॥ 22 ॥
2.1.m: from that Prakṛti Brahmā was born together with Viṣṇu; / therefore, O twice-born, He produces the occasional creation by His intellect.

2.1.s:
tasmātsvayaṃbhuvo brahmā brāhmaṇānsamakalpayat ..
pādahīnānkṣatriyāṃśca tasmāddhīnāṃstu vaiśyakān .. 23 ..
2.1.d:
तस्मात्स्वयंभुवो ब्रह्मा ब्राह्मणान्समकल्पयत् ॥
पादहीनान्क्षत्रियांश्च तस्माद्धीनांस्तु वैश्यकान् ॥ 23 ॥
2.1.m: From that, Brahmā the Self-born fashioned the brāhmaṇas; / and kṣatriyas lacking one foot, and vaiśyas lesser than them,

2.1.s:
caturtha pādahīnāṃśca ācāreṣu bahiṣkṛtān ..
pṛthivīṃ cāṃtarikṣaṃ ca diśaścaivāpyakalpayat .. 24 ..
2.1.d:
चतुर्थ पादहीनांश्च आचारेषु बहिष्कृतान् ॥
पृथिवीं चांतरिक्षं च दिशश्चैवाप्यकल्पयत् ॥ 24 ॥
2.1.m: and the fourth [class] lacking a foot, cast out from proper conduct; / He also fashioned the earth, the intermediate space, and the directions,

2.1.s:
lokālokasya saṃsthā ca dvīpānāmudadhestathā ..
saritāṃ sāgarāṇāṃ ca tīrthānyāyatanāni ca .. 25 ..
2.1.d:
लोकालोकस्य संस्था च द्वीपानामुदधेस्तथा ॥
सरितां सागराणां च तीर्थान्यायतनानि च ॥ 25 ॥
2.1.m: and the arrangement of the Lokāloka mountain, of the continents and the ocean, / of rivers and seas, sacred places and shrines,

2.1.s:
meghastanitanirghoṣarohiteṃdradhanūṃṣi ca ..
ulkānirghātaketūṃśca jyotīṃṣyāyatanāni ca .. 26 ..
2.1.d:
मेघस्तनितनिर्घोषरोहितेंद्रधनूंषि च ॥
उल्कानिर्घातकेतूंश्च ज्योतींष्यायतनानि च ॥ 26 ॥
2.1.m: the thunderclaps of clouds, red clouds, and rainbows, / meteors, thunderbolts, comets, luminous bodies, and dwellings;

2.1.s:
utpannaṃ tasya deheṣu bhūyaḥ kālena pīḍayet .. 27 ..
pātālavarṇanam
2.1.d:
उत्पन्नं तस्य देहेषु भूयः कालेन पीडयेत् ॥ 27 ॥
पातालवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
what was born in His bodies He would afflict again in the course of time.
Description of the nether world

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dhruvādūrdhvaṃ maharlokaḥ koṭiyojanavistaraḥ ..
kalpābhikaraṇe tatra saṃsthitā dvijapuṅgavāḥ .. 1 ..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
ध्रुवादूर्ध्वं महर्लोकः कोटियोजनविस्तरः ॥
कल्पाभिकरणे तत्र संस्थिता द्विजपुङ्गवाः ॥ 1 ॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / Above Dhruva is Maharloka, extending a crore of yojanas; / there dwell the foremost among the twice-born at the commencement of a kalpa.

2.1.s:
janaloko maharlokāttathā koṭidvayātmakaḥ ..
sanaṃdanādayastatra saṃsthitā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
जनलोको महर्लोकात्तथा कोटिद्वयात्मकः ॥
सनंदनादयस्तत्र संस्थिता ब्रह्मणः सुताः ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: Janaloka is beyond Maharloka, consisting likewise of two crores; / there dwell Sanandana and the other sons of Brahmā.

2.1.s:
janalokāttapolokaḥ koṭitrayasamanvitaḥ ..
virājaṃte tu devā vai sthitā dāha vivarjitāḥ .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
जनलोकात्तपोलोकः कोटित्रयसमन्वितः ॥
विराजंते तु देवा वै स्थिता दाह विवर्जिताः ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: Beyond Janaloka is Tapoloka, measuring three crores; / there the gods shine forth, situated free from burning heat.

2.1.s:
prājāpatyāttu bhūrlokaḥ koṭiṣaṭkena saṃyutaḥ ..
sanatkumārakastatra brahmalokastu sa smṛtaḥ .. 4 ..
2.1.d:
प्राजापत्यात्तु भूर्लोकः कोटिषट्केन संयुतः ॥
सनत्कुमारकस्तत्र ब्रह्मलोकस्तु स स्मृतः ॥ 4 ॥
2.1.m: Beyond the realm of Prajāpati, the world extends with six crores; / Sanatkumāra is there; it is recorded as Brahmaloka.

2.1.s:
tatra loke gururbrahmā viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ ..
āste yadyogibhiḥ pītvā yogaṃ mṛtyoḥ paraṃ gatam .. 5 ..
2.1.d:
तत्र लोके गुरुर्ब्रह्मा विश्वात्मा विश्वतोमुखः ॥
आस्ते यद्योगिभिः पीत्वा योगं मृत्योः परं गतम् ॥ 5 ॥
2.1.m: In that world resides Brahmā the teacher, the self of the universe, facing all directions, / having drunk that yoga which is practiced by yogins, gone beyond death.

2.1.s:
gāyaṃti yatayo gāthā hyāstikā brahmavādinaḥ ..
yoginastāpasāḥ siddhā jāpakāḥ parameṣṭhinam .. 6 ..
2.1.d:
गायंति यतयो गाथा ह्यास्तिका ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥
योगिनस्तापसाः सिद्धा जापकाः परमेष्ठिनम् ॥ 6 ॥
2.1.m: Orthodox ascetics who expound the Veda, / yogins, practitioners of austerity, siddhas, and reciters sing hymns of praise to Parameṣṭhin.

2.1.s:
dvāraṃ tu yogināmekaṃ gacchatāṃ paramaṃ padam ..
tatra gatvā na śocaṃti sa viṣṇuḥ sa ca śaṃkaraḥ .. 7 ..
2.1.d:
द्वारं तु योगिनामेकं गच्छतां परमं पदम् ॥
तत्र गत्वा न शोचंति स विष्णुः स च शंकरः ॥ 7 ॥
2.1.m: It is the sole gate for yogins going to the supreme abode; / having gone there, they do not grieve; that is Viṣṇu, and that is Śaṅkara.

2.1.s:
sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ puraṃ tasya durāsadam ..
na me varṇayituṃ śakyaṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशं पुरं तस्य दुरासदम् ॥
न मे वर्णयितुं शक्यं ज्वालामालासमाकुलम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: His city is difficult of approach, resembling a crore of suns; / I am not able to describe it, crowded with wreaths of flames.

2.1.s:
tatra nārāyaṇasyāpi bhavanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pure ..
śeṣe tasya hariḥ śrīmānmāyāsahacaraḥ paraḥ .. 9 ..
2.1.d:
तत्र नारायणस्यापि भवनं ब्रह्मणः पुरे ॥
शेषे तस्य हरिः श्रीमान्मायासहचरः परः ॥ 9 ॥
2.1.m: There in the city of Brahmā is also the residence of Nārāyaṇa; / on Śeṣa lies the glorious Hari, accompanied by Māyā, transcendent.

2.1.s:
sa viṣṇurlokakathitaḥ punarāvṛttivarjitaḥ ..
prayāṃti ca mahātmāno ye prapannā janārdanam .. 2.1.3.10 ..
2.1.d:
स विष्णुर्लोककथितः पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितः ॥
प्रयांति च महात्मानो ये प्रपन्ना जनार्दनम् ॥ 2.1.3.10 ॥
2.1.m: That is spoken of as the world of Viṣṇu, devoid of return; / and the great-souled ones who have surrendered to Janārdana go there.

2.1.s:
ūrdhvaṃ brahmāsanātpūrvaṃ paraṃ jyotirmayaṃ śubham ..
vahninā upari kṣiptaṃ tatrāste bhagavānbhavaḥ ..11..
2.1.d:
ऊर्ध्वं ब्रह्मासनात्पूर्वं परं ज्योतिर्मयं शुभम् ॥
वह्निना उपरि क्षिप्तं तत्रास्ते भगवान्भवः ॥11॥
2.1.m: Above, before the seat of Brahmā, the supreme, luminous, and auspicious [realm], / cast upward by fire—there sits the blessed Bhava,

2.1.s:
devyā saha mahādevaścintyamāno manīṣibhiḥ ..
yogibhiḥ śatasāhasrairvṛtaikatvaiśca saṃvṛtaḥ .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
देव्या सह महादेवश्चिन्त्यमानो मनीषिभिः ॥
योगिभिः शतसाहस्रैर्वृतैकत्वैश्च संवृतः ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: Mahādeva together with the Goddess, meditated upon by wise men, / surrounded by yogins by the hundreds of thousands who have achieved oneness.

2.1.s:
tatra te yāṃti niyatā dvijā vai brahmavādinaḥ ..
mahādevapareśānāstāpasā brahmavādinaḥ .. 13 ..
2.1.d:
तत्र ते यांति नियता द्विजा वै ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥
महादेवपरेशानास्तापसा ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥ 13 ॥
2.1.m: There go those self-restrained twice-born who expound the Veda, / ascetics devoted to Mahādeva, the supreme lord, expounders of the Veda.

2.1.s:
nirmamā nirahaṃkārāḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitāḥ ..
drakṣyaṃti brahmaṇā yuktā rudralokaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ .. 14 ..
2.1.d:
निर्ममा निरहंकाराः कामक्रोधविवर्जिताः ॥
द्रक्ष्यंति ब्रह्मणा युक्ता रुद्रलोकः स वै स्मृतः ॥ 14 ॥
2.1.m: Free from possessiveness, free from egotism, and rid of desire and anger, / joined with Brahman they shall behold [him]; that is indeed known as the realm of Rudra.

2.1.s:
ete sapta maharlokāḥ pṛthivyāṃ parikīrtitāḥ ..
mahītalādayaścādhaḥ pātālāḥ saṃti vai dvijāḥ .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
एते सप्त महर्लोकाः पृथिव्यां परिकीर्तिताः ॥
महीतलादयश्चाधः पातालाः संति वै द्विजाः ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: These seven great worlds have been proclaimed on the earth. / Below the surface of the earth, O twice-born ones, are the subterranean realms (Pātālas).

2.1.s:
mahātalaṃ haimatalaṃ sarvavarṇopaśobhitam ..
prāsādairvividhaiḥ śubhrairdevatāyatanairyutam .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
महातलं हैमतलं सर्ववर्णोपशोभितम् ॥
प्रासादैर्विविधैः शुभ्रैर्देवतायतनैर्युतम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: Mahātala has a golden surface, adorned with all colours, / endowed with diverse splendid palaces and temples of deities.

2.1.s:
anaṃtena samāyuktaṃ mucukundena dhīmatā ..
nṛpeṇa balinā caiva pātālaṃ svargavāsinā .. 17 ..
2.1.d:
अनंतेन समायुक्तं मुचुकुन्देन धीमता ॥
नृपेण बलिना चैव पातालं स्वर्गवासिना ॥ 17 ॥
2.1.m: Endowed with Ananta, with the wise Mucukunda, / and with the king Bali, a dweller of heaven, is Pātāla.

2.1.s:
śailaṃ rasātalaṃ viprāḥ śāṃkaraṃ hi rasātalam ..
pītaṃ sutalamityuktaṃ vitalaṃ vidrumaprabham .. 18 ..
2.1.d:
शैलं रसातलं विप्राः शांकरं हि रसातलम् ॥
पीतं सुतलमित्युक्तं वितलं विद्रुमप्रभम् ॥ 18 ॥
2.1.m: Rasātala is rocky, O Brahmins, for Rasātala belongs to Śaṅkara; / Sutala is said to be yellow, and Vitala has the radiance of coral.

2.1.s:
sitaṃ hi vitalaṃ proktaṃ talaṃ caiva sitetaram ..
suvarṇena muniśreṣṭhāstathā vāsukinā śubham .. 19 ..
2.1.d:
सितं हि वितलं प्रोक्तं तलं चैव सितेतरम् ॥
सुवर्णेन मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तथा वासुकिना शुभम् ॥ 19 ॥
2.1.m: Vitala is declared white, and Tala is non-white; / O best of sages, auspicious with gold and with Vāsuki

2.1.s:
rasātalamiti khyātaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam ..
vainateyādibhiścaiva kālanemipurogamaiḥ .. 2.1.3.20 ..
2.1.d:
रसातलमिति ख्यातं सर्वशोभासमन्वितम् ॥
वैनतेयादिभिश्चैव कालनेमिपुरोगमैः ॥ 2.1.3.20 ॥
2.1.m: is that renowned as Rasātala, endowed with all splendour, / along with the descendants of Vinatā and others headed by Kālanemi.

2.1.s:
śaṃkukarṇena saṃbhinnaṃ tathā namucipūrvakam ..
tathānyairvivi dhairnāgaistalaṃ caiva suśobhanam .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
शंकुकर्णेन संभिन्नं तथा नमुचिपूर्वकम् ॥
तथान्यैर्विवि धैर्नागैस्तलं चैव सुशोभनम् ॥ 21 ॥
2.1.m: Interspersed with Śaṅkukarṇa and with Namuci at the head, / and with various other nāgas, Tala is indeed very splendid.

2.1.s:
teṣāmadhastānnarakā rauravādyāśca koṭayaḥ ..
pāpinasteṣu pātyaṃte na te'vanamituṃ kṣamāḥ .. 22 ..
2.1.d:
तेषामधस्तान्नरका रौरवाद्याश्च कोटयः ॥
पापिनस्तेषु पात्यंते न तेऽवनमितुं क्षमाः ॥ 22 ॥
2.1.m: Beneath them are the hells, crores of them, beginning with Raurava; / sinners are thrown into them, unable to rise up.

2.1.s:
pātālā nāmadhaścāṃte śeṣākhyā vaiṣṇavī tanuḥ ..
kālāgnirudrayogātmā nārasiṃho'pi mādhavaḥ .. 23 ..
2.1.d:
पाताला नामधश्चांते शेषाख्या वैष्णवी तनुः ॥
कालाग्निरुद्रयोगात्मा नारसिंहोऽपि माधवः ॥ 23 ॥
2.1.m: And beneath the Pātālas, at the very bottom, is the Vaiṣṇava form named Śeṣa, / the soul of the yoga of Kālāgnirudra, Nārasiṃha, and Mādhava,

2.1.s:
yo'naṃtaḥ paṭhyate devo nāgarūpī janārdanaḥ ..
tadādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ sakalāgnimupāśritam .. 24 ..
2.1.d:
योऽनंतः पठ्यते देवो नागरूपी जनार्दनः ॥
तदाधारमिदं सर्वं सकलाग्निमुपाश्रितम् ॥ 24 ॥
2.1.m: the god who is celebrated as Ananta, Janārdana in the form of a serpent. / All this rests upon that support, abiding in all fires.

2.1.s:
tamāviśya mahāyogī kālastadvadanānalaḥ ..
viṣajvālāsamo'naṃto jagatsaṃharati svayam ..25..
2.1.d:
तमाविश्य महायोगी कालस्तद्वदनानलः ॥
विषज्वालासमोऽनंतो जगत्संहरति स्वयम् ॥25॥
2.1.m: Entering him, the great yogin Time, the fire of whose mouth is like that, / resembling a flame of poison, Ananta himself dissolves the universe.

2.1.s:
tāmasī śāṃbhavī mūrtiḥ kālātmā parameśvaraḥ..
sa eva garbhamāśritya prakāśayati nityaśaḥ ..26..
jyotiścakravarṇanam
2.1.d:
तामसी शांभवी मूर्तिः कालात्मा परमेश्वरः॥
स एव गर्भमाश्रित्य प्रकाशयति नित्यशः ॥26॥
ज्योतिश्चक्रवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
His is the tāmasic, Śāmbhava form, the Supreme Lord whose self is Time; / resorting to the womb, he indeed illuminates [everything] perpetually.
Description of the Zodiac Wheel

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadbrahmāṃḍamākhyātaṃ caturvidhamidaṃ mahat ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhūrlokasya vinirṇayam .. 1 ..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
एतद्ब्रह्मांडमाख्यातं चतुर्विधमिदं महत् ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि भूर्लोकस्य विनिर्णयम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.1.m:
Sūta said:
This great cosmic egg of four kinds has been described; / hereafter I shall declare the determination of the terrestrial realm (Bhūrloka).

2.1.s:
taddvīpapradhāno jaṃbūḥ plakṣaḥ śālmala eva ca ..
kuśaḥ krauṃcaśca śākaśca puṣkaraścaiva saptamaḥ .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
तद्द्वीपप्रधानो जंबूः प्लक्षः शाल्मल एव च ॥
कुशः क्रौंचश्च शाकश्च पुष्करश्चैव सप्तमः ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: Its principal island is Jambū, followed by Plakṣa, Śālmala, / Kuśa, Krauñca, Śāka, and Puṣkara as the seventh.

2.1.s:
ete sapta mahādvīpāḥ samudraiḥ saptabhirvṛtāḥ ..
dvīpāddvīpo mahānuktaḥ sāgarādapi sāgaraḥ .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
एते सप्त महाद्वीपाः समुद्रैः सप्तभिर्वृताः ॥
द्वीपाद्द्वीपो महानुक्तः सागरादपि सागरः ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: These seven great continents are encircled by seven oceans; / each continent is said to be greater than the preceding, and each ocean greater than the preceding ocean.

2.1.s:
kṣīrodekṣurasodo'tha kṣārodaśca ghṛtodakaḥ ..
dadhyodaḥ kṣīrasalilo jalodaśceti sāgarāḥ .. 4 ..
2.1.d:
क्षीरोदेक्षुरसोदोऽथ क्षारोदश्च घृतोदकः ॥
दध्योदः क्षीरसलिलो जलोदश्चेति सागराः ॥ 4 ॥
2.1.m: The milk ocean, the sugarcane-juice ocean, then the salt ocean and the clarified-butter ocean, / the curd ocean, the milky-water ocean, and the fresh-water ocean: such are the oceans.

2.1.s:
paṃcāśatkoṭivistīrṇā samudravalayā smṛtā..
dvīpaiśca saptabhiryuktā yojanānāṃ samānataḥ .. 5 ..
2.1.d:
पंचाशत्कोटिविस्तीर्णा समुद्रवलया स्मृता॥
द्वीपैश्च सप्तभिर्युक्ता योजनानां समानतः ॥ 5 ॥
2.1.m: [The earth] is remembered as fifty crores [of yojanas] in extent, ringed by oceans, / and endowed with seven continents, equal in yojanas.

2.1.s:
jaṃbūdvīpaḥ samastānāṃ dvīpānāṃ madhyataḥ śubhaḥ ..
tasya madhye mahāmerurviśrutaḥ kanakaprabhaḥ .. 6 ..
2.1.d:
जंबूद्वीपः समस्तानां द्वीपानां मध्यतः शुभः ॥
तस्य मध्ये महामेरुर्विश्रुतः कनकप्रभः ॥ 6 ॥
2.1.m: Auspicious Jambūdvīpa lies in the middle of all the continents; / in its centre is renowned the great Meru, shining like gold.

2.1.s:
caturāśītisāhasrayojanairasya cocchrayaḥ ..
praviṣṭaḥ ṣoḍaśādhastāddvātriṃśanmūrdhni viṣkṛtaḥ .. 7 ..
2.1.d:
चतुराशीतिसाहस्रयोजनैरस्य चोच्छ्रयः ॥
प्रविष्टः षोडशाधस्ताद्द्वात्रिंशन्मूर्ध्नि विष्कृतः ॥ 7 ॥
2.1.m: Its height is eighty-four thousand yojanas; / it penetrates sixteen [thousand] beneath, and is thirty-two [thousand] wide at its summit.

2.1.s:
mūle ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ vistārastasya sarvataḥ ..
bhūpramukhyaśca śailo'sau kalikātvena saṃsthitaḥ .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
मूले षोडशसाहस्रं विस्तारस्तस्य सर्वतः ॥
भूप्रमुख्यश्च शैलोऽसौ कलिकात्वेन संस्थितः ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: At its base its width on all sides is sixteen thousand [yojanas]; / and this mountain, foremost on earth, stands in the shape of a lotus bud.

2.1.s:
himavānhimakūṭaśca niṣadhasta sya dakṣiṇe ..
nīlaḥ śvetaśca śṛṃgī ca uttare varṣaparvataḥ..9..
2.1.d:
हिमवान्हिमकूटश्च निषधस्त स्य दक्षिणे ॥
नीलः श्वेतश्च शृंगी च उत्तरे वर्षपर्वतः॥9॥
2.1.m: Himavān, Hemakūṭa, and Niṣadha lie to its south; / Nīla, Śveta, and Śṛṅgin are the boundary mountains to the north.

2.1.s:
lakṣapramāṇau dvau madhye daśahīnāstathāpare ..
sahasradvitayaṃ dīrghāstāvadvistāriṇaśca te .. ..2.1.4.10..
2.1.d:
लक्षप्रमाणौ द्वौ मध्ये दशहीनास्तथापरे ॥
सहस्रद्वितयं दीर्घास्तावद्विस्तारिणश्च ते ॥ ॥2.1.4.10॥
2.1.m: The two in the middle measure one hundred thousand [yojanas], and the others are less by ten [thousand]; / they are two thousand in height and equally broad.

2.1.s:
bhārataṃ dakṣiṇaṃ varṣaṃ tataḥ kiṃpuruṣaṃ smṛtam ..
harivarṣaṃ tathaivānyanmerordakṣiṇato dvijāḥ ..11..
2.1.d:
भारतं दक्षिणं वर्षं ततः किंपुरुषं स्मृतम् ॥
हरिवर्षं तथैवान्यन्मेरोर्दक्षिणतो द्विजाः ॥11॥
2.1.m: Bhārata is the southern continent; next is remembered Kiṃpuruṣa; / and Harivarṣa is another, south of Meru, O twice-born ones.

2.1.s:
caṃpakaṃ cottaraṃ varṣaṃ tathaivāśvahiraṇmayam..
uttarāḥ kuravaścaiva yathaite bhāratāstathā .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
चंपकं चोत्तरं वर्षं तथैवाश्वहिरण्मयम्॥
उत्तराः कुरवश्चैव यथैते भारतास्तथा ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: Campaka is the northern continent, and likewise Hiraṇmaya with its horses, / and Uttarakuru, just as these [are situated in relation to] Bhārata.

2.1.s:
navasāhasramekaikameteṣāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
ilāvṛtaśca tanmadhye tanmadhye merurucchritaḥ ..13..
2.1.d:
नवसाहस्रमेकैकमेतेषां द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
इलावृतश्च तन्मध्ये तन्मध्ये मेरुरुच्छ्रितः ॥13॥
2.1.m: Each one of these measures nine thousand [yojanas], O best of twice-born ones; / and between them is Ilāvṛta, in the middle of which stands lofty Meru.

2.1.s:
meroścaturdiśastatra navasāhasraviṣkṛtam ..
ilāvṛtaṃ mahābhāgāścatvārastatra parvatāḥ ..14..
2.1.d:
मेरोश्चतुर्दिशस्तत्र नवसाहस्रविष्कृतम् ॥
इलावृतं महाभागाश्चत्वारस्तत्र पर्वताः ॥14॥
2.1.m: On the four sides of Meru, stretching across nine thousand [yojanas], / is Ilāvṛta, O noble ones, and there are four mountains

2.1.s:
viṣkaṃbhā racitā meroryojanāyutamucchritāḥ ..
pūrveṇa maṃdaro nāma dakṣiṇe gaṃdhamādanaḥ .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
विष्कंभा रचिता मेरोर्योजनायुतमुच्छ्रिताः ॥
पूर्वेण मंदरो नाम दक्षिणे गंधमादनः ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: erected as buttresses of Meru, ten thousand yojanas high: / to the east is Mandara, to the south Gandhamādana,

2.1.s:
vipulaḥ paścime bhāge supārśvaścottare sthitaḥ ..
kadaṃbeṣveṣu nadyaśca pippalo vaṭa eva ca .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
विपुलः पश्चिमे भागे सुपार्श्वश्चोत्तरे स्थितः ॥
कदंबेष्वेषु नद्यश्च पिप्पलो वट एव च ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: Vipula stands on the western side, and Supārśva on the north; / on these are rivers among the kadamba trees, as well as the pippala and the banyan.

2.1.s:
jaṃbūdvīpasya sā jaṃbūrnāmahetormaharṣayaḥ ..
mahāgajapramāṇāni jaṃbūnyasya phalāni ca .. 17 ..
2.1.d:
जंबूद्वीपस्य सा जंबूर्नामहेतोर्महर्षयः ॥
महागजप्रमाणानि जंबून्यस्य फलानि च ॥ 17 ॥
2.1.m: That rose-apple tree (jambū) is the reason for the name of Jambūdvīpa, O great sages; / and its jambū fruits are as large as huge elephants.

2.1.s:
pataṃti bhūbhṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhe śīryamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ ..
rasena caiva prakhyātā tasya jaṃbūnadī iti ..18..
2.1.d:
पतंति भूभृतः पृष्ठे शीर्यमाणानि सर्वशः ॥
रसेन चैव प्रख्याता तस्य जंबूनदी इति ॥18॥
2.1.m: Shattering everywhere, they fall upon the back of the mountain; / and from its juice the river is renowned as the Jambūnada.

2.1.s:
sarittu vartate sāpi pīyate tatra vāsibhiḥ..
na khedo na ca daurgaṃdhyaṃ na jarā neṃdriyakṣayaḥ ..
utpannāḥ svacchamanaso narāstatra bhavanti vai ..19..
2.1.d:
सरित्तु वर्तते सापि पीयते तत्र वासिभिः॥
न खेदो न च दौर्गंध्यं न जरा नेंद्रियक्षयः ॥
उत्पन्नाः स्वच्छमनसो नरास्तत्र भवन्ति वै ॥19॥
2.1.m: That river indeed flows, and its water is drunk by the inhabitants there; / neither fatigue nor foul smell, nor old age nor decay of the senses / occurs for men born there; indeed, they become pure-minded.

2.1.s:
tīrasūtraṃ samaṃ prāpya vāyunā ca viśoṣitam ..
jāṃbūnadākhyaṃ bhavati suvarṇaṃ siddhabhūṣaṇam .. 2.1.4.20 ..
2.1.d:
तीरसूत्रं समं प्राप्य वायुना च विशोषितम् ॥
जांबूनदाख्यं भवति सुवर्णं सिद्धभूषणम् ॥ 2.1.4.20 ॥
2.1.m: Reaching the bank and dried by the wind, / it becomes the gold called jāmbūnada, an ornament for the Siddhas.

2.1.s:
bhadrāśvaḥ pārśvato meroḥ ketumālaśca paścime ..
varṣe dve tu muniśreṣṭhāstayormadhye ilāvṛtam .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
भद्राश्वः पार्श्वतो मेरोः केतुमालश्च पश्चिमे ॥
वर्षे द्वे तु मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तयोर्मध्ये इलावृतम् ॥ 21 ॥
2.1.m: Bhadrāśva is on the flank of Meru, and Ketumāla is on the west; / these are two continents, O best of sages, and between them lies Ilāvṛta.

2.1.s:
merorupari vipreṃdrā brahmaṇaḥ sthānamuttamam ..
tadūrdhve vāsavasthānaṃ tadūrdhve śaṃkarasya ca .. 22 ..
2.1.d:
मेरोरुपरि विप्रेंद्रा ब्रह्मणः स्थानमुत्तमम् ॥
तदूर्ध्वे वासवस्थानं तदूर्ध्वे शंकरस्य च ॥ 22 ॥
2.1.m: Above Meru, O foremost of Brahmins, is the supreme abode of Brahmā; / above that is the abode of Vāsava, and above that is that of Śaṅkara.

2.1.s:
tadūrdhvaṃ vaiṣṇavo loko dugārlokastadūrdhvataḥ ..
jyotirmayaṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ nirākāraṃ hiraṇmayam .. 23 ..
2.1.d:
तदूर्ध्वं वैष्णवो लोको दुगार्लोकस्तदूर्ध्वतः ॥
ज्योतिर्मयं परं स्थानं निराकारं हिरण्मयम् ॥ 23 ॥
2.1.m: Above that is the realm of Viṣṇu, and above that is the realm of Durgā, / the supreme abode full of light, formless, and golden.

2.1.s:
bhaktasthānaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ ca devo hi bhagavānraviḥ..
jyotiścakrasthitaḥ śuddho niścalaḥ parameśvaraḥ ..
rāśicakre ca bhramati merorupari sattamāḥ .. 24 ...
2.1.d:
भक्तस्थानं तदूर्ध्वं च देवो हि भगवान्रविः॥
ज्योतिश्चक्रस्थितः शुद्धो निश्चलः परमेश्वरः ॥
राशिचक्रे च भ्रमति मेरोरुपरि सत्तमाः ॥ 24 ॥।
2.1.m: And above that is the abode of the devotees, where the divine Lord Sun, / the pure, motionless, Supreme Lord, situated in the stellar wheel, / revolves in the wheel of the zodiac above Meru, O best of men.

2.1.s:
biṃbaṣaṭkedrinābhau ca rathacakraṃ divāniśam ..
vātarajjunibaṃdhena dhruvādhāre pratiṣṭhitam.. 25 ..
2.1.d:
बिंबषट्केद्रिनाभौ च रथचक्रं दिवानिशम् ॥
वातरज्जुनिबंधेन ध्रुवाधारे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥ 25 ॥
2.1.m: With six discs at the navel of the mountain, the chariot wheel day and night, / bound by cords of wind, is fixed upon the pivot of Dhruva.

2.1.s:
dikpālādyā grahāstatra dakṣiṇāduttarāyaṇam ..
pratimāsaṃ gataḥ paṃthā hrāsavṛddhidinakṣayaḥ .. 26 ..
2.1.d:
दिक्पालाद्या ग्रहास्तत्र दक्षिणादुत्तरायणम् ॥
प्रतिमासं गतः पंथा ह्रासवृद्धिदिनक्षयः ॥ 26 ॥
2.1.m: The planets, beginning with the guardians of the directions, move from south to northern course; / month by month the path proceeds with decrease, increase, and loss of day.

2.1.s:
raviṇā laṃghito māsaścāṃdraḥ khyāto malimlucaḥ ..
dvādaśe bhagavatsūrye pratyahaṃ bhaktasevake .. 27 ..
2.1.d:
रविणा लंघितो मासश्चांद्रः ख्यातो मलिम्लुचः ॥
द्वादशे भगवत्सूर्ये प्रत्यहं भक्तसेवके ॥ 27 ॥
2.1.m: A lunar month skipped by the sun is renowned as an intercalary month (malimluca), / while the divine Sun resides in the twelfth [sign], serving the devotees daily.

2.1.s:
kṛtvā triṣu tvahorātraṃ tārāmayagataṃ vibhum ..
yāmeyāme codayaśca deśedeśe ca śarvarī .. 28 ..
2.1.d:
कृत्वा त्रिषु त्वहोरात्रं तारामयगतं विभुम् ॥
यामेयामे चोदयश्च देशेदेशे च शर्वरी ॥ 28 ॥
2.1.m: Having divided the all-pervading [wheel] consisting of stars into day and night across three [watches], / there is sunrise in each watch and night in each land.

2.1.s:
divā carati yaḥ sūryo rātrau carati candramāḥ ..
nakṣatrāṇi divā rātrau sūryacakre pratiṣṭhitam..29..
2.1.d:
दिवा चरति यः सूर्यो रात्रौ चरति चन्द्रमाः ॥
नक्षत्राणि दिवा रात्रौ सूर्यचक्रे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥29॥
2.1.m: The sun moves by day, and the moon moves by night; / the lunar mansions are fixed day and night in the wheel of the sun.

2.1.s:
deśānnaṃ cāvagamanaṃ yatra tasmādivābhavat ..
yatra caṃdrakṣayo bhavati yatra sūryaḥ pravartate .. 2.1.4.30 ..
2.1.d:
देशान्नं चावगमनं यत्र तस्मादिवाभवत् ॥
यत्र चंद्रक्षयो भवति यत्र सूर्यः प्रवर्तते ॥ 2.1.4.30 ॥
2.1.m:
And departure from a region was as if from there,
where the waning of the moon occurs [and] where the sun sets forth.

2.1.s:
rātriṃdivaṃ vijānīyājjyotiścakre pratiṣṭhitam ..
udayāstamanaṃ nāsti nakṣatrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 31 ..
2.1.d:
रात्रिंदिवं विजानीयाज्ज्योतिश्चक्रे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
उदयास्तमनं नास्ति नक्षत्राणां विशेषतः ॥ 31 ॥
2.1.m:
One should know night and day as established in the wheel of heavenly bodies;
especially for the asterisms, there is no rising and setting.

2.1.s:
yannakṣatre ca yo deśaḥ sa teṣāmudayaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
tatrāsto jīvaśukrāṇāṃ sūryādīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ .. 32 ..
2.1.d:
यन्नक्षत्रे च यो देशः स तेषामुदयः स्मृतः ॥
तत्रास्तो जीवशुक्राणां सूर्यादीनां च सर्वशः ॥ 32 ॥
2.1.m:
Whatever region is under whatever asterism, that is considered their rising;
there occurs the setting of Jupiter, Venus, and of the sun and the rest in every way.

2.1.s:
tadā kāle niyoktavyā bhārgavāstādikī kriyā ..
sūryaḥ somo budhaścaṃdro bhārgavaścaiva śīghrakaḥ .. 33 ..
2.1.d:
तदा काले नियोक्तव्या भार्गवास्तादिकी क्रिया ॥
सूर्यः सोमो बुधश्चंद्रो भार्गवश्चैव शीघ्रकः ॥ 33 ॥
2.1.m:
At that time, rites such as those connected with the setting of Venus should be undertaken.
The sun, Moon, Mercury, Moon, and Venus are swift.

2.1.s:
dakṣiṇāyanamāsthāya yadā carati raśmimān ..
tadā sarvagrahāṇāṃ sa sūryodhastātprasarpati .. 34 ..
2.1.d:
दक्षिणायनमास्थाय यदा चरति रश्मिमान् ॥
तदा सर्वग्रहाणां स सूर्योधस्तात्प्रसर्पति ॥ 34 ॥
2.1.m:
When the sun, possessing rays, moves taking resort in the southern solstice,
then he glides below all the planets.

2.1.s:
vistīrṇamaṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā tasyordhve carate śaśī ..
nakṣatramaṃḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ somādūrdhvaṃ prasarpati .. .. 35 ..
2.1.d:
विस्तीर्णमंडलं कृत्वा तस्योर्ध्वे चरते शशी ॥
नक्षत्रमंडलं कृत्स्नं सोमादूर्ध्वं प्रसर्पति ॥ ॥ 35 ॥
2.1.m:
Having made an extensive orb, the moon moves above him;
the entire orb of asterisms glides above the Moon.

2.1.s:
nakṣatrebhyo budhaścordhvaṃ budhādūrdhvaṃ tu bhārgavaḥ ..
candrastu bhārgavādūrdhvaṃ caṃdrādūrdhvaṃ śanaiścaraḥ .. 36 ..
2.1.d:
नक्षत्रेभ्यो बुधश्चोर्ध्वं बुधादूर्ध्वं तु भार्गवः ॥
चन्द्रस्तु भार्गवादूर्ध्वं चंद्रादूर्ध्वं शनैश्चरः ॥ 36 ॥
2.1.m:
Mercury is above the asterisms, and Venus is above Mercury;
Mars is above Venus, and Saturn is above Mars.

2.1.s:
tasmācchanaiścarādūrdhvaṃ tataḥ saptarṣimaṃḍalam ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva saptānāṃ dhruvaścordhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ .. 37 ..
2.1.d:
तस्माच्छनैश्चरादूर्ध्वं ततः सप्तर्षिमंडलम् ॥
ऋषीणां चैव सप्तानां ध्रुवश्चोर्ध्वं व्यवस्थितः ॥ 37 ॥
2.1.m:
Above that Saturn is the realm of the Seven Sages;
and above the seven sages, Dhruva is stationed.

2.1.s:
kālacakramaye cakre sūryo bhavati sarvadā ..
rāśyardedheṣu gatiryatra tithīnāṃ ca tithau smṛtā .. 38 ..
2.1.d:
कालचक्रमये चक्रे सूर्यो भवति सर्वदा ॥
राश्यर्देधेषु गतिर्यत्र तिथीनां च तिथौ स्मृता ॥ 38 ॥
2.1.m:
The sun is always in the wheel consisting of the wheel of time,
where movement is remembered in half-signs, and of lunar days on a lunar day.

2.1.s:
staṃbhate carate śīghraṃ hrāse cāpi dinakṣayaḥ ..
pādāstaṃ cāpi śukrasya mahāstaṃ tatra dṛśyate .. 39 ..
2.1.d:
स्तंभते चरते शीघ्रं ह्रासे चापि दिनक्षयः ॥
पादास्तं चापि शुक्रस्य महास्तं तत्र दृश्यते ॥ 39 ॥
2.1.m:
It stands motionless [or] moves swiftly, and during waning there is loss of a day;
and the partial setting of Venus and the great setting are seen there.

2.1.s:
pādāste pakṣamātraṃ syānmahāste yāmamātrakam ..
cakre pakṣārdhamāsaḥ syādaticāro'ṣṭavāsarān .. 2.1.4.40 ..
2.1.d:
पादास्ते पक्षमात्रं स्यान्महास्ते याममात्रकम् ॥
चक्रे पक्षार्धमासः स्यादतिचारोऽष्टवासरान् ॥ 2.1.4.40 ॥
2.1.m:
In a partial setting there would be only a fortnight; in a great setting, only a watch of the day.
In the wheel it would be half a fortnight to a month; an acceleration of transit lasts eight days.

2.1.s:
na gaṇyate deśabhede nakṣatreṇa ca gaṇyate ..
bāla vṛddhastu śukrasya deśasthe vā gaṇasya ca .. 41 ..
2.1.d:
न गण्यते देशभेदे नक्षत्रेण च गण्यते ॥
बाल वृद्धस्तु शुक्रस्य देशस्थे वा गणस्य च ॥ 41 ॥
2.1.m:
It is not reckoned by difference of region, but is reckoned by asterism.
Whether the youth or old age of Venus resides in a region or in a group,

2.1.s:
bālyavārddhye kṣatriyasya na gaṇyete sadā budhaiḥ ..
pādādūrdhvaṃ mahāstasya vaiśyasya dvijasa ttamāḥ .. 42 ..
2.1.d:
बाल्यवार्द्ध्ये क्षत्रियस्य न गण्येते सदा बुधैः ॥
पादादूर्ध्वं महास्तस्य वैश्यस्य द्विजस त्तमाः ॥ 42 ॥
2.1.m:
the youth and old age [of Venus] are never reckoned by the wise for a kṣatriya.
Beyond a quarter is the great setting for a vaiśya, O best of the twice-born;

2.1.s:
śeṣārdhaṃ bhārgavāstasya śūdrāṇāmatha garhitam ..
abhicāre ca cakre ca na śūdrasya vidhīyate .. 43 ..
2.1.d:
शेषार्धं भार्गवास्तस्य शूद्राणामथ गर्हितम् ॥
अभिचारे च चक्रे च न शूद्रस्य विधीयते ॥ 43 ॥
2.1.m:
the remaining half of the setting of Venus is prohibited for śūdras.
And in sorcery and in the wheel, nothing is prescribed for a śūdra.

2.1.s:
varjayedvāsarānsapta iti cātharvaṇī śrutiḥ .. 44 ..
karmānusāravyaktinirdhāraṇavarṇanam
2.1.d:
वर्जयेद्वासरान्सप्त इति चाथर्वणी श्रुतिः ॥ 44 ॥
कर्मानुसारव्यक्तिनिर्धारणवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
One should avoid seven days; thus says the Atharvanic scripture.
Description of the determination of individuals according to their actions.

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
trayāṇāmeva varṇānāṃ janmato brāhmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ..
saṃsṛṣṭā brāhmaṇāḥ pūrvaṃ tapastaptvā dvijottamāḥ .. 1 ..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
त्रयाणामेव वर्णानां जन्मतो ब्राह्मणः प्रभुः ॥
संसृष्टा ब्राह्मणाः पूर्वं तपस्तप्त्वा द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 1 ॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / A brāhmaṇa is, by birth alone, the lord of the three social classes. / Brāhmaṇas were created first, having performed austerities, O best of the twice-born,

2.1.s:
havyānāmiha kavyānāṃ sarvasyāpi ca guptaye ..
aśnaṃti ca mukhenāsya havyāni tridivaukasaḥ .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
हव्यानामिह कव्यानां सर्वस्यापि च गुप्तये ॥
अश्नंति च मुखेनास्य हव्यानि त्रिदिवौकसः ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: for the protection here of oblations to gods, oblations to ancestors, and of everything. / And through his mouth, the dwellers of heaven eat the oblations to gods,

2.1.s:
kavyāni caiva pitaraḥ kiṃ bhūtamadhikaṃ tataḥ ..
janmanā cottamo'yaṃ ca sarvārcā brāhmaṇo'rhati .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
कव्यानि चैव पितरः किं भूतमधिकं ततः ॥
जन्मना चोत्तमोऽयं च सर्वार्चा ब्राह्मणोऽर्हति ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: and the ancestors [eat] the oblations to ancestors. What being is greater than that? / And he is highest by birth; a brāhmaṇa is worthy of all worship.

2.1.s:
svakīyaṃ brāhmaṇo bhuṃkte vidadhāti dvijottamāḥ ..
trayāṇāmiha varṇānāṃ bhāvābhāvāya vai dvijaḥ .. 4..
2.1.d:
स्वकीयं ब्राह्मणो भुंक्ते विदधाति द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
त्रयाणामिह वर्णानां भावाभावाय वै द्विजः ॥ 4॥
2.1.m: A brāhmaṇa eats what is his own, [and] dispenses it, O best of the twice-born. / Indeed, the twice-born exists for the prosperity or ruin of the three social classes here.

2.1.s:
bhavedvipro na saṃdehastuṣṭo bhāvāya vai bhavet ..
abhāvāya bhavetkruddhastasmātpūjyaḥ sadā hi saḥ .. 5 ..
2.1.d:
भवेद्विप्रो न संदेहस्तुष्टो भावाय वै भवेत् ॥
अभावाय भवेत्क्रुद्धस्तस्मात्पूज्यः सदा हि सः ॥ 5 ॥
2.1.m: A vipra would be—there is no doubt—for prosperity when pleased; / when angered, he would be for ruin; therefore, he is always to be worshipped.

2.1.s:
garbhādhānādayaśceha saṃskārā yasya sattamāḥ ..
catvāriṃśattathā cāṣṭau nirvṛttāḥ śāstrato dvijāḥ ...
sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ brāhmaṇatvena saṃyutaḥ .. 6 ..
2.1.d:
गर्भाधानादयश्चेह संस्कारा यस्य सत्तमाः ॥
चत्वारिंशत्तथा चाष्टौ निर्वृत्ताः शास्त्रतो द्विजाः ॥।
स याति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं ब्राह्मणत्वेन संयुतः ॥ 6 ॥
2.1.m: The twice-born for whom the forty-eight life-cycle rituals, / beginning with the rite of impregnation, have been performed in accordance with the scriptures, O virtuous ones, / he goes to the realm of Brahmā, endowed with the nature of a brāhmaṇa.

2.1.s:
saṃskārapūtaḥ prathamo vedapūto dvitīyakaḥ ..
vidyāpūtastṛtīyaḥ syāttīrthapūtastvanaṃtaram .. 7 ..
2.1.d:
संस्कारपूतः प्रथमो वेदपूतो द्वितीयकः ॥
विद्यापूतस्तृतीयः स्यात्तीर्थपूतस्त्वनंतरम् ॥ 7 ॥
2.1.m: The first is purified by life-cycle rituals; the second is purified by the Veda; / the third would be purified by learning; and next, purified by sacred places.

2.1.s:
kṣetrapūtaṃ pravijñāya vipūtaṃ pūjayeddvijāḥ ..
svargāpavargaphaladamanyathā śramatāmiyāta .. . 8 ..
2.1.d:
क्षेत्रपूतं प्रविज्ञाय विपूतं पूजयेद्द्विजाः ॥
स्वर्गापवर्गफलदमन्यथा श्रमतामियात ॥ । 8 ॥
2.1.m: Having recognized one purified by sacred fields [or] exceptionally purified, one should worship him, O twice-born; / it yields the fruit of heaven and liberation; otherwise, it would lead only to weariness.

2.1.s:
pūtānāṃ paramaḥ pūto gurūṇāṃ paramo guruḥ ..
sarvasattvānvitā vipro nirmito brahmaṇā purā .. 9 ..
2.1.d:
पूतानां परमः पूतो गुरूणां परमो गुरुः ॥
सर्वसत्त्वान्विता विप्रो निर्मितो ब्रह्मणा पुरा ॥ 9 ॥
2.1.m: The purest among the pure, the supreme guru among gurus, / endowed with all goodness, the vipra was fashioned by Brahmā in ancient times.

2.1.s:
pūjayitvā dvijāndevāḥ svargaṃ bhuñjaṃti cākṣayam..
manuṣyāścāpi devatvaṃ svaṃsvaṃ rājyaṃ gatena saḥ .. 2.1.5.10 ..
2.1.d:
पूजयित्वा द्विजान्देवाः स्वर्गं भुञ्जंति चाक्षयम्॥
मनुष्याश्चापि देवत्वं स्वंस्वं राज्यं गतेन सः ॥ 2.1.5.10 ॥
2.1.m: Having worshipped the twice-born, the gods enjoy imperishable heaven, / and men also [attain] godhood, having attained their respective kingdoms.

2.1.s:
yasya viprāḥ prasīdaṃti tasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati ..
tasmādbrāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ viṣṇustuṣyati tatkṣaṇāt .. 11 ..
2.1.d:
यस्य विप्राः प्रसीदंति तस्य विष्णुः प्रसीदति ॥
तस्माद्ब्राह्मणपूजायां विष्णुस्तुष्यति तत्क्षणात् ॥ 11 ॥
2.1.m: He with whom the vipras are pleased, with him Viṣṇu is pleased; / therefore, at the worship of a brāhmaṇa, Viṣṇu is delighted that very instant.

2.1.s:
yasmādviṣṇumukhādvipraḥ samudbhūtaḥ purā dvijāḥ ..
vedāstatraiva saṃjātāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārahetavaḥ .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
यस्माद्विष्णुमुखाद्विप्रः समुद्भूतः पुरा द्विजाः ॥
वेदास्तत्रैव संजाताः सृष्टिसंहारहेतवः ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: Because in ancient times the vipra arose from the mouth of Viṣṇu, O twice-born, / right there were produced the Vedas, the causes of creation and dissolution.

2.1.s:
tasmādvipramukhe vedāścārpitāḥ puruṣeṇa hi ..
pūjārthaṃ brahmalokānāṃ sarvajñānārthato dhruvam .. 13 ..
2.1.d:
तस्माद्विप्रमुखे वेदाश्चार्पिताः पुरुषेण हि ॥
पूजार्थं ब्रह्मलोकानां सर्वज्ञानार्थतो ध्रुवम् ॥ 13 ॥
2.1.m: Therefore the Vedas were indeed placed in the mouth of the vipra by the Supreme Person / for the sake of the worship of the realms of Brahmā, surely for the sake of all knowledge.

2.1.s:
pitṛyajñavivāheṣu vahnikāryeṣu śāṃtiṣu ..
praśastā brāhmaṇā nityaṃ sarvasvastyayaneṣu ca .. 14 ..
2.1.d:
पितृयज्ञविवाहेषु वह्निकार्येषु शांतिषु ॥
प्रशस्ता ब्राह्मणा नित्यं सर्वस्वस्त्ययनेषु च ॥ 14 ॥
2.1.m: In sacrifices to ancestors, marriages, fire rituals, and rites of pacification, / brāhmaṇas are always commended, and in all rites for well-being.

2.1.s:
devā bhuñjaṃti havyāni baliṃ pretādayo'surāḥ ..
pitaro havyakavyāni viprasyaiva mukhād dhruvam .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
देवा भुञ्जंति हव्यानि बलिं प्रेतादयोऽसुराः ॥
पितरो हव्यकव्यानि विप्रस्यैव मुखाद् ध्रुवम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: The gods eat oblations to gods, the pretas, asuras, and others eat the offering, / and the ancestors surely eat the oblations to gods and ancestors from the very mouth of the vipra.

2.1.s:
devebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca yo dadayādyajñakarmasu ..
dānaṃ homaṃ baliṃ caiva vinā vipreṇa niṣphalam .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्यश्च यो ददयाद्यज्ञकर्मसु ॥
दानं होमं बलिं चैव विना विप्रेण निष्फलम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: Whoever would give to the gods and to the ancestors in sacrificial rites— / gift, fire oblation, and offering are fruitless without a vipra.

2.1.s:
vinā vipraṃ ca yo dharmaḥ prayāsaphalamātrakaḥ ..
bhuñjate cāsurāstatra pretā bhūtāśca rākṣasāḥ .. 17 ..
2.1.d:
विना विप्रं च यो धर्मः प्रयासफलमात्रकः ॥
भुञ्जते चासुरास्तत्र प्रेता भूताश्च राक्षसाः ॥ 17 ॥
2.1.m: And whatever religious duty is performed without a vipra bears only the fruit of fatigue; / and there the asuras, pretas, ghosts, and rākṣasas consume it.

2.1.s:
tasmādbrāhmaṇamāhūya tasya pūjāṃ ca kārayet ..
kāle deśe ca pātre ca lakṣakoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 18 ..
2.1.d:
तस्माद्ब्राह्मणमाहूय तस्य पूजां च कारयेत् ॥
काले देशे च पात्रे च लक्षकोटिगुणं भवेत् ॥ 18 ॥
2.1.m: Therefore, having summoned a brāhmaṇa, one should have him worshipped. / In the [right] time, place, and worthy recipient, it becomes multiplied a hundred-thousand- or ten-million-fold.

2.1.s:
śraddhayā ca dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā prakuryādabhivādanam..
dīrghāyustasya vākyena ciraṃjīvī bhavennaraḥ .. 19 ..
2.1.d:
श्रद्धया च द्विजं दृष्ट्वा प्रकुर्यादभिवादनम्॥
दीर्घायुस्तस्य वाक्येन चिरंजीवी भवेन्नरः ॥ 19 ॥
2.1.m: And seeing a twice-born with faith, one should offer salutation; / by his word, a man becomes long-lived, living for a long time.

2.1.s:
anabhivādināṃ vipre dveṣādaśraddhayāpi ca ...
āyuḥ kṣīṇaṃ bhavetpuṃsāṃ bhūmināśaśca durgatiḥ .. 2.1.5.20 ..
2.1.d:
अनभिवादिनां विप्रे द्वेषादश्रद्धयापि च ॥।
आयुः क्षीणं भवेत्पुंसां भूमिनाशश्च दुर्गतिः ॥ 2.1.5.20 ॥
2.1.m: For those who do not salute a vipra out of hatred or lack of faith, / the lifespan of those men is diminished, and there is loss of land and misfortune.

2.1.s:
āyurvṛddhiryaśorvṛddhirvṛddhirvidyādhanasya ca ..
pūjayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhānbhavennāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ... .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
आयुर्वृद्धिर्यशोर्वृद्धिर्वृद्धिर्विद्याधनस्य च ॥
पूजयित्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठान्भवेन्नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥॥। 21 ॥
2.1.m: Increase of lifespan, increase of fame, and increase of learning and wealth / will occur upon worshipping the best of the twice-born; there is no doubt about this.

2.1.s:
na viprapādodakakardamāni na vedaśāstrapratigarjitāni ..
svāhāsvadhāsvastivivarjitāni śmaśānatulyāni gṛhāṇi tāni .. 22 ..
2.1.d:
न विप्रपादोदककर्दमानि न वेदशास्त्रप्रतिगर्जितानि ॥
स्वाहास्वधास्वस्तिविवर्जितानि श्मशानतुल्यानि गृहाणि तानि ॥ 22 ॥
2.1.m: Those houses that lack the mud made by the water from the feet of vipras, that lack the resounding of the Vedas and treatises, / and that are devoid of svāhā, svadhā, and svasti, are equal to cremation grounds.

2.1.s:
ṣadviṃśatidoṣamāhurnarā narakabhīravaḥ ..
vimucyaiva vasettīrthe grāme vā pattane vane .. 23 ..
2.1.d:
षद्विंशतिदोषमाहुर्नरा नरकभीरवः ॥
विमुच्यैव वसेत्तीर्थे ग्रामे वा पत्तने वने ॥ 23 ॥
2.1.m: Men who fear hell mention twenty-six defects. / Only having abandoned them should one dwell in a sacred place, a village, a town, or a forest.

2.1.s: te svarge pitṛloke ca brahmalokeṣvavasthitāḥ .. 24 ..
2.1.d: ते स्वर्गे पितृलोके च ब्रह्मलोकेष्ववस्थिताः ॥ 24 ॥
2.1.m: They abide in heaven, in the realm of the ancestors, and in the realms of Brahmā.

2.1.s:
anyathā na vasedvāsastasmātsteyī na pālayet ..
adharmo viṣamaścaiva paśuśca piśunastathā .. 25 ..
2.1.d:
अन्यथा न वसेद्वासस्तस्मात्स्तेयी न पालयेत् ॥
अधर्मो विषमश्चैव पशुश्च पिशुनस्तथा ॥ 25 ॥
2.1.m: Otherwise one must not take up residence; therefore, a thief should not be maintained. / Unrighteous, dishonest, brutish, and slanderous,

2.1.s:
pāpiṣṭho naṣṭakaṣṭau ca ruṣṭo duṣṭaśca muktakaḥ ...
hṛṣṭaḥ kuṇṭhaśca andhaśca kāṇaścaiva tathāparaḥ .. 26 ..
2.1.d:
पापिष्ठो नष्टकष्टौ च रुष्टो दुष्टश्च मुक्तकः ॥।
हृष्टः कुण्ठश्च अन्धश्च काणश्चैव तथापरः ॥ 26 ॥
2.1.m: most sinful, ruined and distressed, angry, wicked, uninhibited, / insolent, blunt, blind, and one-eyed, and likewise another:

2.1.s:
caṇḍaḥ khaṇḍaśca vaktā ca dattasyāpaharastathā ..
nīcaḥ khalaśca vācālaḥ kadaryaścapala stathā .. 27 ..
2.1.d:
चण्डः खण्डश्च वक्ता च दत्तस्यापहरस्तथा ॥
नीचः खलश्च वाचालः कदर्यश्चपल स्तथा ॥ 27 ॥
2.1.m: violent, mutilated, a [mere] talker, and a snatcher of what was given, / base, vile, talkative, miserly, and fickle.

2.1.s:
malīmasaśca te doṣāḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiramī matāḥ ..
eteṣāṃ cāpi viprendrāḥ pañcāśītirnigadyate .. 28 ..
2.1.d:
मलीमसश्च ते दोषाः षड्विंशतिरमी मताः ॥
एतेषां चापि विप्रेन्द्राः पञ्चाशीतिर्निगद्यते ॥ 28 ॥
2.1.m: And the soiled: these defects are considered twenty-six. / And of these, O best of Brahmins, eighty-five [subdivisions] are declared.

2.1.s:
śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijaśārdūlāḥ śāstresminbruvataḥ kramāt ..
adhamo'tra tridhāvidyādviṣamaḥ syādvidhocitaḥ ..29..
2.1.d:
शृणुध्वं द्विजशार्दूलाः शास्त्रेस्मिन्ब्रुवतः क्रमात् ॥
अधमोऽत्र त्रिधाविद्याद्विषमः स्याद्विधोचितः ॥29॥
2.1.m: Listen, O tigers among the twice-born, as I speak of them in order in this scripture: / here, the base is to be known as threefold; the discordant is properly of two kinds.

2.1.s:
paśuścaturvidhaścaiva kṛpaṇopi hi vai dvidhā ..
dvidhāthāpi ca pāpiṣṭho naṣṭaḥ saptavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2.1.5.30 ..
2.1.d:
पशुश्चतुर्विधश्चैव कृपणोपि हि वै द्विधा ॥
द्विधाथापि च पापिष्ठो नष्टः सप्तविधः स्मृतः ॥ 2.1.5.30 ॥
2.1.m: The beast is of four kinds, and the miser is indeed of two kinds; / likewise the most wicked is of two kinds, and the depraved is remembered as sevenfold.

2.1.s:
kaṣṭaḥ syātpañcadhā jñeyo ruṣṭopi syāddvidhā ddvijāḥ ..
duṣṭaḥ syātṣaḍvidho jñeyaḥ puṣṭaścaiva bhaveddvidhā 31 ..
2.1.d:
कष्टः स्यात्पञ्चधा ज्ञेयो रुष्टोपि स्याद्द्विधा द्द्विजाः ॥
दुष्टः स्यात्षड्विधो ज्ञेयः पुष्टश्चैव भवेद्द्विधा 31 ॥
2.1.m: The wretched is known as fivefold, and the enraged is of two kinds, O Brahmins; / the vicious is to be known as sixfold, and the overfed is of two kinds.

2.1.s:
hṛṣṭaścāṣṭavidhaḥ proktaḥ kuṇṭhaścaiva tridhoditaḥ ..
andhaḥ kāṇaśca tau dvau dvau syādvai ca saguṇo'guṇaḥ .. 32 ..
2.1.d:
हृष्टश्चाष्टविधः प्रोक्तः कुण्ठश्चैव त्रिधोदितः ॥
अन्धः काणश्च तौ द्वौ द्वौ स्याद्वै च सगुणोऽगुणः ॥ 32 ॥
2.1.m: The elated is declared to be of eight kinds, and the dull is spoken of as threefold; / the blind and the one-eyed are two each; they can be with virtues or without virtues.

2.1.s:
dvau caṇḍau capalaścaikāvaṇḍacaṇḍo dvigurbhavet ..
daṇḍapaṇḍau tathā jñeyau khalanīcau caturdvayam .. 33 ..
2.1.d:
द्वौ चण्डौ चपलश्चैकावण्डचण्डो द्विगुर्भवेत् ॥
दण्डपण्डौ तथा ज्ञेयौ खलनीचौ चतुर्द्वयम् ॥ 33 ॥
2.1.m: There are two fierce ones, one fickle; the castration-violent is twofold; / the punishing and the eunuch are likewise to be known; the rogue and the base are twice four.

2.1.s:
vācālaśca kadaryaśca kramāttribhirudāhṛtaḥ ..
kadaryaścapalaścaiva tathā jñeyo malīmasaḥ .. 34 ..
2.1.d:
वाचालश्च कदर्यश्च क्रमात्त्रिभिरुदाहृतः ॥
कदर्यश्चपलश्चैव तथा ज्ञेयो मलीमसः ॥ 34 ॥
2.1.m: The talkative and the stingy are described in order by threes; / likewise the stingy and the fickle, and also the soiled is to be known.

2.1.s:
dvāvekau caturaścaiva steyī caikavidho bhavet ..
pṛthaglakṣaṇameteṣāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 35 ..
2.1.d:
द्वावेकौ चतुरश्चैव स्तेयी चैकविधो भवेत् ॥
पृथग्लक्षणमेतेषां शृणुध्वं द्विजसत्तमाः ॥ 35 ॥
2.1.m: Two, one, and four; and the thief is of one kind. / Hear their individual definitions, O best of the twice-born,

2.1.s:
samyagyasya parijñānaṃ naro devatvamāpnuyāt ..
upānacchatradhārī ca gurudevāgrataścaran .. 36 ..
2.1.d:
सम्यग्यस्य परिज्ञानं नरो देवत्वमाप्नुयात् ॥
उपानच्छत्रधारी च गुरुदेवाग्रतश्चरन् ॥ 36 ॥
2.1.m: by complete knowledge of which a man attains godhood. / One who wears sandals and holds an umbrella while walking in front of guru and deity,

2.1.s:
uccāsanaṃ guroragre tīrthayātrāṃ karoti yaḥ ..
yānamāruhya viprendrāḥ sopyekatrādhamo mataḥ .. 37 ..
2.1.d:
उच्चासनं गुरोरग्रे तीर्थयात्रां करोति यः ॥
यानमारुह्य विप्रेन्द्राः सोप्येकत्राधमो मतः ॥ 37 ॥
2.1.m: and one who takes a higher seat before the guru, or undertakes a pilgrimage / riding in a vehicle, O best of Brahmins, he is regarded in one category as base.

2.1.s:
nimajjya tīrthe vidhivadgrāmyadharmeṇa vartayan ..
dvitīyaścādhamaḥ prokto niṃditaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 38 ..
2.1.d:
निमज्ज्य तीर्थे विधिवद्ग्राम्यधर्मेण वर्तयन् ॥
द्वितीयश्चाधमः प्रोक्तो निंदितः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 38 ॥
2.1.m: One who bathes properly in a sacred bathing-place but lives according to vulgar carnal ways / is declared the second base person, proclaimed as censured.

2.1.s:
vācaiva madhurā ślakṣṇā hṛdi hālāhalaṃ viṣam ..
vadatyanyatkarotyanyaddvāvetau viṣamau smṛtā .. 39 ..
2.1.d:
वाचैव मधुरा श्लक्ष्णा हृदि हालाहलं विषम् ॥
वदत्यन्यत्करोत्यन्यद्द्वावेतौ विषमौ स्मृता ॥ 39 ॥
2.1.m: Whose speech alone is sweet and smooth, while in the heart is hālāhala poison, / who says one thing and does another—these two are remembered as discordant.

2.1.s:
mokṣacintāmatikramya yo'nyacintāpariśramaḥ ..
harisevā vihīno yaḥ sa paśuryonitaḥ paśuḥ ..2.1.5.40..
2.1.d:
मोक्षचिन्तामतिक्रम्य योऽन्यचिन्तापरिश्रमः ॥
हरिसेवा विहीनो यः स पशुर्योनितः पशुः ॥2.1.5.40॥
2.1.m: Setting aside contemplation of liberation, he who exerts himself in other concerns, / and who is devoid of devotion to Hari: he is a beast by nature, an animal in birth.

2.1.s:
prayāge vidyamāne'pi yo'nyatra snānamācaret ..
dṛṣṭaṃ devaṃ parityajya adṛṣṭaṃ bhajate tu yaḥ ..41..
2.1.d:
प्रयागे विद्यमानेऽपि योऽन्यत्र स्नानमाचरेत् ॥
दृष्टं देवं परित्यज्य अदृष्टं भजते तु यः ॥41॥
2.1.m: Even while Prayāga exists, he who bathes elsewhere; / abandoning a visible god, he who worships an unseen one,

2.1.s:
āyuṣastu kṣayārthāya śāstreyamṛṣisaṃmataḥ ..
yogābhyāsaṃ tato hitvā tṛtīyaścādhamaḥ paśuḥ .. 42 ..
2.1.d:
आयुषस्तु क्षयार्थाय शास्त्रेयमृषिसंमतः ॥
योगाभ्यासं ततो हित्वा तृतीयश्चाधमः पशुः ॥ 42 ॥
2.1.m: for the sake of the destruction of life; this is approved by the ṛṣis in scripture; / then, having abandoned the practice of yoga, he is the third base beast.

2.1.s:
bahūni pustakānīha śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca ..
tasya sāraṃ na jānāti sa eva jaṃbukaḥ paśuḥ.. 43 ..
2.1.d:
बहूनि पुस्तकानीह शास्त्राणि विविधानि च ॥
तस्य सारं न जानाति स एव जंबुकः पशुः॥ 43 ॥
2.1.m: There are many books and various scriptures here; / he who does not understand their essence is indeed a jackal, a beast.

2.1.s:
balena cchalachadmena upāyena prabaṃdhanam ..
so'pi syātpiśunaḥ khyātaḥ praṇayādvā dvitīyakaḥ .. 44 ..
2.1.d:
बलेन च्छलछद्मेन उपायेन प्रबंधनम् ॥
सोऽपि स्यात्पिशुनः ख्यातः प्रणयाद्वा द्वितीयकः ॥ 44 ॥
2.1.m: Binding [another] by force, deceit, trickery, or contrivance, / he is known as malicious, or a second [type] out of affection.

2.1.s:
madhurānnaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya daive pitrye ca karmaṇi ..
mlānaṃ cāpi ca tiktānnaṃ yaḥ prayacchati durmatiḥ .. 45 ..
2.1.d:
मधुरान्नं प्रतिष्ठाप्य दैवे पित्र्ये च कर्मणि ॥
म्लानं चापि च तिक्तान्नं यः प्रयच्छति दुर्मतिः ॥ 45 ॥
2.1.m: Having arranged sweet food in rites for the gods and the ancestors, / the evil-minded one who offers stale and bitter food instead:

2.1.s:
kṛpaṇaḥ sa tu vijñeyo na svargī na ca mokṣabhāk ..
kudātā ca mudā hīnaḥ sakrodhastu yajeta yaḥ .. 46 ..
2.1.d:
कृपणः स तु विज्ञेयो न स्वर्गी न च मोक्षभाक् ॥
कुदाता च मुदा हीनः सक्रोधस्तु यजेत यः ॥ 46 ॥
2.1.m: he should be known as a miser, possessing neither heaven nor liberation. / A bad giver, lacking joy, who sacrifices with anger:

2.1.s:
sa eva kṛpaṇaḥ khyātaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ ..
adoṣeṇa śubhatyāgī śubhakāryopavikrayī .. 47 ..
2.1.d:
स एव कृपणः ख्यातः सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृतः ॥
अदोषेण शुभत्यागी शुभकार्योपविक्रयी ॥ 47 ॥
2.1.m: he alone is known as a miser, cast out from all duty. / One who abandons an auspicious person without fault, one who sells auspicious acts,

2.1.s:
pitṛmātṛgurutyāgī śaucācāravivarjitaḥ ..
pitroragre samaśnāti sa pāpiṣṭhatamaḥ smṛtaḥ ..48 ..
2.1.d:
पितृमातृगुरुत्यागी शौचाचारविवर्जितः ॥
पित्रोरग्रे समश्नाति स पापिष्ठतमः स्मृतः ॥48 ॥
2.1.m: one who abandons father, mother, and guru, one devoid of purity and conduct, / one who eats before his parents—he is remembered as most wicked.

2.1.s:
jīvatpitṛparityaktaṃ sutaṃ sevanna vā kvacit ..
dvitīyastu sa pāpiṣṭho homalopī tṛtīyakaḥ .. 49 ..
2.1.d:
जीवत्पितृपरित्यक्तं सुतं सेवन्न वा क्वचित् ॥
द्वितीयस्तु स पापिष्ठो होमलोपी तृतीयकः ॥ 49 ॥
2.1.m: Serving a son abandoned while the father is alive, or not at any time, / he is the second most wicked; the third is one who neglects the fire-offering.

2.1.s:
sādhvācāraṃ ca pracchāya sevanaṃ cāpi darśayet ..
sa naṣṭa iti vijñeyaḥ krayakrītaṃ ca maithunam .. 2.1.5.50 ..
2.1.d:
साध्वाचारं च प्रच्छाय सेवनं चापि दर्शयेत् ॥
स नष्ट इति विज्ञेयः क्रयक्रीतं च मैथुनम् ॥ 2.1.5.50 ॥
2.1.m: Concealing righteous conduct and merely displaying service, / he should be known as depraved; and [one who engages in] sexual union bought for a price,

2.1.s:
jīveddevalavṛttiryaḥ bhāryāvipaṇajīvakaḥ ..
kanyāśulkena jīvedvā strīdhanena ca vā kvacit .. 51 ..
2.1.d:
जीवेद्देवलवृत्तिर्यः भार्याविपणजीवकः ॥
कन्याशुल्केन जीवेद्वा स्त्रीधनेन च वा क्वचित् ॥ 51 ॥
2.1.m: one who lives by the livelihood of a temple priest, one who lives off the trafficking of his wife, / or one who lives off a maiden's bride-price, or off a woman's wealth at any time:

2.1.s:
ṣaḍeva naṣṭāḥ śāstre ca na svargamokṣabhāginaḥ ..
sadā kruddhaṃ mano yasya hīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā prakopavān .. 52 ..
2.1.d:
षडेव नष्टाः शास्त्रे च न स्वर्गमोक्षभागिनः ॥
सदा क्रुद्धं मनो यस्य हीनं दृष्ट्वा प्रकोपवान् ॥ 52 ॥
2.1.m: these six alone are depraved in scripture, having no share in heaven or liberation. / One whose mind is ever angry, who becomes enraged upon seeing an inferior,

2.1.s:
bhrukuṭīkuṭilaḥ kruddho ruṣṭaḥ paṃcavidhoditaḥ ..
akārye bhramate nityaṃ dharmārthe na vyavasthitaḥ .. 53 ..
2.1.d:
भ्रुकुटीकुटिलः क्रुद्धो रुष्टः पंचविधोदितः ॥
अकार्ये भ्रमते नित्यं धर्मार्थे न व्यवस्थितः ॥ 53 ॥
2.1.m: crooked with knit brows, angry—the enraged is declared fivefold. / One who constantly wanders in improper deeds, not established in righteousness and wealth,

2.1.s:
nidrālurvyasanāsakto madyapaḥ srtrīniṣevakaḥ ..
duṣṭaiḥ saha sadālāpaḥ sa duṣṭaḥ saptadhā smṛtaḥ ..54 ..
2.1.d:
निद्रालुर्व्यसनासक्तो मद्यपः स्र्त्रीनिषेवकः ॥
दुष्टैः सह सदालापः स दुष्टः सप्तधा स्मृतः ॥54 ॥
2.1.m: slothful, addicted to vices, a drinker of liquor, one given over to women, / always conversing with the wicked—that vicious person is remembered as sevenfold.

2.1.s:
ekākī miṣṭamaśnāti vaṃcakaḥ sādhuniṃdakaḥ ..
yathā sūkaraḥ puṣṭaḥ syāttathā puṣṭaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 95 ..
2.1.d:
एकाकी मिष्टमश्नाति वंचकः साधुनिंदकः ॥
यथा सूकरः पुष्टः स्यात्तथा पुष्टः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 95 ॥
2.1.m: One who eats sweet food alone, a deceiver, a reviler of the virtuous— / just as a pig is fattened, so is such an overfed one proclaimed.

2.1.s:
nigamāgamataṃtrāṇi nādhyāpayati yo dvijaḥ..
na śṛṇoti ca pāpātmā sa duṣṭa iti cocyate .. 56 ..
2.1.d:
निगमागमतंत्राणि नाध्यापयति यो द्विजः॥
न शृणोति च पापात्मा स दुष्ट इति चोच्यते ॥ 56 ॥
2.1.m: The Brahmin who does not teach the Vedic scriptures, the Āgamas, and the Tantras, / nor listens [to them], that evil-minded one is called vicious.

2.1.s:
śrutiḥ smṛtiśca viprāṇāṃ nayane dve vinirmite ..
ekena vikalaḥ kāṇo dvābhyāmaṃdhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 57 ..
2.1.d:
श्रुतिः स्मृतिश्च विप्राणां नयने द्वे विनिर्मिते ॥
एकेन विकलः काणो द्वाभ्यामंधः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 57 ॥
2.1.m: Śruti and Smṛti are fashioned as the two eyes of Brahmins; / deficient in one he is called one-eyed, and deficient in both, blind.

2.1.s:
vivādaḥ sodaraiḥ sārddhaṃ pitrorapriyakṛdvadet ..
dvijādhamaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sa caṃḍaḥ śāstraniṃditaḥ ..58..
2.1.d:
विवादः सोदरैः सार्द्धं पित्रोरप्रियकृद्वदेत् ॥
द्विजाधमः स विज्ञेयः स चंडः शास्त्रनिंदितः ॥58॥
2.1.m: He who speaks quarrelling with siblings, causing displeasure to his parents, / should be known as the lowest of Brahmins; he is fierce, censured by the scriptures.

2.1.s:
piśuno rājagāmī ca śūdrasevaka eva ca ..
śūdrāṃganāgamo vipraḥ sa caṃḍaśca dvijādhamaḥ ..59..
2.1.d:
पिशुनो राजगामी च शूद्रसेवक एव च ॥
शूद्रांगनागमो विप्रः स चंडश्च द्विजाधमः ॥59॥
2.1.m: Malicious, resorting to kings, serving Śūdras, / and a Brahmin having intercourse with a Śūdra woman—he is fierce, the lowest of Brahmins.

2.1.s:
pakvānnaṃ śūdragehe ca yo bhuṃkte sakṛdeva vā ..
paṃcarātraṃ śūdragehe nivāsī caṃḍa ucyate .. .. 2.1.5.60 ..
2.1.d:
पक्वान्नं शूद्रगेहे च यो भुंक्ते सकृदेव वा ॥
पंचरात्रं शूद्रगेहे निवासी चंड उच्यते ॥ ॥ 2.1.5.60 ॥
2.1.m: One who eats cooked food in a Śūdra's house even once, / or resides in a Śūdra's house for five nights, is called fierce.

2.1.s:
aṣṭakuṣṭhānvitaḥ kuṣṭhī trikuṣṭhī śāstraninditaḥ ..
etaiḥ saha sadālāpaḥ sa bhavettatsamo'dhamaḥ .. 61 ..
2.1.d:
अष्टकुष्ठान्वितः कुष्ठी त्रिकुष्ठी शास्त्रनिन्दितः ॥
एतैः सह सदालापः स भवेत्तत्समोऽधमः ॥ 61 ॥
2.1.m: A leper afflicted with eight types of leprosy, or one with three types of leprosy, is censured by scripture; / one who constantly converses with them becomes base, equal to them.

2.1.s:
kīṭavadbhramaṇaṃ yasya kuvyāpārī kupaṃḍitaḥ ..
ajñānācca vadeddharmamagravṛttiḥ pradhāvati .. 62 ..
2.1.d:
कीटवद्भ्रमणं यस्य कुव्यापारी कुपंडितः ॥
अज्ञानाच्च वदेद्धर्ममग्रवृत्तिः प्रधावति ॥ 62 ॥
2.1.m: One whose wandering is like an insect, a bad trader, a pseudo-scholar, / who speaks of dharma out of ignorance and eagerly runs forward for personal profit,

2.1.s:
avimuktaṃ parityajya yo'nyadeśe vasecciram ..
sa dvidhā śūkarapaśurniṃditaḥ siddhasaṃmataḥ.. .. 63 ..
2.1.d:
अविमुक्तं परित्यज्य योऽन्यदेशे वसेच्चिरम् ॥
स द्विधा शूकरपशुर्निंदितः सिद्धसंमतः॥ ॥ 63 ॥
2.1.m: who, abandoning Avimukta, lives for long in another region: / he is twofold, a swinish beast, censured and considered so by the accomplished.

2.1.s:
kapolena hi saṃyukto bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ ..
nṛpavaddaṃḍayedyastu sa daṃḍaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ .. 64 ..
2.1.d:
कपोलेन हि संयुक्तो भ्रुकुटीकुटिलाननः ॥
नृपवद्दंडयेद्यस्तु स दंडः समुदाहृतः ॥ 64 ॥
2.1.m: Endowed with puffed cheeks, his face twisted with knit brows, / he who inflicts punishment like a king is declared punishing.

2.1.s:
brahmasvaharaṇaṃ kṛtvā nṛpadeva svameva ca ..
dhanena tena itaraṃ devaṃ vā brāhmaṇānapi .. 65 ..
2.1.d:
ब्रह्मस्वहरणं कृत्वा नृपदेव स्वमेव च ॥
धनेन तेन इतरं देवं वा ब्राह्मणानपि ॥ 65 ॥
2.1.m: Having stolen the property of Brahmins, of the king, or of the gods, / with that wealth another god or Brahmins

2.1.s:
saṃtarpayati yo'śnāti yaḥ prayacchati vā kvacit ..
sa kharaśca paśuśreṣṭhaḥ sarvavedeṣu niṃditaḥ .. 66 ..
2.1.d:
संतर्पयति योऽश्नाति यः प्रयच्छति वा क्वचित् ॥
स खरश्च पशुश्रेष्ठः सर्ववेदेषु निंदितः ॥ 66 ॥
2.1.m: he propitiates, eats [from it], or gives it away anywhere: / he is an ass, the foremost among beasts, censured in all the Vedas.

2.1.s:
akṣarābhyāsanirataḥ paṭhatyeva na budhyate ..
padaśāstraparityaktaḥ sa paśuḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ .. 67 ..
2.1.d:
अक्षराभ्यासनिरतः पठत्येव न बुध्यते ॥
पदशास्त्रपरित्यक्तः स पशुः स्यान्न संशयः ॥ 67 ॥
2.1.m: Devoted only to learning syllables, reciting without understanding, / devoid of grammar and traditional learning, he is a beast without doubt.

2.1.s:
vadatyanyatkarotyanyadgurudevāgrato yataḥ ..
sa nīca iti vijñeyo hyanācārastathāparaḥ .. 68 ..
2.1.d:
वदत्यन्यत्करोत्यन्यद्गुरुदेवाग्रतो यतः ॥
स नीच इति विज्ञेयो ह्यनाचारस्तथापरः ॥ 68 ॥
2.1.m: Because he speaks one thing and does another before guru and deity, / he is to be known as base; and another is ill-behaved.

2.1.s:
ṣaḍguṇālaṃkṛteḥ sādhordoṣānmṛgayate khalaḥ ..
vane puṣpaphalākīrṇe śalabhaḥ kaṃṭakāniva .. 69 ..
2.1.d:
षड्गुणालंकृतेः साधोर्दोषान्मृगयते खलः ॥
वने पुष्पफलाकीर्णे शलभः कंटकानिव ॥ 69 ॥
2.1.m: The rogue searches for faults in a virtuous man adorned with six virtues, / just as a grasshopper seeks thorns in a forest filled with flowers and fruit.

2.1.s:
daivena ca vihīno yaḥ kusaṃbhāṣāṃ vadettu yaḥ ..
sa vācāla iti khyāto yo hyapatrapatāyutaḥ .. 2.1.5.70 ..
2.1.d:
दैवेन च विहीनो यः कुसंभाषां वदेत्तु यः ॥
स वाचाल इति ख्यातो यो ह्यपत्रपतायुतः ॥ 2.1.5.70 ॥
2.1.m: Devoid of destiny, who speaks foul speech, / he is known as talkative, being shameless.

2.1.s:
cāṃḍālaiḥ saha ālāpaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ poṣaṇe rataḥ ..
mārjāraiścāpi saṃbhuṃkte yatkṛtyaṃ makarṭoditam .. 71 ..
2.1.d:
चांडालैः सह आलापः पक्षिणां पोषणे रतः ॥
मार्जारैश्चापि संभुंक्ते यत्कृत्यं मकर्टोदितम् ॥ 71 ॥
2.1.m: Conversing with outcasts, engaged in rearing birds, / he also eats along with cats, doing what is described as monkey-like conduct.

2.1.s:
tṛṇacchedī loṣṭamadī vṛthā māṃsāśanaśca yaḥ ..
capalaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ parabhāryāratastathā.. 72 ...
2.1.d:
तृणच्छेदी लोष्टमदी वृथा मांसाशनश्च यः ॥
चपलः स तु विज्ञेयः परभार्यारतस्तथा॥ 72 ॥।
2.1.m: One who cuts grass, breaks clods of earth, and eats meat in vain, / and is devoted to another's wife—he is to be known as fickle.

2.1.s:
snehodvartanahīno yo gaṃdhacaṃdanavarjitaḥ ..
nityakriyā akurvāṇo nityaṃ sa ca malīmasaḥ .. 73 ..
2.1.d:
स्नेहोद्वर्तनहीनो यो गंधचंदनवर्जितः ॥
नित्यक्रिया अकुर्वाणो नित्यं स च मलीमसः ॥ 73 ॥
2.1.m: One who is devoid of oil and unction, lacking perfumes and sandalwood paste, / and does not perform the daily rites, is perpetually filthy.

2.1.s:
anyāyena gṛhaṃ viṃdedanyāyena gṛhāndhanam ...
śāstrādanyadgṛha maṃtraṃ sa steyī brahmaghātakaḥ .. 74 ..
2.1.d:
अन्यायेन गृहं विंदेदन्यायेन गृहान्धनम् ॥।
शास्त्रादन्यद्गृह मंत्रं स स्तेयी ब्रह्मघातकः ॥ 74 ॥
2.1.m: One who obtains a house unlawfully, or wealth from households unlawfully, / or a house-mantra outside the scriptures—he is a thief, a slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

2.1.s:
devapustakaratnāni maṇimuktāśvameva ca..
gobhūmisvarṇaharaṇaḥ sa steyīti nigadyate .. 75 ...
2.1.d:
देवपुस्तकरत्नानि मणिमुक्ताश्वमेव च॥
गोभूमिस्वर्णहरणः स स्तेयीति निगद्यते ॥ 75 ॥।
2.1.m: One who takes divine images, books, jewels, gems, pearls, or horses, / or cattle, land, and gold—he is declared a thief.

2.1.s:
devo'pi bhāvayetpaścānmānuṣo'pi na saṃśayaḥ ..
anyonyabhāvanā kāryā sa steyī yo na bhāvayet.. 76 ..
2.1.d:
देवोऽपि भावयेत्पश्चान्मानुषोऽपि न संशयः ॥
अन्योन्यभावना कार्या स स्तेयी यो न भावयेत्॥ 76 ॥
2.1.m: Even a god should subsequently honour [a benefactor], and a human being too, without doubt; / mutual honouring should be observed; one who does not honour is a thief.

2.1.s:
guroḥ prasādājjayati pitroścāpi prasādataḥ ..
karoti ca yathārhaṃ ca sa ca svarge mahīyate ..77 ..
2.1.d:
गुरोः प्रसादाज्जयति पित्रोश्चापि प्रसादतः ॥
करोति च यथार्हं च स च स्वर्गे महीयते ॥77 ॥
2.1.m: Through the grace of the guru one triumphs, and through the grace of one's parents; / and whatever he performs worthily, by that he is glorified in heaven.

2.1.s: na poṣayati duṣṭātmā sa steyī cāparaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 78 ..
2.1.d: न पोषयति दुष्टात्मा स स्तेयी चापरः स्मृतः ॥ 78 ॥
2.1.m: The wicked soul who does not support [them] is remembered as another kind of thief.

2.1.s:
upakārijanaṃ prāpya na karoti pariṣkriyām ..
sa taptanarake śete śoṇite ca patatyadhaḥ .. 79 ..
2.1.d:
उपकारिजनं प्राप्य न करोति परिष्क्रियाम् ॥
स तप्तनरके शेते शोणिते च पतत्यधः ॥ 79 ॥
2.1.m: Having obtained a benefactor, he who does not show honour [in return] / lies in the scalding hell and falls down into blood.

2.1.s:
sarveṣāṃ ca savarṇānāṃ dharmato brāhmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ..
pṛthivīpālako rājā dharmacakṣurudāhṛtaḥ .. 2.1.5.80 ..
2.1.d:
सर्वेषां च सवर्णानां धर्मतो ब्राह्मणः प्रभुः ॥
पृथिवीपालको राजा धर्मचक्षुरुदाहृतः ॥ 2.1.5.80 ॥
2.1.m: By sacred law, the brāhmaṇa is the master of all the classes; / the king, protector of the earth, is called the eye of dharma.

2.1.s:
prajāpatermukhodbhūto horātaṃtre yathoditam ..
tadvido gaṇanābhijñā anyaviprāḥ pracakṣate .. 81 ..
2.1.d:
प्रजापतेर्मुखोद्भूतो होरातंत्रे यथोदितम् ॥
तद्विदो गणनाभिज्ञा अन्यविप्राः प्रचक्षते ॥ 81 ॥
2.1.m: Born from the mouth of Prajāpati, as stated in the treatise on Horā, / those who know it and are skilled in calculation are declared different brāhmaṇas [from others].

2.1.s:
gaṃgāhīno hato deśo viprahīnā yathā kriyā ..
horājñaptivihīno yo deśo'sau viplavaplavaḥ .. 82 ..
2.1.d:
गंगाहीनो हतो देशो विप्रहीना यथा क्रिया ॥
होराज्ञप्तिविहीनो यो देशोऽसौ विप्लवप्लवः ॥ 82 ॥
2.1.m: Just as a land without the Gaṅgā is ruined, and a ritual devoid of a brāhmaṇa, / so a realm devoid of the knowledge of horoscopy is tossed upon the waves of devastation.

2.1.s:
