apradīpā yathā rātriranādityaṃ yathā nabhaḥ ..
tathā'sāṃvatsaro rājā bhramatyaṃdha ivādhvani .. 83 ..
2.1.d:
अप्रदीपा यथा रात्रिरनादित्यं यथा नभः ॥
तथाऽसांवत्सरो राजा भ्रमत्यंध इवाध्वनि ॥ 83 ॥
2.1.m: Just as a night is without a lamp, and the sky is without the sun, / so a king without an astrologer wanders like a blind man on the road.

2.1.s:
sthāpayeddharmato vipraṃ bhāvayetkarmavṛddhaye ..
śmaśruyukto dvijaḥ pūjyaḥ sūryo viprastu śmaśrulaḥ .. 84 ..
2.1.d:
स्थापयेद्धर्मतो विप्रं भावयेत्कर्मवृद्धये ॥
श्मश्रुयुक्तो द्विजः पूज्यः सूर्यो विप्रस्तु श्मश्रुलः ॥ 84 ॥
2.1.m: In accordance with dharma, he should establish a brāhmaṇa and honour him for the increase of works; / a bearded twice-born is worthy of worship, for the sun-brāhmaṇa is bearded.

2.1.s:
pratyakpradarśanātpuṇyaṃ tridinaṃ kalmaṣāpaham ..
darśane vrātyaviprasya sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā viśudhyati .. 85 ..
2.1.d:
प्रत्यक्प्रदर्शनात्पुण्यं त्रिदिनं कल्मषापहम् ॥
दर्शने व्रात्यविप्रस्य सूर्यं दृष्ट्वा विशुध्यति ॥ 85 ॥
2.1.m: Merit arises from looking towards the west, dispelling sins for three days; / upon seeing a vrātya brāhmaṇa, one becomes pure by looking at the sun.

2.1.s:
na vrātyatvaṃ sūryavipre pūjayedyajñasiddhaye ..
jyotirvedasyādhikāraḥ sūryaviprasya vai dvijāḥ .. 86 ..
2.1.d:
न व्रात्यत्वं सूर्यविप्रे पूजयेद्यज्ञसिद्धये ॥
ज्योतिर्वेदस्याधिकारः सूर्यविप्रस्य वै द्विजाः ॥ 86 ॥
2.1.m: There is no fallen status in a sun-brāhmaṇa; one should worship him for the success of sacrifices; / the authority over the scripture of astronomy belongs indeed to the sun-brāhmaṇa, O twice-born.

2.1.s:
jātibhedāśca catvāro bhojakaḥ kathakastathā ..
śivavipraḥ sūryavipraścaturthaḥ paripaṭhyate .. 87 ..
2.1.d:
जातिभेदाश्च चत्वारो भोजकः कथकस्तथा ॥
शिवविप्रः सूर्यविप्रश्चतुर्थः परिपठ्यते ॥ 87 ॥
2.1.m: The divisions of classes are four: the Bhojaka and the Kathaka, / the Śiva-brāhmaṇa, and the sun-brāhmaṇa is recited as the fourth.

2.1.s:
kathako madhyamasteṣāṃ sūryaviprastathottamaḥ ..
śivaliṃgārcanarataḥ śivaviprastu niṃditaḥ .. 88 ..
2.1.d:
कथको मध्यमस्तेषां सूर्यविप्रस्तथोत्तमः ॥
शिवलिंगार्चनरतः शिवविप्रस्तु निंदितः ॥ 88 ॥
2.1.m: Among them the Kathaka is middling, and the sun-brāhmaṇa is the highest; / but the Śiva-brāhmaṇa devoted to the worship of the Śiva-liṅga is censured.

2.1.s:
sūryaviprasya viprasya vaidyasya ca nṛpasya ca ..
pravāsayedakṣatena saputrapaśubāṃdhavaḥ ..
avadhyaḥ sarvalokeṣu rājā rājyena pālayet .. 89 ..
2.1.d:
सूर्यविप्रस्य विप्रस्य वैद्यस्य च नृपस्य च ॥
प्रवासयेदक्षतेन सपुत्रपशुबांधवः ॥
अवध्यः सर्वलोकेषु राजा राज्येन पालयेत् ॥ 89 ॥
2.1.m: Of a sun-brāhmaṇa, of a brāhmaṇa, of a physician, and of a king, / along with sons, cattle, and relatives, one should provide lodging with unhusked grain; / inviolable in all worlds, the king should protect [them] through his kingdom.

2.1.s:
vasubhirvastragaṃdhādyairmālyaiśca vividhairapi ..
deśacakravidaḥ pūjyā horācakravidaḥ parāḥ .. 2.1.5.90 ..
2.1.d:
वसुभिर्वस्त्रगंधाद्यैर्माल्यैश्च विविधैरपि ॥
देशचक्रविदः पूज्या होराचक्रविदः पराः ॥ 2.1.5.90 ॥
2.1.m: With wealth, garments, perfumes and the like, and various garlands, / those who know the cycle of lands are to be worshipped, and supreme are those who know the cycle of horoscopes.

2.1.s:
sūryacakravidaḥ pūjyā nāvamanyetkathaṃcana ..
siddhavṛddhiṃ ca dhanarddhiṃ ca ya icchedāyuṣā samam ..
gaṇaviprasamaḥ pūjyo daivajñaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ .. 91 ..
2.1.d:
सूर्यचक्रविदः पूज्या नावमन्येत्कथंचन ॥
सिद्धवृद्धिं च धनर्द्धिं च य इच्छेदायुषा समम् ॥
गणविप्रसमः पूज्यो दैवज्ञः समुदाहृतः ॥ 91 ॥
2.1.m: Those who know the solar cycle should be worshipped, never disrespected; / he who desires the attainment of prosperity, increase of wealth, along with long life, / an astrologer should be worshipped like a gaṇa-brāhmaṇa, so it is declared.

2.1.s:
jāte bāle nirūpye ca lagnagrahanirūpaṇam ..
saṃsthānaṃ sūryavipro yaḥ sūryaviprasya sattamāḥ ..
dvimātrikāṃ samabhyasya sarvavedaphalaṃ labhet .. 92 ..
guruvarṇanam
2.1.d:
जाते बाले निरूप्ये च लग्नग्रहनिरूपणम् ॥
संस्थानं सूर्यविप्रो यः सूर्यविप्रस्य सत्तमाः ॥
द्विमात्रिकां समभ्यस्य सर्ववेदफलं लभेत् ॥ 92 ॥
गुरुवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
When a child is born and to be examined, the examination of the ascendant and planets [is made]; / that status is the sun-brāhmaṇa's, O best of men; / having mastered the twofold metric, one attains the fruit of all the Vedas.
Description of the Guru.

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ nānyo baṃdhuḥ pracakṣate ..
ṛte piturdvijaśreṣṭhā itīyaṃ naigamī smṛtiḥ .. 1 ..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां नान्यो बंधुः प्रचक्षते ॥
ऋते पितुर्द्विजश्रेष्ठा इतीयं नैगमी स्मृतिः ॥ 1 ॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / For all four varnas, no other relative is proclaimed / besides the father, O best of the twice-born; thus is this Vedic tradition.

2.1.s:
trayo'pi guravaḥ śreṣṭhāstābhyāṃ mātā paro guruḥ ..
ye sodarā jyeṣṭhaśreṣṭhā uttarottarato guruḥ .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
त्रयोऽपि गुरवः श्रेष्ठास्ताभ्यां माता परो गुरुः ॥
ये सोदरा ज्येष्ठश्रेष्ठा उत्तरोत्तरतो गुरुः ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: All three elders are pre-eminent; higher than the [other] two, the mother is the supreme elder; / among brothers of the same womb the eldest is chief; in ascending order each is an elder.

2.1.s:
dvādaśyāṃ tu āmavāsyāmatha vā ravisaṃkrame ..
vāsāṃsi dakṣiṇā deyā maṇimuktā yathāruci .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
द्वादश्यां तु आमवास्यामथ वा रविसंक्रमे ॥
वासांसि दक्षिणा देया मणिमुक्ता यथारुचि ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: On the twelfth lunar day, on the new-moon day, or at the solar transit, / garments, priestly fees, gems, and pearls should be given according to one's pleasure.

2.1.s:
ayane viṣuve caiva caṃdrasūryagrahe tathā ..
prāpte cāparapakṣe tu bhojayeccāpi śaktitaḥ .. 4 ..
2.1.d:
अयने विषुवे चैव चंद्रसूर्यग्रहे तथा ॥
प्राप्ते चापरपक्षे तु भोजयेच्चापि शक्तितः ॥ 4 ॥
2.1.m: At the solstice and the equinox, and at lunar and solar eclipses, / and when the dark fortnight arrives, one should also feed [them] according to one's capacity.

2.1.s:
paścātpravaṃdayetpādau maṃtreṇānena sattamāḥ ..
vidhivadvaṃdanādeva sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet .. 5 ..
2.1.d:
पश्चात्प्रवंदयेत्पादौ मंत्रेणानेन सत्तमाः ॥
विधिवद्वंदनादेव सर्वतीर्थफलं लभेत् ॥ 5 ॥
2.1.m: Afterwards, one should salute their feet with this mantra, O best of men; / merely from revering them according to rule, one obtains the fruit of all pilgrimage sites:

2.1.s:
svargāpavargapradamekamādyaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ pitaraṃ namāmi ..
yato jagatpaśyati cārurūpaṃ taṃ tarpayāmaḥ salilaistilairyutaiḥ .. .. 6 ..
2.1.d:
स्वर्गापवर्गप्रदमेकमाद्यं ब्रह्मस्वरूपं पितरं नमामि ॥
यतो जगत्पश्यति चारुरूपं तं तर्पयामः सलिलैस्तिलैर्युतैः ॥ ॥ 6 ॥
2.1.m: "I bow to the father, the bestower of heaven and liberation, the single primeval one, whose nature is Brahman; / from whom the world beholds pleasant forms, him we gratify with waters accompanied by sesame seeds."

2.1.s:
pitaro janayaṃtīha pitaraḥ pālayaṃti ca ..
pitaro brahmarūpā hi tebhyo nityaṃ namonamaḥ .. 7 ..
2.1.d:
पितरो जनयंतीह पितरः पालयंति च ॥
पितरो ब्रह्मरूपा हि तेभ्यो नित्यं नमोनमः ॥ 7 ॥
2.1.m: "Fathers give birth here, and fathers protect; / fathers are indeed the forms of Brahman; obeisance, obeisance to them constantly."

2.1.s:
yasmādvijayate lokastasmāddharmaḥ pravartate ...
namastubhyaṃ pitaḥ sākṣādbrahmarūpa namo'stu te .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
यस्माद्विजयते लोकस्तस्माद्धर्मः प्रवर्तते ॥।
नमस्तुभ्यं पितः साक्षाद्ब्रह्मरूप नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: "From whom the world triumphs, from whom dharma proceeds; / obeisance to you, father, manifest form of Brahman, obeisance to you."

2.1.s:
yā kukṣivivare kṛtvā svayaṃ rakṣati sarvataḥ ..
namāmi jananīṃ devīṃ parāṃ prakṛtirūpiṇīm ..9...
2.1.d:
या कुक्षिविवरे कृत्वा स्वयं रक्षति सर्वतः ॥
नमामि जननीं देवीं परां प्रकृतिरूपिणीम् ॥9॥।
2.1.m: "She who, having placed [me] within the cavity of her womb, herself protects from all sides; / I bow to the mother, the goddess, the supreme embodiment of Prakṛti."

2.1.s:
kṛcchreṇa mahatā devyā dhārito'haṃ yathodare ..
tvatprasādājjagaddṛṣṭaṃ mātarnityaṃ namo'stu te .. 2.1.6.10 ..
2.1.d:
कृच्छ्रेण महता देव्या धारितोऽहं यथोदरे ॥
त्वत्प्रसादाज्जगद्दृष्टं मातर्नित्यं नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 2.1.6.10 ॥
2.1.m: "As I was carried in the womb with great hardship by the goddess, / by your grace the world was seen; mother, perpetual obeisance to you."

2.1.s:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni sāgarādīni sarvaśaḥ ..
vasaṃti yatra tāṃ naumi mātaraṃ bhūtihetave .. 11 ..
2.1.d:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि सागरादीनि सर्वशः ॥
वसंति यत्र तां नौमि मातरं भूतिहेतवे ॥ 11 ॥
2.1.m: "All the pilgrimage places on earth, the oceans and the rest, / wherein they dwell, to that mother I bow for the sake of prosperity."

2.1.s:
gurudevaprasādena labdhā vidyā yaśaskarī ..
śivarūpa namastasmai saṃsārārṇavasetave .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
गुरुदेवप्रसादेन लब्धा विद्या यशस्करी ॥
शिवरूप नमस्तस्मै संसारार्णवसेतवे ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: "By the grace of the guru and the deity, fame-bringing wisdom is obtained; / obeisance to him whose form is Śiva, the bridge across the ocean of worldly existence."

2.1.s:
veda vedāṃgaśāstrāṇāṃ tattvaṃ yatra pratiṣṭhitam ..
ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāmagrajanmannamo'stu te .. 13 ..
2.1.d:
वेद वेदांगशास्त्राणां तत्त्वं यत्र प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
आधारः सर्वभूतानामग्रजन्मन्नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 13 ॥
2.1.m: "In whom the essence of the Vedas, the Vedāṅgas, and the scriptures is established; / O foundation of all beings, first-born [brāhmaṇa], obeisance to you."

2.1.s:
brāhmaṇo jagatāṃ tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ paramaṃ yataḥ ..
bhūdeva hara me pāpaṃ viṣṇurūpinnamo'stu te .. 14 ..
2.1.d:
ब्राह्मणो जगतां तीर्थं पावनं परमं यतः ॥
भूदेव हर मे पापं विष्णुरूपिन्नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 14 ॥
2.1.m: "Because the brāhmaṇa is the sacred ford of the worlds, the supreme purifier, / O earthly deity, destroy my sin; embodiment of Viṣṇu, obeisance to you."

2.1.s:
pitāmahaṃ ca praṇametsarvādau mātaraṃ gurum ..
mātāmahaṃ ca tadanu ācāryamatha ṛtvijam .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
पितामहं च प्रणमेत्सर्वादौ मातरं गुरुम् ॥
मातामहं च तदनु आचार्यमथ ऋत्विजम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: First of all, one should bow to the grandfather, the mother, and the guru; / and then to the maternal grandfather, then to the ācārya and the officiating priest.

2.1.s:
mātṛmaṃtraiśca prathamaṃ praṇamedbhaktibhāvataḥ ..
yathāgrajastathā jyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛvyo'pi dvijottamāḥ .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
मातृमंत्रैश्च प्रथमं प्रणमेद्भक्तिभावतः ॥
यथाग्रजस्तथा ज्येष्ठः पितृव्योऽपि द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: And with mantras to the mother, one should first bow with devotional feeling; / as is the eldest brother, so is the elder, and the paternal uncle likewise, O best of the twice-born.

2.1.s:
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭe ca sa gururgururmātā tathā guruḥ ..
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭastṛtīyaḥ syātsūryo'gniścaṃdra eva ca ..17..
2.1.d:
दृष्टादृष्टे च स गुरुर्गुरुर्माता तथा गुरुः ॥
दृष्टादृष्टस्तृतीयः स्यात्सूर्योऽग्निश्चंद्र एव च ॥17॥
2.1.m: In visible and invisible realms, that one is the guru; the mother likewise is a guru; / the third visible and invisible [guru] is the sun, fire, and the moon.

2.1.s:
maṃtradātā guruḥ khyātassaptamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
kabhojanaguruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ svargāpavargahetukaḥ ..18..
2.1.d:
मंत्रदाता गुरुः ख्यातस्सप्तमः परिकीर्तितः ॥
कभोजनगुरुः श्रेष्ठः स्वर्गापवर्गहेतुकः ॥18॥
2.1.m: The giver of the mantra is known as a guru; he is proclaimed as the seventh; / the guru who feeds is excellent, the cause of heaven and liberation.

2.1.s:
dṛṣṭadevaṃ ca yo hitvā adṛṣṭaṃ ca niṣevate ..
pāpātmā paramaḥ saikastiryagyoniṃ ca gacchati ..19..
2.1.d:
दृष्टदेवं च यो हित्वा अदृष्टं च निषेवते ॥
पापात्मा परमः सैकस्तिर्यग्योनिं च गच्छति ॥19॥
2.1.m: And he who, having abandoned the visible deity, serves the invisible, / is singularly the most sinful soul, and goes to the womb of an animal.

2.1.s:
yathā pitā jyeṣṭhapitā kanīyāṃśca tathā dvijāḥ ..
jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitṛtulyo mānyaḥ satkārabhāgyataḥ ..2.1.6.20..
2.1.d:
यथा पिता ज्येष्ठपिता कनीयांश्च तथा द्विजाः ॥
ज्येष्ठो भ्राता पितृतुल्यो मान्यः सत्कारभाग्यतः ॥2.1.6.20॥
2.1.m: As is the father, so is the elder paternal uncle and the younger, O twice-born; / the eldest brother is equal to a father, venerable and entitled to honour.

2.1.s:
ācāryo brahmaṇo mūrtiḥ pitā mūrtiḥ prajāpateḥ ..
mātā syānpṛthivīmūrtirbhrātaro mūrtirātmanaḥ .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
आचार्यो ब्रह्मणो मूर्तिः पिता मूर्तिः प्रजापतेः ॥
माता स्यान्पृथिवीमूर्तिर्भ्रातरो मूर्तिरात्मनः ॥ 21 ॥
2.1.m: The ācārya is the embodiment of Brahman; the father is the embodiment of Prajāpati; / the mother is the embodiment of the earth; brothers are the embodiment of one's own self.

2.1.s:
pitā merurva śiṣṭhaḥ syāddharmamūrtiḥ sanātanaḥ ..
sa cāpi dṛṣṭadevaḥ syāttadājñāṃ paripālayet .. 22 ..
2.1.d:
पिता मेरुर्व शिष्ठः स्याद्धर्ममूर्तिः सनातनः ॥
स चापि दृष्टदेवः स्यात्तदाज्ञां परिपालयेत् ॥ 22 ॥
2.1.m: The father is Meru, the most excellent, the eternal embodiment of dharma; / and he is also a visible deity; one should obey his command.

2.1.s:
pitāmahaṃ ca pitragre havyakavyaiśca tarpayet ..
sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yasmānnāvartate punaḥ .. 23 ..
2.1.d:
पितामहं च पित्रग्रे हव्यकव्यैश्च तर्पयेत् ॥
स याति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं यस्मान्नावर्तते पुनः ॥ 23 ॥
2.1.m: And one should satisfy the paternal grandfather before the father with offerings to gods and ancestors; / he goes to the abode of Brahmā, from which he does not return again.

2.1.s:
tasya pādodakasnānādgaṃgā nārhati kevalam ..
tathāvalokanāttasya jyotirliṃgaśataiśca kim .. 24 ..
2.1.d:
तस्य पादोदकस्नानाद्गंगा नार्हति केवलम् ॥
तथावलोकनात्तस्य ज्योतिर्लिंगशतैश्च किम् ॥ 24 ॥
2.1.m: The Gaṅgā alone does not equal bathing in the water of his feet; / likewise, having looked upon him, what need is there for hundreds of liṅgas of light?

2.1.s:
dvātriṃ śatkuṃḍakaśilāsparśane yādṛśaṃ phalam ..
tādṛśaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ pitāmahapradakṣiṇe .. 25 ..
2.1.d:
द्वात्रिं शत्कुंडकशिलास्पर्शने यादृशं फलम् ॥
तादृशं कोटिगुणितं पितामहप्रदक्षिणे ॥ 25 ॥
2.1.m: Whatever fruit is attained by touching thirty-two pit-stones, / a crore times that is attained by circumambulating the paternal grandfather.

2.1.s:
śatamātṛvariṣṭhāśca pitāmahyāśca poṣaṇe ..
guṇāstaddarśane viprāḥ saṃsāre na punarviśet .. 26 ..
guruvarṇanam
2.1.d:
शतमातृवरिष्ठाश्च पितामह्याश्च पोषणे ॥
गुणास्तद्दर्शने विप्राः संसारे न पुनर्विशेत् ॥ 26 ॥
गुरुवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
Greater than a hundred mothers is the nourishing of the paternal grandmother; / by the merits of seeing her, O brahmins, one does not enter mundane existence again.
Description of the Guru

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
samākhyāmīha vipreṃdrā itihāsaṃ purātanam ..
śravaṇepi ca dharmātmañchrūyatāṃ yanmayā purā .. 1 ..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
समाख्यामीह विप्रेंद्रा इतिहासं पुरातनम् ॥
श्रवणेपि च धर्मात्मञ्छ्रूयतां यन्मया पुरा ॥ 1 ॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / I will fully recount here, O best of brahmins, an ancient legend; / and upon listening, O righteous one, let that which was heard by me long ago be heard.

2.1.s:
pṛṣṭovocanmahātejā viriṃco bhagavānprabhuḥ ..
haṃta te kathayāmyeṣa purāṇaśravaṇe vidhim .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
पृष्टोवोचन्महातेजा विरिंचो भगवान्प्रभुः ॥
हंत ते कथयाम्येष पुराणश्रवणे विधिम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: When asked, the glorious lord Viriñci of great splendor spoke: / 'Come, I shall tell you the rule regarding the listening to the Purāṇa.

2.1.s:
itihāsapurāṇāni śrutvā bhaktyā dvijottamāḥ ..
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo brahmahatyāśataṃ ca yat .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
इतिहासपुराणानि श्रुत्वा भक्त्या द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो ब्रह्महत्याशतं च यत् ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: Having heard the Itihāsas and Purāṇas with devotion, O best of brahmins, / one is freed from all sins, and even from a hundred slaughters of brahmins.

2.1.s:
sāyaṃ prātastathā rātrau śucirbhūtvā śṛṇoti yaḥ ..
tasya viṣṇustathā brahmā tuṣyate śaṃkarastathā .. 4 ..
2.1.d:
सायं प्रातस्तथा रात्रौ शुचिर्भूत्वा शृणोति यः ॥
तस्य विष्णुस्तथा ब्रह्मा तुष्यते शंकरस्तथा ॥ 4 ॥
2.1.m: He who, having become pure, listens in the morning, in the evening, and at night— / with him Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and Śaṅkara are pleased.

2.1.s:
pratyūṣe bhagavānbrahmā dināṃte tuṣyate hariḥ ..
mahādevastathā rātrau śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ nṛṇām..5..
2.1.d:
प्रत्यूषे भगवान्ब्रह्मा दिनांते तुष्यते हरिः ॥
महादेवस्तथा रात्रौ शृण्वतां पठतां नृणाम्॥5॥
2.1.m: The lord Brahmā is pleased at dawn, Hari at the close of the day, / and Mahādeva at night, with men who listen or read.

2.1.s:
śuklavastradharaścaiva cailājinakuśottaraḥ ..
pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kuryādyā tasmindevatā gurau ..6...
2.1.d:
शुक्लवस्त्रधरश्चैव चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरः ॥
प्रदक्षिणत्रयं कुर्याद्या तस्मिन्देवता गुरौ ॥6॥।
2.1.m: Wearing white garments, and seated on cloth, black antelope skin, and kuśa grass, / one should perform three circumambulations of the deity that is in the guru.

2.1.s:
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ svāsanaṃ bhajate tataḥ ..
dikpatibhyo namaskṛtya ūm̐kārādhiṣṭhitānapi .. 7 ..
2.1.d:
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं स्वासनं भजते ततः ॥
दिक्पतिभ्यो नमस्कृत्य ऊम्̐काराधिष्ठितानपि ॥ 7 ॥
2.1.m: Then he takes his seat, neither too high nor too low; / having bowed to the guardians of the directions, and also to those presided over by the syllable Om,

2.1.s:
pustakaṃ dharmaśāstrasya dharmādhiṣṭhānaśāśvatam ..
āgamānāṃ śivo devastaṃtrādīnāṃ ca śāradā .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
पुस्तकं धर्मशास्त्रस्य धर्माधिष्ठानशाश्वतम् ॥
आगमानां शिवो देवस्तंत्रादीनां च शारदा ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: [and to] the book of the Dharmaśāstra, the eternal abode of dharma. / Śiva is the deity of the Āgamas, and Śāradā of the Tantras and the rest.

2.1.s:
jāmalānāṃ gaṇapatirḍāmarāṇāṃ śatakratuḥ ..
nārāyaṇo bhāratasya tathā rāmāyaṇasya ca .. 9 ...
2.1.d:
जामलानां गणपतिर्डामराणां शतक्रतुः ॥
नारायणो भारतस्य तथा रामायणस्य च ॥ 9 ॥।
2.1.m: Gaṇapati is the deity of the Yāmalas, Śatakratu of the Ḍāmaras; / Nārāyaṇa is the deity of the Mahābhārata and also of the Rāmāyaṇa.

2.1.s:
vāsudevo bhaveddevaḥ saptānāṃ śṛṇu sattama ..
ādityo vāsudevaśca mādhavo rāmakeśavau .. 2.1.7.10 ..
2.1.d:
वासुदेवो भवेद्देवः सप्तानां शृणु सत्तम ॥
आदित्यो वासुदेवश्च माधवो रामकेशवौ ॥ 2.1.7.10 ॥
2.1.m: Vāsudeva is the deity of the seven; hear, O best of men: / Āditya, Vāsudeva, Mādhava, Rāma, Keśava,

2.1.s:
vanamālī mahādevaḥ saptānāṃ saptaparvasu ..
viṣṇudharmādikānāṃ ca śivo jñeyaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
atha cādipurāṇasya viriṃciḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 11 ..
2.1.d:
वनमाली महादेवः सप्तानां सप्तपर्वसु ॥
विष्णुधर्मादिकानां च शिवो ज्ञेयः सनातनः ॥
अथ चादिपुराणस्य विरिंचिः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 11 ॥
2.1.m: Vanamālin, and Mahādeva are the deities of the seven in the seven festivals; / and Śiva the eternal should be known as the deity of the Viṣṇudharma and similar texts; / moreover, Viriñci is proclaimed as the deity of the Ādipurāṇa.

2.1.s:
śuddhaudanaṃ yavakṣīraṃ pāyasaṃ kṛśaraṃ tathā ..
kṛśarānnaṃ ca vā dadyātkramādbaligaṇaṃ viduḥ .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
शुद्धौदनं यवक्षीरं पायसं कृशरं तथा ॥
कृशरान्नं च वा दद्यात्क्रमाद्बलिगणं विदुः ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: Pure boiled rice, barley-milk, milk rice, and kṛśara— / or one should offer kṛśara rice; they know this set of offerings in sequence.

2.1.s:
śālibhaktaṃ sagodhūmaṃ tilākṣatavimiśritam ..
gavyaṃ ca saphalaṃ caiva deyaścaibhyastvayaṃ baliḥ ..13..
2.1.d:
शालिभक्तं सगोधूमं तिलाक्षतविमिश्रितम् ॥
गव्यं च सफलं चैव देयश्चैभ्यस्त्वयं बलिः ॥13॥
2.1.m: Boiled śāli rice, with wheat, mixed with sesame and unbroken grains, / with cow's milk and with fruits—this offering must be given to them.

2.1.s:
pṛthakpṛthakcaiva kāṃsye vinyaseddikṣu madhyataḥ ..
paṭheccāpi vidhānena sa yāgaḥ ṣaṇmayaḥ paraḥ ..14..
2.1.d:
पृथक्पृथक्चैव कांस्ये विन्यसेद्दिक्षु मध्यतः ॥
पठेच्चापि विधानेन स यागः षण्मयः परः ॥14॥
2.1.m: Separately and individually one should place them in bronze vessels, in the cardinal directions and in the center; / and one should read according to the prescription; that superior sacrifice consists of six items.

2.1.s:
śītodakaṃ madhu kṣīraṃ sitekṣvośca raso guḍaḥ..
sagarbhaśca paro jñeyaḥ ṣaṇmayaścāparo baliḥ .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
शीतोदकं मधु क्षीरं सितेक्ष्वोश्च रसो गुडः॥
सगर्भश्च परो ज्ञेयः षण्मयश्चापरो बलिः ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: Cool water, honey, milk, white sugar, sugarcane juice, and jaggery: / this is to be known as superior with filling, and another offering consisting of six items.

2.1.s:
śālitaṃḍulaprasthaṃ tu tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakam ..
kṣīreṇāpi ca saṃbhaktaṃ yavakṣīramidaṃ smṛtam .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
शालितंडुलप्रस्थं तु तदर्धं वा तदर्धकम् ॥
क्षीरेणापि च संभक्तं यवक्षीरमिदं स्मृतम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: A prastha measure of husked śāli rice, or half of that, or half of that, / cooked along with milk—this is traditionally remembered as barley-milk.

2.1.s:
kṣīraṃ bhāgāṣṭakaṃ grāhyaṃ saptabhāgena saṃsthitam..
haimaṃtikaṃ sitākhyaṃ ca tāṃḍulaṃ prapaceccarum .. 17 ..
2.1.d:
क्षीरं भागाष्टकं ग्राह्यं सप्तभागेन संस्थितम्॥
हैमंतिकं सिताख्यं च तांडुलं प्रपचेच्चरुम् ॥ 17 ॥
2.1.m: Eight parts of milk should be taken, boiled down to seven parts; / with winter white rice one should cook the caru.

2.1.s:
aśītipalamānena siddhamāsādayettataḥ ..
bhāgārdhena dadetpaścānmākṣikaṃ vā sitāmapi .. 18 ..
2.1.d:
अशीतिपलमानेन सिद्धमासादयेत्ततः ॥
भागार्धेन ददेत्पश्चान्माक्षिकं वा सितामपि ॥ 18 ॥
2.1.m: By a measure of eighty palas, one should then attain what is prepared; / afterward one should add honey or white sugar by half that amount.

2.1.s:
guḍamiśreṇa yo dadyātsaṃparko jāyate kvacit ..
saṃpṛktaṃ mākṣikeṇāpi dadyādikṣurasaṃ budhaḥ ..
gṛhītvā yācakaḥ śuddhaḥ śṛṇuta dvijasattamāḥ .. 19 ..
2.1.d:
गुडमिश्रेण यो दद्यात्संपर्को जायते क्वचित् ॥
संपृक्तं माक्षिकेणापि दद्यादिक्षुरसं बुधः ॥
गृहीत्वा याचकः शुद्धः शृणुत द्विजसत्तमाः ॥ 19 ॥
2.1.m: For one who gives it mixed with jaggery, contact occurs somewhere; / the wise man should give sugarcane juice mixed also with honey; / having received it, being pure, the petitioner—listen, O best of brahmins—

2.1.s:
śṛṇute vādhīyāno yo dadyāddhaste ca pustakam ..
samutthāya ca gṛhṇīyātpraṇamya vinivedayet .. 2.1.7.20 ..
2.1.d:
शृणुते वाधीयानो यो दद्याद्धस्ते च पुस्तकम् ॥
समुत्थाय च गृह्णीयात्प्रणम्य विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 2.1.7.20 ॥
2.1.m: listens, or he who studies should place the book in his hand; / and rising, he should receive it, and having bowed, he should present it.

2.1.s:
pūrvasthaḥ śrāvako vipro vikhyātastasyadakṣiṇe ..
paścimāśāmukhenaiva tarjanyāṃguṣṭhayā saha ..21..
2.1.d:
पूर्वस्थः श्रावको विप्रो विख्यातस्तस्यदक्षिणे ॥
पश्चिमाशामुखेनैव तर्जन्यांगुष्ठया सह ॥21॥
2.1.m: The reciting brahmin is stationed in the east, or famously to his south, / facing the western direction, using the forefinger along with the thumb.

2.1.s:
prastareṇāpi hastena vinyāsaḥ paṃḍitaiḥ sadā ..
itonyathā na kartavyaḥ kṛtvā nyāsamathāpnuyāt ..22..
2.1.d:
प्रस्तरेणापि हस्तेन विन्यासः पंडितैः सदा ॥
इतोन्यथा न कर्तव्यः कृत्वा न्यासमथाप्नुयात् ॥22॥
2.1.m: The placement is always performed by wise men with an open hand; / it should not be done otherwise than this; having performed the nyāsa, he then attains [the fruit].

2.1.s:
asakṛdvinyasedviprāḥ pāvamānīṃ jale japet ..
vedāṃtāgamavedāṃtavidhireṣa smṛto budhaiḥ ..23..
2.1.d:
असकृद्विन्यसेद्विप्राः पावमानीं जले जपेत् ॥
वेदांतागमवेदांतविधिरेष स्मृतो बुधैः ॥23॥
2.1.m: One should repeatedly perform the placement, O brahmins, and chant the Pāvamānī hymn in water; / this rule of the Vedānta, the Āgamas, and the Upaniṣads is remembered by the wise.

2.1.s:
yamadiksaṃmukhe śrotā vācakaścottarāmukhaḥ ..
purāṇabhāratākhyāna eṣa vai kathito vidhiḥ ..24..
2.1.d:
यमदिक्संमुखे श्रोता वाचकश्चोत्तरामुखः ॥
पुराणभारताख्यान एष वै कथितो विधिः ॥24॥
2.1.m: The listener faces the direction of Yama, and the reciter faces the north; / this indeed is the rule declared for the recitation of the Purāṇa and the Mahābhārata.

2.1.s:
vaiparītyena vidhinā vijñeyo dvijasattamāḥ ..
rāmāyaṇe dharmaśāstre harivaṃśe ca sattamāḥ .. 25 ..
2.1.d:
वैपरीत्येन विधिना विज्ञेयो द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
रामायणे धर्मशास्त्रे हरिवंशे च सत्तमाः ॥ 25 ॥
2.1.m: It is to be known as reversed in the rule, O best of brahmins, / for the Rāmāyaṇa, the Dharmaśāstra, and the Harivaṃśa, O best of men.

2.1.s:
ito'nyathā yātudhānāḥ praluṃpaṃti phalaṃ yataḥ ..
tasmādvidhividhānena śṛṇuyādatha vā paṭhet .. 26 ..
2.1.d:
इतोऽन्यथा यातुधानाः प्रलुंपंति फलं यतः ॥
तस्माद्विधिविधानेन शृणुयादथ वा पठेत् ॥ 26 ॥
2.1.m: Because otherwise than this, demons snatch away the fruit; / therefore, one should listen or read according to the prescribed rule.

2.1.s:
śrutvā prati puṇyavidyāṃ yo'śnīyānmāṃsameva tu ..
sa yāti gārdabhīṃ yoniṃ yadi maithuninaḥ kvacit .. 27 ..
2.1.d:
श्रुत्वा प्रति पुण्यविद्यां योऽश्नीयान्मांसमेव तु ॥
स याति गार्दभीं योनिं यदि मैथुनिनः क्वचित् ॥ 27 ॥
2.1.m: Having heard sacred knowledge, he who eats meat, / or if he engages in sexual union, goes to the womb of an ass.

2.1.s:
yadi devālaye tīrthe vācayecchṛṇuyādatha ..
yasya devagṛhe tasya tasya tīrthasya varṇanam ..28..
2.1.d:
यदि देवालये तीर्थे वाचयेच्छृणुयादथ ॥
यस्य देवगृहे तस्य तस्य तीर्थस्य वर्णनम् ॥28॥
2.1.m: If he has it read or listens in a temple or at a sacred bathing place, / there should be a description of that deity's temple and of that sacred bathing place.

2.1.s:
māhātmyaśravaṇādeva godānasya phalaṃ labhet..
mahāgurośca māhātmyaṃ pitroragre na ca smaret ..
piturmāhātmyaṃ yatputrairvācyaṃ saṃsadi parvaṇi .. 29 ..
2.1.d:
माहात्म्यश्रवणादेव गोदानस्य फलं लभेत्॥
महागुरोश्च माहात्म्यं पित्रोरग्रे न च स्मरेत् ॥
पितुर्माहात्म्यं यत्पुत्रैर्वाच्यं संसदि पर्वणि ॥ 29 ॥
2.1.m: Merely by listening to the eulogy, one obtains the fruit of giving a cow; / but one must not recite the greatness of the supreme guru before one's parents; / the greatness of the father should be recited by sons in an assembly on a festival day.

2.1.s:
vāsudevāmataścāpi rudramāhātmyavarṇanam ..
rudrāgre vāsudevasya kīrtanaṃ puṇyavardhanam .. 2.1.7.30 ..
2.1.d:
वासुदेवामतश्चापि रुद्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ॥
रुद्राग्रे वासुदेवस्य कीर्तनं पुण्यवर्धनम् ॥ 2.1.7.30 ॥
2.1.m: The description of the greatness of Rudra does not please Vāsudeva; / chanting Vāsudeva's name in front of Rudra increases merit.

2.1.s:
durgāgre śivasūryasya vaiṣṇavākhyānameva ca ..
yaḥ karoti vimūḍhātmā gārdabhīṃ yonimāviśet .. 31 ..
2.1.d:
दुर्गाग्रे शिवसूर्यस्य वैष्णवाख्यानमेव च ॥
यः करोति विमूढात्मा गार्दभीं योनिमाविशेत् ॥ 31 ॥
2.1.m: In front of Durgā, reciting the narrative of Śiva, Sūrya, / or Viṣṇu—he who does this, foolish in mind, will enter the womb of an ass.

2.1.s:
guroranujñayā pitroḥ prakuryādabhivādanam ..
anujñayā tathā pitrorhareḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇam .. 32 ..
2.1.d:
गुरोरनुज्ञया पित्रोः प्रकुर्यादभिवादनम् ॥
अनुज्ञया तथा पित्रोर्हरेः कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणम् ॥ 32 ॥
2.1.m: With the permission of the guru, one should salute one's parents; / likewise, with the permission of the parents, one should circumambulate Hari.

2.1.s:
na viṣṇurna ca brahmā ca na ca rudraḥ śacīpatiḥ ..
sarvavedena tattulyaṃ sarvadharmaparāyaṇam .. 33 ..
2.1.d:
न विष्णुर्न च ब्रह्मा च न च रुद्रः शचीपतिः ॥
सर्ववेदेन तत्तुल्यं सर्वधर्मपरायणम् ॥ 33 ॥
2.1.m: Not Viṣṇu, nor Brahmā, nor Rudra, nor the husband of Śacī / is equal to that which is endowed with all the Vedas and devoted to all dharmas,

2.1.s:
sarvajñānamayaṃ caiva sarvajñena ca tatsamam ..
tasmāddvijanmanpitrorhi sevanādbrahmaśāśvatam ..34..
2.1.d:
सर्वज्ञानमयं चैव सर्वज्ञेन च तत्समम् ॥
तस्माद्द्विजन्मन्पित्रोर्हि सेवनाद्ब्रह्मशाश्वतम् ॥34॥
2.1.m: consisting of all knowledge, and equal to the omniscient; / therefore, O twice-born, serving one's parents leads to the eternal Brahman.

2.1.s:
gurubhyo vaṃdanaṃ vyartha pitaraṃ yo na tarpayet ..
jīvanna tarpayenmukhyaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ maraṇepi ca ..
ubhayostarpaṇaṃ nāsti jīvannapi na jīvati .. 35 ..
2.1.d:
गुरुभ्यो वंदनं व्यर्थ पितरं यो न तर्पयेत् ॥
जीवन्न तर्पयेन्मुख्यं गंगायां मरणेपि च ॥
उभयोस्तर्पणं नास्ति जीवन्नपि न जीवति ॥ 35 ॥
2.1.m: Salutation to gurus is useless for him who does not satisfy his father; / if while alive he does not satisfy the foremost [parent], even upon death at the Gaṅgā / there is no libation for either; though living, he does not live.

2.1.s:
purāṇaśravaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ śūnyaṃ bhāgavataṃ yadi ..
vyarthaṃ bhāgavataṃ viprā nārasiṃhavihīnakam .. .. 36 ..
2.1.d:
पुराणश्रवणं पुण्यं शून्यं भागवतं यदि ॥
व्यर्थं भागवतं विप्रा नारसिंहविहीनकम् ॥ ॥ 36 ॥
2.1.m: Listening to the Purāṇa is meritorious, [yet] empty if devoid of the Bhāgavata; / useless is the Bhāgavata, O brahmins, if devoid of Narasiṃha.

2.1.s:
ādiparvaṇi hīne tu bhāratākhyaṃ na dhārayet ..
vināśvamedhikaṃ viprā vinā yajñānanaṃ vinā .. 37 ..
2.1.d:
आदिपर्वणि हीने तु भारताख्यं न धारयेत् ॥
विनाश्वमेधिकं विप्रा विना यज्ञाननं विना ॥ 37 ॥
2.1.m: If the Ādiparvan is missing, one should not keep the [text] called the Bhārata, / [nor] without the Āśvamedhika, O brāhmaṇas, [nor] without the head of the sacrifice.

2.1.s:
dānakarmavihīnaṃ ca mokṣadharmaṃ na dhārayeta ..
bhārataṃ ca divārohadhāraṇādau varaṃ vrajet .. 38 ..
2.1.d:
दानकर्मविहीनं च मोक्षधर्मं न धारयेत ॥
भारतं च दिवारोहधारणादौ वरं व्रजेत् ॥ 38 ॥
2.1.m: And lacking the rite of gift-giving, one should not keep the Mokṣadharma; / and by keeping the Bhārata on the Divāroha, one attains the highest state.

2.1.s:
vāyupurāṇamaśrutvā śāstraṃ ca yaugikaṃ vinā ..
vāyuhīnaṃ dehikulaṃ vṛthā tasya na dhārakam .. 39 ..
2.1.d:
वायुपुराणमश्रुत्वा शास्त्रं च यौगिकं विना ॥
वायुहीनं देहिकुलं वृथा तस्य न धारकम् ॥ 39 ॥
2.1.m: Without having heard the Vāyupurāṇa, and without the yogic treatise, / the bodily lineage is bereft of wind (vital breath); in vain does one fail to maintain it.

2.1.s:
tathā vāyupurāṇaṃ yadvihīnaṃ śravyamanyakam ..
yathā sundarakāṃḍena āraṇyaṃ ca na dhārayeta .. 2.1.7.40 ..
2.1.d:
तथा वायुपुराणं यद्विहीनं श्रव्यमन्यकम् ॥
यथा सुन्दरकांडेन आरण्यं च न धारयेत ॥ 2.1.7.40 ॥
2.1.m: Likewise, that Vāyupurāṇa which is incomplete is another text fit to be heard. / Just as one should not keep the Āraṇyaka without the Sundarakāṇḍa,

2.1.s:
laṃkāṃ vinā cādikāṃḍaṃ tallikhitvā na dhārayet ..
pārāśaraṃ vinā vyāsaṃ yājñavaktyaṃ vinā makham .. 41 ..
2.1.d:
लंकां विना चादिकांडं तल्लिखित्वा न धारयेत् ॥
पाराशरं विना व्यासं याज्ञवक्त्यं विना मखम् ॥ 41 ॥
2.1.m: nor the Ādikāṇḍa without the Laṅkākāṇḍa, having copied it, one should not keep it; / [nor] Vyāsa without the Pārāśara, nor the sacrifice without the Yājñavalkya;

2.1.s:
dakṣaṃ vinā na śaṃkhaṃ ca śaṃkhahīnaṃ bṛhaspatim ..
vahnīyaṃ śravaṇādyena na ca yuktimathāpayet .. 42 ..
2.1.d:
दक्षं विना न शंखं च शंखहीनं बृहस्पतिम् ॥
वह्नीयं श्रवणाद्येन न च युक्तिमथापयेत् ॥ 42 ॥
2.1.m: nor the Śaṅkha without the Dakṣa, nor the Bṛhaspati without the Śaṅkha; / nor should one apply reasoning through hearing the text on fire and the like,

2.1.s:
saṃsthāpanādeva vinā na ca kimapi rākṣasaiḥ ..
na dadetprārthakādibhyo na vikrīyetkathaṃcana .. 43 ..
2.1.d:
संस्थापनादेव विना न च किमपि राक्षसैः ॥
न ददेत्प्रार्थकादिभ्यो न विक्रीयेत्कथंचन ॥ 43 ॥
2.1.m: except indeed from proper installation, and not at all through rākṣasas. / One should not give [the book] to suppliants and the like, nor sell it under any circumstances.

2.1.s:
na haretpustakaṃ cāpi na haredakṣarāṇi ṣaṭ ..
brahmākṣarasya haraṇādrauravānna nivartate ..44..
2.1.d:
न हरेत्पुस्तकं चापि न हरेदक्षराणि षट् ॥
ब्रह्माक्षरस्य हरणाद्रौरवान्न निवर्तते ॥44॥
2.1.m: One must not steal a manuscript, nor should one steal six letters; / from stealing a syllable of Brahman, one does not turn back from the Raurava [hell].

2.1.s:
ādyākṣarasya haraṇāttāmrakuṣṭhī bhavediha ..
mukhavṛttasya haraṇādyāvadācaṃdratārakam.. ..45..
2.1.d:
आद्याक्षरस्य हरणात्ताम्रकुष्ठी भवेदिह ॥
मुखवृत्तस्य हरणाद्यावदाचंद्रतारकम्॥ ॥45॥
2.1.m: From stealing the first letter, one becomes a coppery leper here; / from stealing the face-meter, for as long as the moon and stars endure,

2.1.s:
kuvale asipatre ca patatīha na saṃśayaḥ ..
svākṣarasya haraṇe svamātṛharaṇe'pi yat ..46..
2.1.d:
कुवले असिपत्रे च पततीह न संशयः ॥
स्वाक्षरस्य हरणे स्वमातृहरणेऽपि यत् ॥46॥
2.1.m: he falls into Kuvala and Asipatra in this world, without a doubt. / When one's own letter is stolen, it is as when one's own mother is abducted.

2.1.s:
tasmātpustakamātraṃ yo harennarakamāpnuyāt ..
yadbhārataṃ yatpurāṇaṃ stotrarūpāṇi tāni ca .. 47 ..
2.1.d:
तस्मात्पुस्तकमात्रं यो हरेन्नरकमाप्नुयात् ॥
यद्भारतं यत्पुराणं स्तोत्ररूपाणि तानि च ॥ 47 ॥
2.1.m: Therefore, he who steals merely a manuscript will incur hell. / Whatever Bhārata, whatever Purāṇa, and those [texts] in the form of praise,

2.1.s:
tāni vedāgamādīni pustakeṣvapi vācayet ..
vedānāṃ pustakaṃ yatra likhitvā tanna vācayet .. .. 48 ..
2.1.d:
तानि वेदागमादीनि पुस्तकेष्वपि वाचयेत् ॥
वेदानां पुस्तकं यत्र लिखित्वा तन्न वाचयेत् ॥ ॥ 48 ॥
2.1.m: those, the Veda, Āgama, and the rest, one should read even from manuscripts. / Where a book of the Vedas has been written down, one must not read it [from the text];

2.1.s:
tathā tantroditānmaṃtrām̐llikhitvā tanna vācayet ..
pustakaṃ nigamānāṃ ca mantravyākhyānasaṃgraham .. 49 ..
2.1.d:
तथा तन्त्रोदितान्मंत्राम्̐ल्लिखित्वा तन्न वाचयेत् ॥
पुस्तकं निगमानां च मन्त्रव्याख्यानसंग्रहम् ॥ 49 ॥
2.1.m: likewise, having written down mantras taught in the Tantras, one must not read them. / A manuscript of the scriptures, or a compilation of mantra commentaries,

2.1.s:
sphuṭaṃ kṛtvā puraḥ sthāpya yāvatkālaṃ pravartate ..
tāvatsa narake ghore pretatvaṃ janmajanmani .. 2.1.7.50 ..
2.1.d:
स्फुटं कृत्वा पुरः स्थाप्य यावत्कालं प्रवर्तते ॥
तावत्स नरके घोरे प्रेतत्वं जन्मजन्मनि ॥ 2.1.7.50 ॥
2.1.m: having opened it and placed it in front, for as long as it remains, / for that long he suffers preta-hood in a terrible hell, birth after birth.

2.1.s:
na vācayecca vyākhyātā vācako'pi pravācayet ..
pauṣkare ca śloka pādamāśvamedhaṃ padepade .. 51 ..
2.1.d:
न वाचयेच्च व्याख्याता वाचकोऽपि प्रवाचयेत् ॥
पौष्करे च श्लोक पादमाश्वमेधं पदेपदे ॥ 51 ॥
2.1.m: The commentator should not read it aloud, but a reciter may recite it. / In the Pauṣkara, one quarter-verse of the horse-sacrifice occurs at every step.

2.1.s:
vedārthaṃ vācayedyasmādviparīto'pavācakaḥ ..
tāvubhau patitau jñeyau pāvamānīśataṃ japet.. 52 ..
2.1.d:
वेदार्थं वाचयेद्यस्माद्विपरीतोऽपवाचकः ॥
तावुभौ पतितौ ज्ञेयौ पावमानीशतं जपेत्॥ 52 ॥
2.1.m: Because he reads the meaning of the Veda, he is contrary, an improper reciter; / both of them are to be known as fallen; one should mutter the Pāvamānī verses a hundred times.

2.1.s:
ādimadhyāvasāne ca mantre ca praṇavaṃ diśet ..
balibhirgaṃdhapuṣpaiśca pustakaṃ devanirmitam .. 53 ..
2.1.d:
आदिमध्यावसाने च मन्त्रे च प्रणवं दिशेत् ॥
बलिभिर्गंधपुष्पैश्च पुस्तकं देवनिर्मितम् ॥ 53 ॥
2.1.m: At the beginning, middle, and end, and in the mantra, one should indicate the Praṇava; / with offerings, scents, and flowers, [one worships] the book fashioned by the gods.

2.1.s:
tridevaṃ pustakaṃ vidyātsūtraṃ vāsukirucyate ..
amānakaraṇe doṣastasmāttacca na hāpayet .. 54 ..
2.1.d:
त्रिदेवं पुस्तकं विद्यात्सूत्रं वासुकिरुच्यते ॥
अमानकरणे दोषस्तस्मात्तच्च न हापयेत् ॥ 54 ॥
2.1.m: One should know the manuscript as the triple deity, and the cord is called Vāsuki; / there is fault in disrespecting it, therefore one should not neglect it.

2.1.s:
patrāṇi bhagavānbrahmā ūrdhvadīrghāṇi yāni ca ..
janārdanaścākṣarāṇi mātrā prakṛtiravyayā .. 55 ..
2.1.d:
पत्राणि भगवान्ब्रह्मा ऊर्ध्वदीर्घाणि यानि च ॥
जनार्दनश्चाक्षराणि मात्रा प्रकृतिरव्यया ॥ 55 ॥
2.1.m: The leaves, those that are tall and long, are the blessed Brahmā; / Janārdana is the letters, and the mora is imperishable Prakṛti;

2.1.s:
lipī bhaṃgī maheśaḥ syāttasyā mātrā sarasvatī ..
ekarekhā ca ekātmā pādācca pādavicyutiḥ .. 56 ..
2.1.d:
लिपी भंगी महेशः स्यात्तस्या मात्रा सरस्वती ॥
एकरेखा च एकात्मा पादाच्च पादविच्युतिः ॥ 56 ॥
2.1.m: the style of the script is Maheśa, and its vowel-mark is Sarasvatī; / a single line is the single Self, and from a metrical foot comes deviation of the foot.

2.1.s:
catuṣpādāṃtare yugmaṃ madhyamoṃ'te yugaṃ yugam ..
vipatkaraṃ yugmapaṃktāvayugme svargasādhanam .. 57 ..
2.1.d:
चतुष्पादांतरे युग्मं मध्यमोंऽते युगं युगम् ॥
विपत्करं युग्मपंक्तावयुग्मे स्वर्गसाधनम् ॥ 57 ॥
2.1.m: Within four quarters is a pair; in the middle, Om; at the end, age after age; / an even-numbered line causes calamity, while an odd-numbered [line] is the means to heaven,

2.1.s:
bhārate cetihāse ca purāṇe dvijasattamāḥ ..
ayugmapaṃktau svargaḥ syādyugme narakamāviśet .. .. 58 ..
2.1.d:
भारते चेतिहासे च पुराणे द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
अयुग्मपंक्तौ स्वर्गः स्याद्युग्मे नरकमाविशेत् ॥ ॥ 58 ॥
2.1.m: in the Bhārata, in the Itihāsa, and in the Purāṇa, O best of the twice-born. / On an odd-numbered line there is heaven; on an even one, one would enter hell.

2.1.s:
vaktṛnāmākṣarairyuktaṃ paṃktibhedena sattamāḥ ..
upanyastasya yannāma tatkalau mātrayā saha .. 59 ..
2.1.d:
वक्तृनामाक्षरैर्युक्तं पंक्तिभेदेन सत्तमाः ॥
उपन्यस्तस्य यन्नाम तत्कलौ मात्रया सह ॥ 59 ॥
2.1.m: Endowed with the letters of the speaker's name, through the division of lines, O best of men: / whatever name of the subject is introduced, that in the Kali [age] is along with the mora.

2.1.s:
ātmasaṃśuddhisaṃśuddhyā dhārayeddharma saṃhitām ..
ito'nyathā bhaveddoṣastasmāttatparivarjayet .. 2.1.7.60 ..
2.1.d:
आत्मसंशुद्धिसंशुद्ध्या धारयेद्धर्म संहिताम् ॥
इतोऽन्यथा भवेद्दोषस्तस्मात्तत्परिवर्जयेत् ॥ 2.1.7.60 ॥
2.1.m: Through the purification of self-purification, one should maintain the law-collection; / otherwise than this, there will be fault; therefore, one should avoid that.

2.1.s:
ripuḥ sūryastayārāmo yakṣo'naṃtaḥ sarasvatī ..
brāhmī ca yakṣiṇī caiva gāyatrī navamī smṛtā .. 61 ..
2.1.d:
रिपुः सूर्यस्तयारामो यक्षोऽनंतः सरस्वती ॥
ब्राह्मी च यक्षिणी चैव गायत्री नवमी स्मृता ॥ 61 ॥
2.1.m: Enemy, Sun, then Delight, Yakṣa, Ananta, Sarasvatī, / Brāhmī, and Yakṣiṇī, and Gāyatrī is remembered as the ninth.

2.1.s:
viṣṇvante ca bhavenmuktiḥ sūryāṃ'te pādavicyutiḥ ..
ripuṃkaraṃ bhavettasya yakṣe durgatimādiśet .. 62 ..
2.1.d:
विष्ण्वन्ते च भवेन्मुक्तिः सूर्यांऽते पादविच्युतिः ॥
रिपुंकरं भवेत्तस्य यक्षे दुर्गतिमादिशेत् ॥ 62 ॥
2.1.m: At the end of Viṣṇu there will be liberation; at the end of the Sun, deviation of the foot; / it becomes an enemy-maker for him; at the Yakṣa, one should designate an evil path.

2.1.s:
anaṃte vipulā kīrtiḥ sarasvatyāṃ dhanāgamaḥ ..
brāhmyā brahmatvamāpnoti yakṣiṇyā yakṣamandiram .. 63 ..
2.1.d:
अनंते विपुला कीर्तिः सरस्वत्यां धनागमः ॥
ब्राह्म्या ब्रह्मत्वमाप्नोति यक्षिण्या यक्षमन्दिरम् ॥ 63 ॥
2.1.m: In Ananta there is abundant fame; in Sarasvatī, the acquisition of wealth; / through Brāhmī one attains the state of Brahman; through Yakṣiṇī, the abode of Yakṣas;

2.1.s:
muktimāpnoti gāyatryā iti paṃktiphalodayaḥ ..
caturdhā pratibhaktiḥ syātpustakaṃ dharmanirmitam .. 64 ..
2.1.d:
मुक्तिमाप्नोति गायत्र्या इति पंक्तिफलोदयः ॥
चतुर्धा प्रतिभक्तिः स्यात्पुस्तकं धर्मनिर्मितम् ॥ 64 ॥
2.1.m: one attains liberation through Gāyatrī: such is the arising of the fruit of the lines. / There should be a fourfold division of parts; the manuscript is fashioned by Dharma:

2.1.s:
brahmendravaiṣṇavaṃ śaivaṃ śāktikaṃ ca maheśvarī ..
brahmarūpaṃ cetihāsamaiṃdraṃ rāmāyaṇātmakam..65..
2.1.d:
ब्रह्मेन्द्रवैष्णवं शैवं शाक्तिकं च महेश्वरी ॥
ब्रह्मरूपं चेतिहासमैंद्रं रामायणात्मकम्॥65॥
2.1.m: of Brahmā, Indra, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and of Śakti, O Maheśvarī; / having the form of Brahmā is the Itihāsa; belonging to Indra is that consisting of the Rāmāyaṇa;

2.1.s:
vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ daivaṃ yacchaivaṃ tallalāṭakam ..
pāvako'sya tathā mūle madhye bhāge śatakratuḥ .. 66 ..
2.1.d:
वैष्णवं परमं दैवं यच्छैवं तल्ललाटकम् ॥
पावकोऽस्य तथा मूले मध्ये भागे शतक्रतुः ॥ 66 ॥
2.1.m: the Vaiṣṇava is the supreme deity; that which is Śaiva is the forehead; / Fire is at its base, and in the middle part is Śatakratu;

2.1.s:
agre sthitā grahāḥ sarve diśāmīśāstathā dvijāḥ ..
meruḥ sumeruruddiṣṭaḥ saṃgavānkāma ucyate .. 67 ..
2.1.d:
अग्रे स्थिता ग्रहाः सर्वे दिशामीशास्तथा द्विजाः ॥
मेरुः सुमेरुरुद्दिष्टः संगवान्काम उच्यते ॥ 67 ॥
2.1.m: at the front stand all the planets, as well as the lords of the directions, O twice-born; / Meru is designated as Sumeru; Saṃgavat is called Desire;

2.1.s:
dvāvāpṛthivyau pātālaṃ tasyāṃtaḥ samudāhṛtam ..
paurāṇikakathāyuktapustako devapūjitaḥ .. 68 ..
2.1.d:
द्वावापृथिव्यौ पातालं तस्यांतः समुदाहृतम् ॥
पौराणिककथायुक्तपुस्तको देवपूजितः ॥ 68 ॥
2.1.m: Heaven and Earth and the netherworld are declared to be within it. / A manuscript containing the stories of the Purāṇas is worshipped by the gods;

2.1.s:
na śasyaḥ pūjanīyaśca gṛhe sthāpyeta mānavaḥ ..
yo yasmai śūdro viprāya vṛttiṃ dadyācca mānavaḥ .. 69 ..
2.1.d:
न शस्यः पूजनीयश्च गृहे स्थाप्येत मानवः ॥
यो यस्मै शूद्रो विप्राय वृत्तिं दद्याच्च मानवः ॥ 69 ॥
2.1.m: a man [who does so] is not to be punished, and it should be worshipped when kept in the house. / Whatever Śūdra or man should give a livelihood to a brāhmaṇa,

2.1.s:
sa yāti brahmasadanaṃ maṇivartmādikuṭṭimam ..
na śasyaḥ pūjanīyaśca gṛhe sthāpyeta mānavaḥ ..2.1.7.70..
2.1.d:
स याति ब्रह्मसदनं मणिवर्त्मादिकुट्टिमम् ॥
न शस्यः पूजनीयश्च गृहे स्थाप्येत मानवः ॥2.1.7.70॥
2.1.m: he goes to the abode of Brahman, inlaid with paths of gems and the like. / A man [who does so] is not to be punished, and it should be worshipped when kept in the house.

2.1.s:
patrāṇāmagrabhāge tu vedhaṃ kuryātsuvartulam ..
śravaṇāttatra mātreṇa tatra padmaṃ ca vartulam .. 71 ..
2.1.d:
पत्राणामग्रभागे तु वेधं कुर्यात्सुवर्तुलम् ॥
श्रवणात्तत्र मात्रेण तत्र पद्मं च वर्तुलम् ॥ 71 ॥
2.1.m: At the front part of the leaves, one should make a very round hole; / merely by hearing thereof, there is a round lotus;

2.1.s:
saṃhitāgamatantreṣu prativedhe ca saṃkulam ..
prakuryāccittatāpena tataḥ śakrapuraṃ vrajet .. 72 ..
2.1.d:
संहितागमतन्त्रेषु प्रतिवेधे च संकुलम् ॥
प्रकुर्याच्चित्ततापेन ततः शक्रपुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 72 ॥
2.1.m: in the collections, Āgamas, and Tantras, at each piercing, it is crowded; / one should make it with anguish of heart, and then go to the city of Śakra.

2.1.s:
madhyaṃ tasya haredāyuḥ pārśvavedhaḥ śivaṃ haret ..
yugmavedhe jayaṃ dadyādekavedhe balirbhavet ..73..
2.1.d:
मध्यं तस्य हरेदायुः पार्श्ववेधः शिवं हरेत् ॥
युग्मवेधे जयं दद्यादेकवेधे बलिर्भवेत् ॥73॥
2.1.m: The middle [hole] takes away his lifespan; a side-hole takes away auspiciousness; / in a pair of holes, he grants victory; in a single hole, there will be an offering.

2.1.s:
paramaṃ prakṛterguhyaṃ sthānaṃ devairvinirmitam ..
pūrayettāmraliṃgena atha raityamayena vā ..74..
2.1.d:
परमं प्रकृतेर्गुह्यं स्थानं देवैर्विनिर्मितम् ॥
पूरयेत्ताम्रलिंगेन अथ रैत्यमयेन वा ॥74॥
2.1.m: The supreme secret place of Prakṛti was fashioned by the gods; / one should fill it with a copper liṅga, or else one made of brass.

2.1.s:
aśakto bilvakāṣṭhasya tathā śrīparṇikasya ca ..
na kāṣṭhasya navaṃ śasyaṃ na lauhaṃ yojayetkvacit .. 75 ..
2.1.d:
अशक्तो बिल्वकाष्ठस्य तथा श्रीपर्णिकस्य च ॥
न काष्ठस्य नवं शस्यं न लौहं योजयेत्क्वचित् ॥ 75 ॥
2.1.m: If unable, [one should fill it with a liṅga] of bilva wood or of śrīparṇikā wood; / fresh [wood] of a tree is not praised, nor should one ever join iron to it.

2.1.s:
prāgāraṃbhaślokaśataṃ dharmaśāstrasya vai likhet ..
saṃhitāyāṃ purāṇāyāṃ yugmakalpaṃ tadardhakam.. 76 ..
2.1.d:
प्रागारंभश्लोकशतं धर्मशास्त्रस्य वै लिखेत् ॥
संहितायां पुराणायां युग्मकल्पं तदर्धकम्॥ 76 ॥
2.1.m: Before beginning, one should indeed write a hundred verses of the Dharmaśāstra; / in an ancient collection, half of that constitutes a pair of kalpas.

2.1.s:
brahmacaryeṇa vilikhenna mohādbrahmaṇaḥ kvacit ..
tathāpi cākhilavyāsa lekhanātsaṃtatikṣayaḥ .. 77 ..
2.1.d:
ब्रह्मचर्येण विलिखेन्न मोहाद्ब्रह्मणः क्वचित् ॥
तथापि चाखिलव्यास लेखनात्संततिक्षयः ॥ 77 ॥
2.1.m: One should copy it with celibacy, never out of delusion regarding Brahman; / even so, from writing the entire Vyāsa [corpus], there is loss of offspring.

2.1.s:
anāmātve hemayutāṃ balākaṃ cittameva ca ..
na likhetkhilabhāgaṃ ca harivaṃśasya sattamāḥ .. 78 ..
2.1.d:
अनामात्वे हेमयुतां बलाकं चित्तमेव च ॥
न लिखेत्खिलभागं च हरिवंशस्य सत्तमाः ॥ 78 ॥
2.1.m: In the ring finger, endowed with gold, and the crane of the mind; / O best of men, one should not write the supplementary section of the Harivaṃśa;

2.1.s:
gāruḍasya ca skāndasya na likhenmadhyatantrakam ..
lekhanaṃ harivaṃśasya vratastho niyamairyutaḥ .. 79 ..
2.1.d:
गारुडस्य च स्कान्दस्य न लिखेन्मध्यतन्त्रकम् ॥
लेखनं हरिवंशस्य व्रतस्थो नियमैर्युतः ॥ 79 ॥
2.1.m: nor should one write the middle Tantra of the Gāruḍa and the Skānda. / One engaged in copying the Harivaṃśa should be established in vows and endowed with restraints.

2.1.s:
gṛhastho na likhedgraṃthaṃ likhecca mathurāṃ vinā ..
lekhane pārijātasya matsya māṃsāśinaṃ likhet .. 2.1.7.80 ..
2.1.d:
गृहस्थो न लिखेद्ग्रंथं लिखेच्च मथुरां विना ॥
लेखने पारिजातस्य मत्स्य मांसाशिनं लिखेत् ॥ 2.1.7.80 ॥
2.1.m: A householder should not copy the book, or he should copy it except for Mathurā. / In the copying of the Pārijāta, one who eats fish and meat should copy it.

2.1.s:
vālmīkisaṃhitāyāśca lekhane ca tathā kvacit ..
stotramātraṃ likhedviprā avratī na likhetkvacit .. 81 ..
2.1.d:
वाल्मीकिसंहितायाश्च लेखने च तथा क्वचित् ॥
स्तोत्रमात्रं लिखेद्विप्रा अव्रती न लिखेत्क्वचित् ॥ 81 ॥
2.1.m: And in the copying of the Vālmīkisaṃhitā likewise at any time, / a Brahmin may write only a hymn of praise; one who has not taken a vow should never write it.

2.1.s: abrāhmaṇena likhitaṃ niṣphalaṃ parikīrtitam.. 82 ..
2.1.d: अब्राह्मणेन लिखितं निष्फलं परिकीर्तितम्॥ 82 ॥
2.1.m: What is written by a non-Brahmin is proclaimed to be fruitless.

2.1.s:
patitairapi pākhaṃḍairna strī vilikhati kvacit ..
durvicāro duṣṭabhāryo durmatiścāpi lekhakaḥ ..
na likheddharmaśāstraṃ ca purāṇaṃ stotrasaṃhitam .. 83 ..
2.1.d:
पतितैरपि पाखंडैर्न स्त्री विलिखति क्वचित् ॥
दुर्विचारो दुष्टभार्यो दुर्मतिश्चापि लेखकः ॥
न लिखेद्धर्मशास्त्रं च पुराणं स्तोत्रसंहितम् ॥ 83 ॥
2.1.m: Nor should a woman ever copy [it], nor outcasts, nor heretics. / A scribe who has evil thoughts, a wicked wife, or an evil mind, / should not write a Dharmaśāstra, a Purāṇa, or a collection of hymns of praise.

2.1.s:
tacca prāpnuvankartavyaṃ suvarṇarajatasya ca ..
kajjalairmalinaṃ kuryānmantrī niryāsamaṃtritaiḥ .. 84 ..
2.1.d:
तच्च प्राप्नुवन्कर्तव्यं सुवर्णरजतस्य च ॥
कज्जलैर्मलिनं कुर्यान्मन्त्री निर्यासमंत्रितैः ॥ 84 ॥
2.1.m: And acquiring that of gold and silver, it should be prepared; / with soot the mantrin should darken [the ink], consecrated with tree resins,

2.1.s:
jīvantyāśca rasairyuktairmaṇikardamalolupaiḥ ..
vaṃgunyānmukhyāyutairvāpi pītayogairathāpi vā .. 85 ..
2.1.d:
जीवन्त्याश्च रसैर्युक्तैर्मणिकर्दमलोलुपैः ॥
वंगुन्यान्मुख्यायुतैर्वापि पीतयोगैरथापि वा ॥ 85 ॥
2.1.m: mixed with the juices of jīvantī, lustrous with jewel-slurry, / or mixed with prime vaṅgunya, or with yellow compounds.

2.1.s:
kṛṣṇe vāyupradaṃ vidyātpīte vāyukṣayo bhavet ..
rakte puṣṭimavāpnoti kṛṣṇe ca saṃpadāgamaḥ ..86..
2.1.d:
कृष्णे वायुप्रदं विद्यात्पीते वायुक्षयो भवेत् ॥
रक्ते पुष्टिमवाप्नोति कृष्णे च संपदागमः ॥86॥
2.1.m: With black [ink] one should know it bestows air; with yellow there is loss of air; / with red one obtains nourishment, and with black comes an influx of wealth.

2.1.s:
itihāsapurāṇānāṃ vilikhedyanmukhācchṛṇu ..
vāyavyādimukhenaiva kāṣṭhavedaṃ ca saṃlikhet .. 87..
2.1.d:
इतिहासपुराणानां विलिखेद्यन्मुखाच्छृणु ॥
वायव्यादिमुखेनैव काष्ठवेदं च संलिखेत् ॥ 87॥
2.1.m: Hear facing which direction one should write the Itihāsas and Purāṇas: / facing the northwest and other directions, one should write the wooden Veda.

2.1.s:
pūrvāmukhe cārthahāniruttare ca mukhe śriyaḥ ..
maraṇaṃ dakṣiṇāsye tu paścimāsye dhanakṣayaḥ ..88..
2.1.d:
पूर्वामुखे चार्थहानिरुत्तरे च मुखे श्रियः ॥
मरणं दक्षिणास्ये तु पश्चिमास्ये धनक्षयः ॥88॥
2.1.m: Facing east there is loss of wealth, and facing north [there is] prosperity; / but death [comes] when facing south, and loss of wealth when facing west.

2.1.s:
pitṛmedhe bhuvaḥ kaṃpe na likhejjanmavāsare ..
aśauce mṛtake sūtāvamāyāṃ ravisaṃkrame .. 89 ..
2.1.d:
पितृमेधे भुवः कंपे न लिखेज्जन्मवासरे ॥
अशौचे मृतके सूतावमायां रविसंक्रमे ॥ 89 ॥
2.1.m: At a funeral rite, during an earthquake, and on one's birthday one should not write; / during ritual impurity caused by death or childbirth, on a new-moon day, or at a solar transit.

2.1.s:
atra lekhāddaridraḥ syāttathā putravināśanam ..
baladharmaṃ kṣayaṃ caiva tasmādyatnena varjayet .. 2.1.7.90 ..
2.1.d:
अत्र लेखाद्दरिद्रः स्यात्तथा पुत्रविनाशनम् ॥
बलधर्मं क्षयं चैव तस्माद्यत्नेन वर्जयेत् ॥ 2.1.7.90 ॥
2.1.m: From writing at these [times], one becomes poor, and likewise there is the destruction of sons, / and the loss of strength and virtue; therefore, one should avoid it with effort.

2.1.s:
pitṛśrāddhadine lekhaḥ kulakṣayakaro bhavet ..
ekarātraṃ bhuvaḥ kaṃpe tasmim̐llekhe dhanakṣayaḥ ..91..
2.1.d:
पितृश्राद्धदिने लेखः कुलक्षयकरो भवेत् ॥
एकरात्रं भुवः कंपे तस्मिम्̐ल्लेखे धनक्षयः ॥91॥
2.1.m: Writing on the day of the ancestral śrāddha causes the ruin of the lineage; / during an earthquake for one night, writing in that [period] causes loss of wealth.

2.1.s:
aśoce'pi daridraḥ syājjanmāhe cāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ ..
lipicchaṃdaḥ padajñaśca yuvā dhīmāñjitāsanaḥ ..92..
2.1.d:
अशोचेऽपि दरिद्रः स्याज्जन्माहे चायुषः क्षयः ॥
लिपिच्छंदः पदज्ञश्च युवा धीमाञ्जितासनः ॥92॥
2.1.m: During ritual impurity as well one becomes poor, and on one's birthday there is loss of lifespan. / Knowing scripts, meters, and words, young, intelligent, having mastered his posture,

2.1.s:
drutalekhī ca tejasvī yo lekhayati lekhakaḥ ..
asaṃvalitabhāvena ūrdhvordhve syātsamākṣaram ..93..
2.1.d:
द्रुतलेखी च तेजस्वी यो लेखयति लेखकः ॥
असंवलितभावेन ऊर्ध्वोर्ध्वे स्यात्समाक्षरम् ॥93॥
2.1.m: writing swiftly, and radiant—such a scribe as he causes to write, / without crowding, the letters should be uniform line above line.

2.1.s:
lipiyuktaḥ samāyuktaḥ evāgamalekhakaḥ ..
nāṃdīnāgarakairvarṇaiḥ śuddhanāgarakairapi .. 94 ..
2.1.d:
लिपियुक्तः समायुक्तः एवागमलेखकः ॥
नांदीनागरकैर्वर्णैः शुद्धनागरकैरपि ॥ 94 ॥
2.1.m: Endowed with proper script, evenly composed, thus is a scribe of the āgamas; / with Nāndīnāgarī characters, or with pure Nāgarī,

2.1.s:
kāmarūpākṣarairvāpi yāvacca saṃhitāgaṇaḥ ..
acetanena likhitaṃ yāvatkālaṃ pravartate .. 95 ..
2.1.d:
कामरूपाक्षरैर्वापि यावच्च संहितागणः ॥
अचेतनेन लिखितं यावत्कालं प्रवर्तते ॥ 95 ॥
2.1.m: or with Kāmarūpī characters, as long as the collection of saṃhitās [exists]. / As long as that which is written by an inanimate [hand] endures,

2.1.s:
yāvadakṣarasaṃsthānaṃ tāvatsvarge mahīyate ..
anukto vācayedyastu dharmaśāstrasya vetanam .. 96 ..
2.1.d:
यावदक्षरसंस्थानं तावत्स्वर्गे महीयते ॥
अनुक्तो वाचयेद्यस्तु धर्मशास्त्रस्य वेतनम् ॥ 96 ॥
2.1.m: for as long as the letters remain, for so long is one glorified in heaven. / But whoever recites unasked, [taking] a fee for a Dharmaśāstra,

2.1.s:
likhitvā yastu pāpātmā yāvadakṣara saṃkhyayā ..
tāvatkālaṃ tu narake pacyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 97 ..
2.1.d:
लिखित्वा यस्तु पापात्मा यावदक्षर संख्यया ॥
तावत्कालं तु नरके पच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ 97 ॥
2.1.m: having written [it], that sinful soul, for as many as the number of letters, / for that much time is cooked in hell; there is no doubt about this.

2.1.s:
kuṭuṃbabharaṇārthaṃ tu gṛhṇīyādvāpi vetanam ..
na jīvati sa duṣṭātmā dhanavastraphalānvitaḥ .. 98 ..
2.1.d:
कुटुंबभरणार्थं तु गृह्णीयाद्वापि वेतनम् ॥
न जीवति स दुष्टात्मा धनवस्त्रफलान्वितः ॥ 98 ॥
2.1.m: Or if he takes a fee for the sake of maintaining his family, / that wicked-souled man, [though] possessed of wealth, garments, and fruits, does not live long.

2.1.s:
patitairaṃtyajairmlecchai rogī kuṣṭhī kṣayī tathā ..
rogī śilīpadaiścaiva mūko'pi dharmasaṃhataḥ .. 99 ..
2.1.d:
पतितैरंत्यजैर्म्लेच्छै रोगी कुष्ठी क्षयी तथा ॥
रोगी शिलीपदैश्चैव मूकोऽपि धर्मसंहतः ॥ 99 ॥
2.1.m: By outcasts, untouchables, mlecchas, the diseased, lepers, and those with consumption, / or those afflicted with elephantiasis, or even a mute person deprived of virtue—

2.1.s:
etairvilikhitaṃ yacca dhārayenna gṛhāśramī ..
anāyuṣyakaraṃ yasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet .. 2.1.7.100 ..
2.1.d:
एतैर्विलिखितं यच्च धारयेन्न गृहाश्रमी ॥
अनायुष्यकरं यस्मात्तस्मात्तत्परिवर्जयेत् ॥ 2.1.7.100 ॥
2.1.m: whatever has been written by these, a householder should not keep; / because it diminishes lifespan, he should therefore avoid it.

2.1.s:
hīnāṃgā pratimā caiva pustakaṃ mānahīnakam ..
na kalau dhārayeddeha anāyuṣyakaraṃ bhavet .. 101 ..
2.1.d:
हीनांगा प्रतिमा चैव पुस्तकं मानहीनकम् ॥
न कलौ धारयेद्देह अनायुष्यकरं भवेत् ॥ 101 ॥
2.1.m: An image with missing limbs and a book lacking proper measure, / one should not keep in the Kali [age]; it causes a shortening of lifespan.

2.1.s:
dvātriṃśadagulairyuktaṃ kartavyaṃ pustakottamam ..
sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ khyāto dhāraṇācca kuto'pyalam .. 102 ..
2.1.d:
द्वात्रिंशदगुलैर्युक्तं कर्तव्यं पुस्तकोत्तमम् ॥
स वै नारायणः ख्यातो धारणाच्च कुतोऽप्यलम् ॥ 102 ॥
2.1.m: An excellent book should be made thirty-two aṅgulas in size; / that indeed is known as Nārāyaṇa, and from keeping it, what else could be needed?

2.1.s:
catuviśāṃgulaṃ yacca tadvai svadhanamucyate ..
śaṃkaraḥ sa tu vijñeyo dharmakāmaphalapradaḥ .. 103 ..
2.1.d:
चतुविशांगुलं यच्च तद्वै स्वधनमुच्यते ॥
शंकरः स तु विज्ञेयो धर्मकामफलप्रदः ॥ 103 ॥
2.1.m: That which is twenty-four aṅgulas is called one's own wealth; / that is to be known as Śaṅkara, bestowing the fruits of virtue and desire.

2.1.s:
aṣṭāṃgulaṃ bhavedyacca tatkaniṣṭhamihocyate ..
tasmādbrahmamayaṃ jñeyaṃ trivarga phaladāyakam .. 104 ..
2.1.d:
अष्टांगुलं भवेद्यच्च तत्कनिष्ठमिहोच्यते ॥
तस्माद्ब्रह्ममयं ज्ञेयं त्रिवर्ग फलदायकम् ॥ 104 ॥
2.1.m: That which is eight aṅgulas is here said to be the smallest; / therefore it should be known as consisting of Brahmā, bestowing the fruits of the three aims of life.

2.1.s:
tāḍitā jalapatre ca atha vā cāgurutvaci ..
etyāḥ patrakṛte mānaṃ bhūrje mānaṃ na vidyate .. 105 ..
2.1.d:
ताडिता जलपत्रे च अथ वा चागुरुत्वचि ॥
एत्याः पत्रकृते मानं भूर्जे मानं न विद्यते ॥ 105 ॥
2.1.m: On palm-leaf, on water-leaf, or on the bark of aguru— / this is the measure for leaves made [of these]; on birch bark there is no fixed measure.

2.1.s:
dvādaśāṃgulakaṃ yacca bhūrjataiḍādinirmitam ..
aṃgulānāṃ pramāṇaṃ yattenāpi jñānapustakam .. 106 ..
2.1.d:
द्वादशांगुलकं यच्च भूर्जतैडादिनिर्मितम् ॥
अंगुलानां प्रमाणं यत्तेनापि ज्ञानपुस्तकम् ॥ 106 ॥
2.1.m: That which is twelve aṅgulas, made of birch bark, palm, or the like, / that measure of aṅgulas is also for a book of knowledge.

2.1.s:
hastasaṃsthāpite tasya tenāyuṣyakaraṃ bhavet ..
dharmaśāstrasya sāhasre dharmaśāstrasya vetanam .. 107 ..
2.1.d:
हस्तसंस्थापिते तस्य तेनायुष्यकरं भवेत् ॥
धर्मशास्त्रस्य साहस्रे धर्मशास्त्रस्य वेतनम् ॥ 107 ॥
2.1.m: When placed in his hand, it becomes a promoter of lifespan for him. / For a thousand [verses] of Dharmaśāstra, the wage for a Dharmaśāstra

2.1.s:
svargamārgasya gamane bhārate ca tadardhakam ..
harivaṃśe svarṇamāne kṛte mūlyasahasrake .. 108 ..
2.1.d:
स्वर्गमार्गस्य गमने भारते च तदर्धकम् ॥
हरिवंशे स्वर्णमाने कृते मूल्यसहस्रके ॥ 108 ॥
2.1.m: for going on the path to heaven, and for the Bhārata half of that; / for the Harivaṃśa, when measured in gold, a price of a thousand is set.

2.1.s:
yugeyuge pādahīnaṃ dharmaṃ kuryādyathāruci ..
praṇamya śirasā sarvānvyāsādīnsaṃhitāśrutān .. 109 ..
2.1.d:
युगेयुगे पादहीनं धर्मं कुर्याद्यथारुचि ॥
प्रणम्य शिरसा सर्वान्व्यासादीन्संहिताश्रुतान् ॥ 109 ॥
2.1.m: In each successive age, reduced by a quarter, one should perform virtue according to one's inclination. / Bowing with one's head to all the revealed collections beginning with Vyāsa,

2.1.s:
jaiminiṃ ca tato vyāsaṃ śaṃkaraṃ ca tathā harim ...
namaskāramathaiṣāṃ tu ādimadhyāvasānake .. 2.1.7.110 ..
2.1.d:
जैमिनिं च ततो व्यासं शंकरं च तथा हरिम् ॥।
नमस्कारमथैषां तु आदिमध्यावसानके ॥ 2.1.7.110 ॥
2.1.m: and then to Jaimini, Vyāsa, Śaṅkara, and Hari— / salutations to them at the beginning, middle, and end.

2.1.s:
tataḥ pravācayedvipro dharmaśāstrārthakovidaḥ ..
alakṣitamanāstadvadyadrūpaṃ spaṣṭamuccaran.. 111 ..
2.1.d:
ततः प्रवाचयेद्विप्रो धर्मशास्त्रार्थकोविदः ॥
अलक्षितमनास्तद्वद्यद्रूपं स्पष्टमुच्चरन्॥ 111 ॥
2.1.m: Then the Brahmin, skilled in the meaning of the Dharmaśāstras, should recite, / with an attentive mind, clearly articulating the form as it is,

2.1.s:
asaṃyuktākṣarapadaṃ spaṣṭabhāgasamanvitam ..
saptasvarasamāyuktaṃ saptanādavibhūṣitam .. 112 ..
2.1.d:
असंयुक्ताक्षरपदं स्पष्टभागसमन्वितम् ॥
सप्तस्वरसमायुक्तं सप्तनादविभूषितम् ॥ 112 ॥
2.1.m: with words having uncompounded syllables, endowed with clear divisions, / accompanied by the seven musical notes, adorned with the seven resonance tones.

2.1.s:
sāmagāthāḥ samāśritya rāgayuktāṃtaraṃ paṭhet..
maṇivāro dhanaṃ yatsyādgaurāṃdhāṃ saṃtikastathā .. 113 ..
2.1.d:
सामगाथाः समाश्रित्य रागयुक्तांतरं पठेत्॥
मणिवारो धनं यत्स्याद्गौरांधां संतिकस्तथा ॥ 113 ॥
2.1.m: Resorting to the Sāman chants, he should recite with melodic modulations in between: / Maṇivāra, Dhana, and likewise Gaurāndhā, Santika,

2.1.s:
śrīrāgaścaiva hillolarāgo vājāvikastathā ..
evaṃ prakramamāṇena śṛṇuyāddharmasaṃhitāḥ .. 114 ..
2.1.d:
श्रीरागश्चैव हिल्लोलरागो वाजाविकस्तथा ॥
एवं प्रक्रममाणेन शृणुयाद्धर्मसंहिताः ॥ 114 ॥
2.1.m: and Śrīrāga, Hillolarāga, and Vājāvika. / In this sequential manner one should listen to the collections of virtue.

2.1.s:
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraścāpi viśeṣataḥ ..
aśvamedhamavāpnoti sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..
pāpaiḥ pramucyate sarvairmahāpuṇyaṃ ca viṃdati .. 115 ..
2.1.d:
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रश्चापि विशेषतः ॥
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥
पापैः प्रमुच्यते सर्वैर्महापुण्यं च विंदति ॥ 115 ॥
2.1.m: A Brahmin, a Kṣatriya, a Vaiśya, and especially a Śūdra, / obtains [the fruit of] an aśvamedha, obtains all desires, / is freed from all sins, and attains great merit.

2.1.s:
śūdrāṇāṃ purato vaiśyo vaiśyānāṃ kṣatriyaḥ paraḥ ..
kṣatriyāṃte tathā viprāḥ śṛṇuyuścāgrataḥ sadā .. 116 ..
2.1.d:
शूद्राणां पुरतो वैश्यो वैश्यानां क्षत्रियः परः ॥
क्षत्रियांते तथा विप्राः शृणुयुश्चाग्रतः सदा ॥ 116 ॥
2.1.m: In front of the Śūdras the Vaiśya, beyond the Vaiśyas the Kṣatriya, / and next to the Kṣatriya the Brahmins should always listen in the front.

2.1.s:
na śūdraḥ kathayeddharmāṃstapaadhyāpane tathā ..
naihikatvaṃ paratvaṃ ca na śubhaṃ na parāṃ gatim .. 117 ..
2.1.d:
न शूद्रः कथयेद्धर्मांस्तपअध्यापने तथा ॥
नैहिकत्वं परत्वं च न शुभं न परां गतिम् ॥ 117 ॥
2.1.m: A Śūdra must not expound duties, nor engage in austerity and teaching; / [from that he gains] neither this world nor the next, neither auspiciousness nor the highest state.

2.1.s:
śūdreṇādhigataṃ nāsti viśeṣācchabdalakṣaṇam ..
yaddvijasya kṛto dāso brahmaṇā'vyaktayoninā ..118..
2.1.d:
शूद्रेणाधिगतं नास्ति विशेषाच्छब्दलक्षणम् ॥
यद्द्विजस्य कृतो दासो ब्रह्मणाऽव्यक्तयोनिना ॥118॥
2.1.m: Nothing has been mastered by a Śūdra, especially the grammatical characteristics of words, / since he was made a servant of the twice-born by Brahmā of unmanifest origin.

2.1.s:
śvaśṛgālakharīkṣīramapeyaṃ hi yathā bhavet ..
evaṃ śūdramukhāddharmā na grāhyāḥ śabdasaṃskṛtāḥ ..119..
2.1.d:
श्वशृगालखरीक्षीरमपेयं हि यथा भवेत् ॥
एवं शूद्रमुखाद्धर्मा न ग्राह्याः शब्दसंस्कृताः ॥119॥
2.1.m: Just as the milk of a bitch, a female jackal, or a she-ass is undrinkable, / even so teachings refined with words are not to be received from the mouth of a Śūdra.

2.1.s:
amedhyaṃ śudhyate toyaiḥ śūdraḥ śrotā hi śudhyati ..
evaṃ śūdro'pyaśuciḥ syādyadi vyākaraṇārthavit ..2.1.7.120..
2.1.d:
अमेध्यं शुध्यते तोयैः शूद्रः श्रोता हि शुध्यति ॥
एवं शूद्रोऽप्यशुचिः स्याद्यदि व्याकरणार्थवित् ॥2.1.7.120॥
2.1.m: Impurity is purified with water, and a Śūdra is indeed purified as a listener; / even so, a Śūdra would still be impure if he knows the meaning of grammar.

2.1.s:
yaḥ śūdra uddiśeddharmaṃ tathā cāgamavaidikam ..
sa vai vadhyo nareṃdreṇa jihvāṃ cakreṇa chedayet .. ... 121 ..
2.1.d:
यः शूद्र उद्दिशेद्धर्मं तथा चागमवैदिकम् ॥
स वै वध्यो नरेंद्रेण जिह्वां चक्रेण छेदयेत् ॥ ॥। 121 ॥
2.1.m: A Śūdra who teaches virtue and Vedic āgama, / he is indeed to be executed by the king; he should cut off his tongue with a discus.

2.1.s:
budhyamānaḥ sadā hyarthaṃ graṃthārthaṃ kṛtsnameva ca ..
ya evaṃ kathayetsamyaksa vipro vyāsa ucyate .. 122 ..
2.1.d:
बुध्यमानः सदा ह्यर्थं ग्रंथार्थं कृत्स्नमेव च ॥
य एवं कथयेत्सम्यक्स विप्रो व्यास उच्यते ॥ 122 ॥
2.1.m: Constantly understanding the meaning and the entire sense of the book, / he who thus properly expounds it, that Brahmin is called a Vyāsa.

2.1.s:
vasetsa pattane grāme puṇye deśe sa kīrtitaḥ ..
te dhanyāste kṛtātmānaste kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ ..
vasaṃti pattane tasminvyākhyātā yatra saṃvaset .. 123 ..
2.1.d:
वसेत्स पत्तने ग्रामे पुण्ये देशे स कीर्तितः ॥
ते धन्यास्ते कृतात्मानस्ते कृतार्था न संशयः ॥
वसंति पत्तने तस्मिन्व्याख्याता यत्र संवसेत् ॥ 123 ॥
2.1.m: He may dwell in a city or a village; that region is proclaimed as holy. / They are blessed, they have accomplished their souls, they have achieved their goals, no doubt, / who dwell in that city where an expounder resides.

2.1.s:
yathārkahīnaṃ divasaścaṃdrahīnā yathā niśā ..
na rarāja sabhā tadvadvyāsena rahitā dvijāḥ..124..
2.1.d:
यथार्कहीनं दिवसश्चंद्रहीना यथा निशा ॥
न रराज सभा तद्वद्व्यासेन रहिता द्विजाः॥124॥
2.1.m: Just as a day is without the sun, just as a night is without the moon, / so an assembly does not shine when deprived of a Vyāsa, O twice-born.

2.1.s:
yadgṛhe naiva śiśavo na rarāja gṛhaṃ kvacit ..
yathaikato grahāḥ sarve ekatastu divākaraḥ ..
tathaiva sodara gehe dṛṣṭvā puṣkaradarśanam .. 125 ..
aṅkamāhātmyavarṇanam
2.1.d:
यद्गृहे नैव शिशवो न रराज गृहं क्वचित् ॥
यथैकतो ग्रहाः सर्वे एकतस्तु दिवाकरः ॥
तथैव सोदर गेहे दृष्ट्वा पुष्करदर्शनम् ॥ 125 ॥
अङ्कमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
In whatever house there are no children, that house does not shine anywhere. / Just as all the planets are on one side, while the sun is on the other, / in the very same way, having seen the sight of Puṣkara in the brother's house.
Description of the Greatness of Numbers

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śṛṇudhvaṃ viprasaṃghātāḥ purāṇaṃ devasaṃmatam..
yacchrutvā mucyate pāpātpuruṣo brahmahatyayā..1..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणुध्वं विप्रसंघाताः पुराणं देवसंमतम्॥
यच्छ्रुत्वा मुच्यते पापात्पुरुषो ब्रह्महत्यया॥1॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / Listen, O assemblies of Brahmins, to the Purāṇa approved by the gods, / upon hearing which a man is freed from the sin of killing a Brahmin.

2.1.s:
tṛtīyaṃ śaivamākhyātaṃ tato bhāgavataṃ param..
paṃcamaṃ ca tathā mātsyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ṣaṣṭhamucyate ..2..
2.1.d:
तृतीयं शैवमाख्यातं ततो भागवतं परम्॥
पंचमं च तथा मात्स्यं भविष्यं षष्ठमुच्यते ॥2॥
2.1.m: The third is declared to be the Śaiva, and after that the supreme Bhāgavata; / the fifth is the Mātsya, and the Bhaviṣya is said to be the sixth.

2.1.s:
asāmarthye ca mātsyoktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca bhaviṣyakam ..
bhārate cāpi parvaṃ ca śāṃtibhaiṣmīyakaṃ tathā .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
असामर्थ्ये च मात्स्योक्तं वैष्णवं च भविष्यकम् ॥
भारते चापि पर्वं च शांतिभैष्मीयकं तथा ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: In case of inability, [study] the one spoken in the Mātsya, the Vaiṣṇava, and the Bhaviṣya, / and in the Mahābhārata the Śānti and the Bhīṣma parvans.

2.1.s:
parāśaramataṃ gṛhyaṃ gobhiloktāni yāni ca ..
kātyāyanoktamaparamabhyasennigamāditaḥ .. 4 ..
2.1.d:
पराशरमतं गृह्यं गोभिलोक्तानि यानि च ॥
कात्यायनोक्तमपरमभ्यसेन्निगमादितः ॥ 4 ॥
2.1.m: One should study the views of Parāśara, the Gṛhya, whatever is spoken by Gobhila, / and other things spoken by Kātyāyana, beginning with the Vedic tradition.

2.1.s:
aṃtareṇāgate martye śāstraṃ nādhyāpayetkvacit ..
ekarātraṃ gate martye trirātramajameṣayoḥ .. 5 ..
2.1.d:
अंतरेणागते मर्त्ये शास्त्रं नाध्यापयेत्क्वचित् ॥
एकरात्रं गते मर्त्ये त्रिरात्रमजमेषयोः ॥ 5 ॥
2.1.m: If an intermediate person has come, one should never teach the scripture. / When a man has passed between, [one should suspend study for] one night; for three nights in the case of a goat or sheep;

2.1.s:
maṃḍūke paṃcarātraṃ tu sarpe rātricatuṣṭayam ..
saṃvatsaraṃ tu turage gaje dvādaśavatsarān .. 6 ..
2.1.d:
मंडूके पंचरात्रं तु सर्पे रात्रिचतुष्टयम् ॥
संवत्सरं तु तुरगे गजे द्वादशवत्सरान् ॥ 6 ॥
2.1.m: for five nights in the case of a frog; but four nights for a snake; / a year for a horse, and twelve years for an elephant;

2.1.s:
māsamekaṃ khare kāke sthānatyāgānna kutracit ..
kerave vā rave caiva ahorātraṃ pracakṣate ..7..
2.1.d:
मासमेकं खरे काके स्थानत्यागान्न कुत्रचित् ॥
केरवे वा रवे चैव अहोरात्रं प्रचक्षते ॥7॥
2.1.m: one month for a donkey; for a crow, [there is no fault] unless there is an abandonment of place anywhere; / but when an owl or a sun is seen, they declare a day and night [of non-study];

2.1.s:
trirātramapi mārjāre nakule mūṣake khare ..
haṃse dinamanadhyāyaṃ kṣudrajaṃtau na dūṣaṇam .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
त्रिरात्रमपि मार्जारे नकुले मूषके खरे ॥
हंसे दिनमनध्यायं क्षुद्रजंतौ न दूषणम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: three nights also for a cat, a mongoose, a mouse, or a donkey; / for a swan, a day of non-study; in the case of small creatures, there is no defect.

2.1.s:
adhyāpayedguroḥ putraṃ jñāninaṃ dhārmikaṃ śucim ..
bhaktaṃ śāṃtaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca jitakrodhaṃ jiteṃdriyam .. 9 ..
2.1.d:
अध्यापयेद्गुरोः पुत्रं ज्ञानिनं धार्मिकं शुचिम् ॥
भक्तं शांतं वैष्णवं च जितक्रोधं जितेंद्रियम् ॥ 9 ॥
2.1.m: One should teach the teacher's son, one who possesses knowledge, is righteous, pure, / devoted, peaceful, a Vaiṣṇava, has conquered anger, and has mastered the senses.

2.1.s:
adhyātmādhyāpayedebhyaḥ śaṭhaṃ pāpaharaṃ dviṣam ..
anyāyenaiva yacchatamabhayaṃ dāṃbhikaṃ dviṣam..2.1.8.10..
2.1.d:
अध्यात्माध्यापयेदेभ्यः शठं पापहरं द्विषम् ॥
अन्यायेनैव यच्छतमभयं दांभिकं द्विषम्॥2.1.8.10॥
2.1.m: One should [not] teach the supreme self to these: a rogue, a remover of virtue, a foe, / one who gives unjustly, an arrogant person, a hypocrite, a malicious one,

2.1.s:
nirarthakaṃ maṃtharaṃ ca viśuśrūṣumayājakam ..
ṣaṇḍaṃ caivānṛjuṃ kruddhaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ vyasanārthinam.. 11 ..
2.1.d:
निरर्थकं मंथरं च विशुश्रूषुमयाजकम् ॥
षण्डं चैवानृजुं क्रुद्धं कृपणं व्यसनार्थिनम्॥ 11 ॥
2.1.m: a useless person, a sluggish one, one unwilling to serve, one who does not perform sacrifices, / an impotent man, one who is dishonest, angry, miserly, or intent on vice,

2.1.s:
niṃdakaṃ cāvidhijñaṃ ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet ..
apracchannanataṃ brūyātputrapautrādikādṛte .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
निंदकं चाविधिज्ञं च दूरतः परिवर्जयेत् ॥
अप्रच्छन्ननतं ब्रूयात्पुत्रपौत्रादिकादृते ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: a censurer, and one ignorant of the rules; one should avoid these from afar. / One should not speak to one who has bowed down without being asked, except for sons, grandsons, and the like.

2.1.s:
vidyayā saha martavyaṃ na dadyācca pṛthagjane ..
ato vidyā vadatyevaṃ pāṭhayaṃtaṃ dvijottamam ..13..
2.1.d:
विद्यया सह मर्तव्यं न दद्याच्च पृथग्जने ॥
अतो विद्या वदत्येवं पाठयंतं द्विजोत्तमम् ॥13॥
2.1.m: One should rather die with one's knowledge than bestow it on an ordinary person. / Therefore Knowledge speaks thus to the excellent twice-born who teaches:

2.1.s:
mā dadyādbhaktihīnāya durjanāya durātmane ..
apramādāya viprāya śucaye brahmacāriṇe .. .. 14..
2.1.d:
मा दद्याद्भक्तिहीनाय दुर्जनाय दुरात्मने ॥
अप्रमादाय विप्राय शुचये ब्रह्मचारिणे ॥ ॥ 14॥
2.1.m: 'Do not give [me] to one devoid of devotion, to a wicked person, or to an evil-natured one; / [give me] to a vigilant Brahmin, pure, a student of the Veda,

2.1.s:
sārthakāya vidhijñāya sādhave dehi sattama ..
dadyādyadi niṣiddhāya vidyādhanamanuttamam .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
सार्थकाय विधिज्ञाय साधवे देहि सत्तम ॥
दद्याद्यदि निषिद्धाय विद्याधनमनुत्तमम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: meaningful, knowing the rules, and virtuous; give [me] to him, O best of beings.' / If one should give the unsurpassed wealth of knowledge to one who is forbidden,

2.1.s:
tayorekataro gacchedacireṇa yamakṣayam ..
anyāyena grahaṃ vidyāmanyaṃ pāṭhayate sukhāt .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
तयोरेकतरो गच्छेदचिरेण यमक्षयम् ॥
अन्यायेन ग्रहं विद्यामन्यं पाठयते सुखात् ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: one of the two would soon go to the abode of Yama. / If one who has grasped knowledge improperly teaches another out of self-interest,

2.1.s:
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ vidyāvarjyaḥ sa ucyate ..
ādhyātmikaṃ vaidikaṃ cālaukikaṃ vātha yo vadet..17..
2.1.d:
स याति नरकं घोरं विद्यावर्ज्यः स उच्यते ॥
आध्यात्मिकं वैदिकं चालौकिकं वाथ यो वदेत्॥17॥
2.1.m: he goes to a dreadful hell; he is called one deprived of knowledge. / Whoever explains that which pertains to the inner self, to the Veda, or to the worldly

2.1.s:
mānamādau praṇamyātha tato'dhīyīta suvrataḥ ..
karmakāṃḍaṃ jyotiṣasya tadvinā na samabhyaset .. 18..
2.1.d:
मानमादौ प्रणम्याथ ततोऽधीयीत सुव्रतः ॥
कर्मकांडं ज्योतिषस्य तद्विना न समभ्यसेत् ॥ 18॥
2.1.m: should first bow down to authority and then study, being of good vows. / Without that, one should not study the ritual section of astronomy/astrology.

2.1.s:
cūtabhogasamabhyāsāddaridraścābhijāyate ..
vādabhāgasamabhyāsāddhananāśāya jāyate ..19..
2.1.d:
चूतभोगसमभ्यासाद्दरिद्रश्चाभिजायते ॥
वादभागसमभ्यासाद्धननाशाय जायते ॥19॥
2.1.m: From the repeated practice of the enjoyment of mangoes, one is born poor; / from the practice of disputation, it leads to the destruction of wealth;

2.1.s:
nidhibhāgasamabhyāsājjāyate nārake kule..
yānyanuktāni śāstrāṇi mānanīyāni yāni ca ..2.1.8.20..
2.1.d:
निधिभागसमभ्यासाज्जायते नारके कुले॥
यान्यनुक्तानि शास्त्राणि माननीयानि यानि च ॥2.1.8.20॥
2.1.m: from the practice of the treasure-section, one is born in a hellish family. / Those scriptures which are unmentioned and those which are to be respected,

2.1.s:
mlecchoktāni mahimnāni nābhyaseddūratastyajet ..
lokānāṃ jñānavṛddhyarthaṃ yaḥ kuryāddharmasaṃgraham .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
म्लेच्छोक्तानि महिम्नानि नाभ्यसेद्दूरतस्त्यजेत् ॥
लोकानां ज्ञानवृद्ध्यर्थं यः कुर्याद्धर्मसंग्रहम् ॥ 21 ॥
2.1.m: or the glories spoken by Mlecchas, one should not study; one should cast them far away. / Whoever makes a compilation of righteousness for the increase of people's knowledge,

2.1.s:
pravartayitvā sa gururbhavejjānapradaḥ pitā ..
jñānadātā ca lokānāṃ teṣu dharmaḥ pravartate..22..
2.1.d:
प्रवर्तयित्वा स गुरुर्भवेज्जानप्रदः पिता ॥
ज्ञानदाता च लोकानां तेषु धर्मः प्रवर्तते॥22॥
2.1.m: having set it in motion, that teacher would become a father who bestows knowledge; / and to the giver of knowledge to the worlds, righteousness proceeds among them.

2.1.s:
nigamānāṃ jyotiṣāṇāṃ vedānāṃ nāṭakasya ca ..
vyākhyānasaṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā kalau nāśamavāpnuyāt ..23..
2.1.d:
निगमानां ज्योतिषाणां वेदानां नाटकस्य च ॥
व्याख्यानसंग्रहं कृत्वा कलौ नाशमवाप्नुयात् ॥23॥
2.1.m: Having made a compilation of commentaries on the Vedic texts, astronomies, the Vedas, / and drama, one would meet destruction in the Kali age.

2.1.s:
vedānāṃ dharbhaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
mīmāṃsājyotiṣāṃ caiva nāṭakānāṃ viraṃcinī..24..
2.1.d:
वेदानां धर्भशास्त्राणां पुराणानां तथैव च ॥
मीमांसाज्योतिषां चैव नाटकानां विरंचिनी॥24॥
2.1.m: For the Vedas, the texts of Dharma, and likewise the Purāṇas, / for Mīmāṃsā, astrology, and dramas, [the term] 'Virañcinī'

2.1.s:
bhāgāvasāne kathitaḥ purāṇādhyāya eva ca ..
puṣpakaśca paricchedaḥ khaṃḍaśca pratikhaṃḍakaḥ ..25..
2.1.d:
भागावसाने कथितः पुराणाध्याय एव च ॥
पुष्पकश्च परिच्छेदः खंडश्च प्रतिखंडकः ॥25॥
2.1.m: is declared at the end of a section; and in a Purāṇa, a chapter; / 'Puṣpaka', a section, a division, and a sub-division;

2.1.s:
vyavahāraścārthaśāstramaśvaśāstrasya caiva hi ..
yasya bhāgāvasāne tu prayoktavyaḥ sa eva hi.. ..26..
2.1.d:
व्यवहारश्चार्थशास्त्रमश्वशास्त्रस्य चैव हि ॥
यस्य भागावसाने तु प्रयोक्तव्यः स एव हि॥ ॥26॥
2.1.m: and in legal procedure, political science, and the treatise on horses, / whatever is to be used at the end of a section, that alone [should be applied].

2.1.s:
tatsaṃgrahepi kavinā niyoktavyaḥ sa eva hi..
yasya nātropadeśe tu pravartayati saṃgrahaḥ ..27..
2.1.d:
तत्संग्रहेपि कविना नियोक्तव्यः स एव हि॥
यस्य नात्रोपदेशे तु प्रवर्तयति संग्रहः ॥27॥
2.1.m: Even in compiling them, the poet must apply only that. / In whose teaching here a compilation is not set in motion,

2.1.s:
tattadakṣarasakhyānāṃ brahmalokānna taccyutiḥ ..
na saṃgrahastaṃtramaṃtre vedamaṃtre ca varjayet ..28..
2.1.d:
तत्तदक्षरसख्यानां ब्रह्मलोकान्न तच्च्युतिः ॥
न संग्रहस्तंत्रमंत्रे वेदमंत्रे च वर्जयेत् ॥28॥
2.1.m: from the enumeration of those respective syllables there is no fall from the world of Brahmā. / One should avoid making a compilation of Tantric mantras and Vedic mantras.

2.1.s:
mohātkṛtvā homadhenuṃ dattvā śuddhirbhaviṣyati ..
kṛtvā cākhyāyikāgraṃthasvarūpānsa divaṃ vrajet .. 29 ...
2.1.d:
मोहात्कृत्वा होमधेनुं दत्त्वा शुद्धिर्भविष्यति ॥
कृत्वा चाख्यायिकाग्रंथस्वरूपान्स दिवं व्रजेत् ॥ 29 ॥।
2.1.m: Having made it out of delusion, purification will occur by giving a cow for the burnt-offering. / And having made narrative texts of true form, one goes to heaven.

2.1.s:
dharmaśāstrasya gamyasya vyavahārasya caiva hi ..
kalau yaḥ saṃgrahaṃ kuryātprasupte caiva keśave .. 2.1.8.30 ..
2.1.d:
धर्मशास्त्रस्य गम्यस्य व्यवहारस्य चैव हि ॥
कलौ यः संग्रहं कुर्यात्प्रसुप्ते चैव केशवे ॥ 2.1.8.30 ॥
2.1.m: Whoever makes a compilation of the Dharmaśāstra to be understood, / and of legal procedure in the Kali age when Keśava is asleep,

2.1.s:
yāvatpravartate lokastāvatsvarge mahīyate ..
siṃhe pauṣe ca caitre ca na kuryātsaṃgrahaṃ kvacit .. 31 ..
2.1.d:
यावत्प्रवर्तते लोकस्तावत्स्वर्गे महीयते ॥
सिंहे पौषे च चैत्रे च न कुर्यात्संग्रहं क्वचित् ॥ 31 ॥
2.1.m: he is exalted in heaven as long as the world endures. / One should never make a compilation when [the sun is in] Leo, in Pauṣa, or in Caitra,

2.1.s:
prātaḥkāle na kurvīt tathā madhyaṃdine dvijāḥ ..
pakṣāṃte bhūbhidāhe ca bhuvaḥ kaṃpe dinakṣaye .. 32 ..
2.1.d:
प्रातःकाले न कुर्वीत् तथा मध्यंदिने द्विजाः ॥
पक्षांते भूभिदाहे च भुवः कंपे दिनक्षये ॥ 32 ॥
2.1.m: nor should one do so in the morning or at midday, O twice-born, / at the end of a fortnight, during a fire on earth, an earthquake, or the loss of a solar day,

2.1.s:
malamāse viśeṣeṇa sandhyayośca vivarjane ..
amedhyāktaṃ ca patraṃ ca lipyakṣaravibhūṣitam .. 33 ..
2.1.d:
मलमासे विशेषेण सन्ध्ययोश्च विवर्जने ॥
अमेध्याक्तं च पत्रं च लिप्यक्षरविभूषितम् ॥ 33 ॥
2.1.m: especially in an intercalary month, and at the avoidance of the two twilights. / Even a leaf smeared with impure matter, adorned with written letters,

2.1.s:
pūtaṃ syāttatkṣaṇādviprāścatuḥ paṃcākṣareṇa vā..
nārasiṃhasya vinyāse pūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt .. 34 ..
2.1.d:
पूतं स्यात्तत्क्षणाद्विप्राश्चतुः पंचाक्षरेण वा॥
नारसिंहस्य विन्यासे पूतो भवति तत्क्षणात् ॥ 34 ॥
2.1.m: becomes purified instantly, O Brahmins, by four or five syllables; / upon the placement of Nārasiṃha's [mantra], it becomes pure in an instant.

2.1.s:
māyāvibhavavinyaste mahāpāpakalevare ..
muhūrtārdhena pūtatvaṃ prabhoryāṃti parāṃ gatim .. 35 ..
2.1.d:
मायाविभवविन्यस्ते महापापकलेवरे ॥
मुहूर्तार्धेन पूतत्वं प्रभोर्यांति परां गतिम् ॥ 35 ॥
2.1.m: When it is placed upon a body filled with great sin, resting in the power of Māyā, / in half a muhūrta they attain purity and reach the supreme state of the Lord.

2.1.s:
striyo vā niṃdito vāpi mleccho yāti parāṃ gatim ..
yo mūḍho manyate doṣaṃ tasya śaucaṃ samācaret ..
sa gardabhīṃ kharīṃ yoniṃ praviśennātra saṃśayaḥ.. .. 36 ..
2.1.d:
स्त्रियो वा निंदितो वापि म्लेच्छो याति परां गतिम् ॥
यो मूढो मन्यते दोषं तस्य शौचं समाचरेत् ॥
स गर्दभीं खरीं योनिं प्रविशेन्नात्र संशयः॥ ॥ 36 ॥
2.1.m: Whether women, a despised person, or even a Mleccha, they reach the supreme state. / Whatever fool considers this a fault and performs a purification for it, / he would enter the womb of a she-ass; of this there is no doubt.

2.1.s:
ekamevātmakaṃ brahma tatprakṛtyātmakaṃ dvayam ..
navātmako bhairavaśca daśamaśca janārdanaḥ .. 37 ..
2.1.d:
एकमेवात्मकं ब्रह्म तत्प्रकृत्यात्मकं द्वयम् ॥
नवात्मको भैरवश्च दशमश्च जनार्दनः ॥ 37 ॥
2.1.m: Brahman is of the nature of one alone; the pair is of the nature of Prakṛti; / Bhairava is ninefold in nature, and Janārdana is the tenth;

2.1.s:
rudra ekādaśaścaiva arkārkaścāpi dvādaśaḥ ..
trayoviṃśe ca bhūtātmā ṣaḍviṃśe manurīritaḥ .. 38 ..
2.1.d:
रुद्र एकादशश्चैव अर्कार्कश्चापि द्वादशः ॥
त्रयोविंशे च भूतात्मा षड्विंशे मनुरीरितः ॥ 38 ॥
2.1.m: Rudra is the eleventh, and the sun of twelve forms is the twelfth; / in the twenty-third is the self of elements, and in the twenty-sixth Manu is declared;

2.1.s:
tithyātmakaṃ paṃcadaśe ṣoḍaśākhyā kalāparā ..
vātātmakaḥ saptadaśo mantraḥ samanuvartate ..39..
2.1.d:
तिथ्यात्मकं पंचदशे षोडशाख्या कलापरा ॥
वातात्मकः सप्तदशो मन्त्रः समनुवर्तते ॥39॥
2.1.m: in the fifteenth is the nature of the tithis; the sixteenth is called the supreme digit; / the seventeenth is of the nature of wind, and the mantra follows;

2.1.s:
aṣṭādaśākṣaro maṃtraḥ purāṇātmaka eva ca ..
ūnaviṃśaścaṃdramāḥ syādviṃśo nārāyaṇo vapuḥ ..2.1.8.40..
2.1.d:
अष्टादशाक्षरो मंत्रः पुराणात्मक एव च ॥
ऊनविंशश्चंद्रमाः स्याद्विंशो नारायणो वपुः ॥2.1.8.40॥
2.1.m: the eighteen-syllabled mantra is indeed of the nature of the Purāṇa; / the nineteenth is the moon, and the twentieth is the body of Nārāyaṇa.

2.1.s:
jyotirmayaścaikaviṃśo dvāviṃśe keśavārcanam ..
nakṣatrāṇi trayoviṃśe caturviṃśe ca tānakam .. 41 ..
2.1.d:
ज्योतिर्मयश्चैकविंशो द्वाविंशे केशवार्चनम् ॥
नक्षत्राणि त्रयोविंशे चतुर्विंशे च तानकम् ॥ 41 ॥
2.1.m: The twenty-first consists of light; in the twenty-second is the worship of Keśava; / the lunar mansions are in the twenty-third, and in the twenty-fourth is tone.

2.1.s:
paṃcaviṃśe ca tīrthāni ṣaḍviṃśe ca triyaṃbakaḥ ..
aṣṭāviṃśe dhaneśaśca ūnatriṃśe sarasvatī .. 42 ..
2.1.d:
पंचविंशे च तीर्थानि षड्विंशे च त्रियंबकः ॥
अष्टाविंशे धनेशश्च ऊनत्रिंशे सरस्वती ॥ 42 ॥
2.1.m: In the twenty-fifth are sacred places, and in the twenty-sixth is Triyambaka; / in the twenty-eighth is the Lord of Wealth, and in the twenty-ninth is Sarasvatī.

2.1.s:
triṃśadyoge śivaḥ proktaḥ pātālamekatriṃśake ..
ahorātraśca dvātriṃśe catustriṃśe ca jāhnavī .. 43 ..
2.1.d:
त्रिंशद्योगे शिवः प्रोक्तः पातालमेकत्रिंशके ॥
अहोरात्रश्च द्वात्रिंशे चतुस्त्रिंशे च जाह्नवी ॥ 43 ॥
2.1.m: In the conjunction of thirty, Śiva is declared; the netherworld is in the thirty-first; / day and night are in the thirty-second, and in the thirty-fourth is the Jāhnavī.

2.1.s:
paṃcatriṃśe tadaṃtaḥ syācchate pūrṇe divākaraḥ ..
sahasre ca śivo jñeyaścāyute merurucyate .. 44 ..
2.1.d:
पंचत्रिंशे तदंतः स्याच्छते पूर्णे दिवाकरः ॥
सहस्रे च शिवो ज्ञेयश्चायुते मेरुरुच्यते ॥ 44 ॥
2.1.m: In the thirty-fifth is their end; at a complete hundred is the Sun; / at a thousand Śiva should be known, and at ten thousand Meru is spoken of.

2.1.s:
lakṣe brahmā tathā koṭyāṃ devo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ..
puṃprakṛtyātmakaṃ cānyacchāradālipimātṛkā ..45..
2.1.d:
लक्षे ब्रह्मा तथा कोट्यां देवो नारायणः परः ॥
पुंप्रकृत्यात्मकं चान्यच्छारदालिपिमातृका ॥45॥
2.1.m: At a hundred thousand is Brahmā, and likewise at ten million is the supreme god Nārāyaṇa; / and the other is composed of Puruṣa and Prakṛti, the matrix of the Śāradā script.

2.1.s:
śuddhabrahmamayaṃ nityaṃ jñānarūpaṃ paraṃ mahat ..
yasminna vyasanādeva śucau cāpyaśucisthale ..
kṣaṇe brahmamayaṃ yāti ityāha bhagavānmanuḥ .. 46 ..
pūrtanirṇayavarṇanam
2.1.d:
शुद्धब्रह्ममयं नित्यं ज्ञानरूपं परं महत् ॥
यस्मिन्न व्यसनादेव शुचौ चाप्यशुचिस्थले ॥
क्षणे ब्रह्ममयं याति इत्याह भगवान्मनुः ॥ 46 ॥
पूर्तनिर्णयवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
It is eternal, composed of pure Brahman, embodied as knowledge, supreme and great. / Even through intense involvement, in a clean or in an unclean place, / in an instant one attains the state of Brahman: thus spoke the venerable Manu.
Description of the determination of public works of piety

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
aṃtarvediṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇoktaṃ yugāṃtare ..
bahirvedaṃ tathaivoktaṃ śastaṃ syāddvāpare kalau .. 1 ..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अंतर्वेदिं प्रवक्ष्यामि ब्रह्मणोक्तं युगांतरे ॥
बहिर्वेदं तथैवोक्तं शस्तं स्याद्द्वापरे कलौ ॥ 1 ॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / I shall describe the inner altar, spoken of by Brahmā in another age; / and the outer altar is likewise described, praised as suitable in the Dvāpara and Kali [ages].

2.1.s:
jñānasādhyaṃ tu yatkarma aṃtarvedīti kathyate ..
devatāsthāpanaṃ pūjā bahiveṃdirudāhṛtā .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
ज्ञानसाध्यं तु यत्कर्म अंतर्वेदीति कथ्यते ॥
देवतास्थापनं पूजा बहिवेंदिरुदाहृता ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: The rite that is accomplished by knowledge alone is called the inner altar. / The installation and worship of deities is called the outer altar.

2.1.s:
prapāpūrtādikaṃ caiva brāhmaṇānāṃ ca toṣaṇam ..
gurubhyaḥ paricaryā ca bahirvedī dvidhā matā .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
प्रपापूर्तादिकं चैव ब्राह्मणानां च तोषणम् ॥
गुरुभ्यः परिचर्या च बहिर्वेदी द्विधा मता ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: Erecting public cisterns, philanthropic works, pleasing the brāhmaṇas, / and service to gurus—the outer altar is considered twofold.

2.1.s:
akāmena kṛtaṃ karma karma ca vyasanādikam ..
aṃtarvedī tadevoktaṃ bahirvedī viparyayaḥ .. 4 ..
2.1.d:
अकामेन कृतं कर्म कर्म च व्यसनादिकम् ॥
अंतर्वेदी तदेवोक्तं बहिर्वेदी विपर्ययः ॥ 4 ॥
2.1.m: Work done without desire, as well as work born of intense involvement and the like— / that is called the inner altar; the reverse is the outer altar.

2.1.s:
dharmasya kāraṇaṃ rājā dharmametadbhavennṛpaḥ ..
tasmānnṛpaṃ samāśritya bahirvedī tato bhavet .. 5 ..
2.1.d:
धर्मस्य कारणं राजा धर्ममेतद्भवेन्नृपः ॥
तस्मान्नृपं समाश्रित्य बहिर्वेदी ततो भवेत् ॥ 5 ॥
