2.1.m: The king is the cause of dharma; this dharma depends upon the king. / Therefore, relying upon the king, the outer altar should be undertaken.

2.1.s:
saptāśītirbahirvedī sārameṣāṃ tṛtīyakam ..
devatāsthāpanaṃ caiva prāsādakaraṇaṃ tathā .. 6 ..
2.1.d:
सप्ताशीतिर्बहिर्वेदी सारमेषां तृतीयकम् ॥
देवतास्थापनं चैव प्रासादकरणं तथा ॥ 6 ॥
2.1.m: Eighty-seven [rites constitute] the outer altar; of these, the essence is threefold: / the installation of deities, the construction of temples,

2.1.s:
taḍāgakaraṇaṃ caiva tṛtīyaṃ na caturthakam ..
paṃcamaṃ pitṛpūjā ca gurupūjāpuraḥsarā .. 7 ..
2.1.d:
तडागकरणं चैव तृतीयं न चतुर्थकम् ॥
पंचमं पितृपूजा च गुरुपूजापुरःसरा ॥ 7 ॥
2.1.m: and the construction of reservoirs is the third, not a fourth; / the fifth is worship of the ancestors, preceded by worship of the guru.

2.1.s:
adhivāsaḥ pratiṣṭhā ca devatānāmavikriyā ..
pratimākaraṇaṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāmatha ropaṇam .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
अधिवासः प्रतिष्ठा च देवतानामविक्रिया ॥
प्रतिमाकरणं चैव वृक्षाणामथ रोपणम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: Preliminary consecration, installation, the uncorrupted state of deities, / the making of images, and the planting of trees—

2.1.s:
trividhā sā vinirdiṣṭā uttamā cātha madhyamā ..
kaniṣṭhā śeṣakalpaśca sarvakāryeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ .. 9 ..
2.1.d:
त्रिविधा सा विनिर्दिष्टा उत्तमा चाथ मध्यमा ॥
कनिष्ठा शेषकल्पश्च सर्वकार्येष्वयं विधिः ॥ 9 ॥
2.1.m: this [rite] is declared to be threefold: superior, middling, / and inferior, with a remaining rite: this rule applies to all rituals.

2.1.s:
tridhā bhavati sarvatra pratiṣṭhādividhirmataḥ ..
pūjāhomādibhirdānairmānataśca tribhāgataḥ .. 2.1.9.10 ..
2.1.d:
त्रिधा भवति सर्वत्र प्रतिष्ठादिविधिर्मतः ॥
पूजाहोमादिभिर्दानैर्मानतश्च त्रिभागतः ॥ 2.1.9.10 ॥
2.1.m: The ritual procedure for installation and other rites is everywhere held to be threefold / according to the three divisions of worship, fire offerings, gifts, and measurements.

2.1.s:
tryahasādhyavidhānena aṣṭāviṃśatidevatāḥ ..
tridhā bhavati sarvatra pratiṣṭhādividhirmataḥ .. 11 ..
2.1.d:
त्र्यहसाध्यविधानेन अष्टाविंशतिदेवताः ॥
त्रिधा भवति सर्वत्र प्रतिष्ठादिविधिर्मतः ॥ 11 ॥
2.1.m: By means of a ritual procedure lasting three days, twenty-eight deities [are worshipped]. / The ritual procedure for installation and other rites is everywhere held to be threefold.

2.1.s:
pratyahaṃ pūjayettatra jāpakāstatra ṣoḍaśa ..
uttamo'sau vidhiḥ kṛtsno hyaśvamedhaphalapradaḥ .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
प्रत्यहं पूजयेत्तत्र जापकास्तत्र षोडश ॥
उत्तमोऽसौ विधिः कृत्स्नो ह्यश्वमेधफलप्रदः ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: One should worship daily there; there are sixteen reciters there. / This complete procedure is the superior one, granting the fruit of a horse-sacrifice.

2.1.s:
catvāro yājakāstatra trayoviṃśatidevatāḥ ..
brahadikpāla vāruṇyaṃ pṛthivī ca śivastathā .. 13 ..
2.1.d:
चत्वारो याजकास्तत्र त्रयोविंशतिदेवताः ॥
ब्रहदिक्पाल वारुण्यं पृथिवी च शिवस्तथा ॥ 13 ॥
2.1.m: There are four sacrificial priests there, and twenty-three deities: / Brahmā, the guardians of the directions, Varuṇa, the Earth, and Śiva.

2.1.s:
ekāhenaiva pūjā ca madhyamaḥ kathito vidhiḥ ..
gaṇeśagrahadikpālānvaruṇaṃ ca śivaṃ tathā .. 14 ..
2.1.d:
एकाहेनैव पूजा च मध्यमः कथितो विधिः ॥
गणेशग्रहदिक्पालान्वरुणं च शिवं तथा ॥ 14 ॥
2.1.m: Worship performed in just a single day is declared to be the middling procedure. / Gaṇeśa, the planets, the guardians of the directions, Varuṇa, and Śiva—

2.1.s:
saṃpūjya pūjyate yatra kaniṣṭho'sau vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
ekavṛkṣaścaikarūpaiḥ pratimākṣudradevatāḥ .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
संपूज्य पूज्यते यत्र कनिष्ठोऽसौ विधिः स्मृतः ॥
एकवृक्षश्चैकरूपैः प्रतिमाक्षुद्रदेवताः ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: when one worships these and [then] the deity is worshipped, that is remembered as the inferior procedure. / For a single tree, for uniform images, and for minor deities,

2.1.s:
nalinīdīrghikāgartavāpīmalaprapādikam ..
eṣāṃ saṃskārakāryeṣu pratimānāṃ pariṣkriyā .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
नलिनीदीर्घिकागर्तवापीमलप्रपादिकम् ॥
एषां संस्कारकार्येषु प्रतिमानां परिष्क्रिया ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: for lotus ponds, elongated ponds, pits, stepwells, ditches, water booths, and the like: / in the consecration rites of these, and the decoration of images,

2.1.s:
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā na kuryādvidhivistaram ..
gaṇeśagrahadikpālānpūjayedupacārataḥ .. 17 ..
2.1.d:
अग्निकार्यं ततः कृत्वा न कुर्याद्विधिविस्तरम् ॥
गणेशग्रहदिक्पालान्पूजयेदुपचारतः ॥ 17 ॥
2.1.m: having performed the fire ritual, one should not expand the ritual elaborate. / One should worship Gaṇeśa, the planets, and the guardians of the directions with offerings.

2.1.s:
vāpyādeḥ puṣkariṇyāśca kṣipedgaṃgājalaṃ tataḥ ..
ulūkhaladvayenāpi jīrṇānāṃ tu kadācana .. 18 ..
2.1.d:
वाप्यादेः पुष्करिण्याश्च क्षिपेद्गंगाजलं ततः ॥
उलूखलद्वयेनापि जीर्णानां तु कदाचन ॥ 18 ॥
2.1.m: One should then pour Gaṅgā water into the stepwell, pond, and the like, / with two mortars. But one should never

2.1.s:
setuprāsādavāpīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ naiva kārayet ..
prāsādaḥ setavaścaiva taḍāgādyāstathaiva ca .. 19 ..
2.1.d:
सेतुप्रासादवापीनां प्रतिष्ठां नैव कारयेत् ॥
प्रासादः सेतवश्चैव तडागाद्यास्तथैव च ॥ 19 ॥
2.1.m: perform the consecration of dilapidated dams, temples, and stepwells. / Temples, dams, and reservoirs and such,

2.1.s:
tribhirvarṇaiḥ pratiṣṭhārhā jīrṇānāṃ tu samudgatāḥ ..
munayo mānamicchaṃti amānaṃ na hi dṛśyate .. 2.1.9.20 ..
2.1.d:
त्रिभिर्वर्णैः प्रतिष्ठार्हा जीर्णानां तु समुद्गताः ॥
मुनयो मानमिच्छंति अमानं न हि दृश्यते ॥ 2.1.9.20 ॥
2.1.m: if dilapidated, are worthy of consecration when renovated by the three classes. / Sages require measurement; indeed, that which lacks measurement is not acceptable.

2.1.s:
tasmānmānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yanmānaṃ yādṛśaṃ phalam ..
ṣaṣṭihastapramāṇena taduktaṃ vāraṇoditam .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
तस्मान्मानं प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मानं यादृशं फलम् ॥
षष्टिहस्तप्रमाणेन तदुक्तं वारणोदितम् ॥ 21 ॥
2.1.m: Therefore, I shall explain the measurement—whatever the measurement, such is the fruit. / By a measure of sixty cubits, that which was proclaimed by Vāraṇa is stated.

2.1.s:
ekaṣaṣṭihastamitaṃ prāsādaṃ cottamaṃ viduḥ ..
madhyaṃ tadardhaṃ vijñeyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ tatparaṃ smṛtam .. 22 ..
2.1.d:
एकषष्टिहस्तमितं प्रासादं चोत्तमं विदुः ॥
मध्यं तदर्धं विज्ञेयं कनिष्ठं तत्परं स्मृतम् ॥ 22 ॥
2.1.m: They know a temple measuring sixty-one cubits to be superior; / half of that should be known as middling, and beyond that it is remembered as inferior.

2.1.s:
atha vā devamānena kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ..
yastaḍāgaṃ navaṃ kṛtvā jīrṇaṃ vā navatāṃ nayet .. .. 23 ..
2.1.d:
अथ वा देवमानेन कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ॥
यस्तडागं नवं कृत्वा जीर्णं वा नवतां नयेत् ॥ ॥ 23 ॥
2.1.m: Or else, it should be made according to divine measure by one desiring prosperity. / One who constructs a new reservoir or restores a dilapidated one to newness,

2.1.s:
sarvaṃ kulaṃ samuddhṛtya svargaloke mahīyate ..
vāpīkūpataḍāgāśca udyānapravahāstathā .. 24 ..
2.1.d:
सर्वं कुलं समुद्धृत्य स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
वापीकूपतडागाश्च उद्यानप्रवहास्तथा ॥ 24 ॥
2.1.m: having delivered his entire family, is honoured in the heavenly world. / Stepwells, wells, and reservoirs, as well as gardens and irrigation channels,

2.1.s:
punaḥ punaśca saṃskāryo labhate mauktikaṃ phalam ..
guṇānāṃ ca pramāṇena pratimānaṃ vibhāgataḥ .. 25 ..
2.1.d:
पुनः पुनश्च संस्कार्यो लभते मौक्तिकं फलम् ॥
गुणानां च प्रमाणेन प्रतिमानं विभागतः ॥ 25 ॥
2.1.m: restored again and again, obtain the fruit of liberation. / In accordance with the measure of merits and by division of proportional measures,

2.1.s:
dviśatena śatenāpi prāsādasyaiṣa niścayaḥ ..
sahasrahastavistāraṃ dairghyeṇāṣṭādhikaṃ bhavet .. 26 ..
2.1.d:
द्विशतेन शतेनापि प्रासादस्यैष निश्चयः ॥
सहस्रहस्तविस्तारं दैर्घ्येणाष्टाधिकं भवेत् ॥ 26 ॥
2.1.m: whether by two hundred or by one hundred, this is the determination for a temple. / With a width of a thousand cubits, in length it should exceed by eight [hundred]:

2.1.s:
taḍāgaṃ taṃ vijānīyātprathamaṃ mānamīritam ..
madhyaṃ catuḥśatenāpi prastāve daśahīnakam .. 27 ..
2.1.d:
तडागं तं विजानीयात्प्रथमं मानमीरितम् ॥
मध्यं चतुःशतेनापि प्रस्तावे दशहीनकम् ॥ 27 ॥
2.1.m: one should know that as a reservoir; it is stated as the first measurement. / The middling is with four hundred, diminished by ten in its breadth.

2.1.s:
kaniṣṭhaṃ triśataṃ caiva prasthe syādviṃśahīnakam ..
tadardhena kalau jñeyaṃ tadardhena tadardhakam .. 28 ..
2.1.d:
कनिष्ठं त्रिशतं चैव प्रस्थे स्याद्विंशहीनकम् ॥
तदर्धेन कलौ ज्ञेयं तदर्धेन तदर्धकम् ॥ 28 ॥
2.1.m: The inferior is three hundred, and in breadth it is diminished by twenty. / In the Kali age it should be known as half of that, and half of that, and half of that.

2.1.s:
taḍāgamānaṃ vijñeyaṃ trivargaphaladāyakam ..
atha puṣkariṇīpakṣe dve śate mānamuttamam .. 29 ..
2.1.d:
तडागमानं विज्ञेयं त्रिवर्गफलदायकम् ॥
अथ पुष्करिणीपक्षे द्वे शते मानमुत्तमम् ॥ 29 ॥
2.1.m: The measurement of a reservoir should be understood as granting the fruits of the three goals of life. / Now, regarding a pond, two hundred is the superior measure.

2.1.s:
taḍāge dviguṇā nemī mānārdhe gartamīritam ..
tatkṣetraṃ vāruṇaṃ sthānaṃ tryuditaṃ tadbahiḥ smṛtam .. 2.1.9.30 ..
2.1.d:
तडागे द्विगुणा नेमी मानार्धे गर्तमीरितम् ॥
तत्क्षेत्रं वारुणं स्थानं त्र्युदितं तद्बहिः स्मृतम् ॥ 2.1.9.30 ॥
2.1.m: For a reservoir, the circumference is twice that; the ditch is stated to be half the measure. / That field is the realm of Varuṇa; outside of it, three are remembered to arise:

2.1.s:
caturthaṃ caiva gāṃdharvaṃ paiśācaṃ paṃcamaṃ viduḥ ..
yakṣasthānamitā bhāge evaṃ sarvakramāṇi hi .. 31 ..
2.1.d:
चतुर्थं चैव गांधर्वं पैशाचं पंचमं विदुः ॥
यक्षस्थानमिता भागे एवं सर्वक्रमाणि हि ॥ 31 ॥
2.1.m: the fourth is of the gandharvas, and the fifth they know as belonging to the piśācas; / the yakṣa realm is in this portion: thus are all the sequences.

2.1.s:
aśītihastamānena nalinyā maṇirucyate ..
pañcahīnaṃ ca prastāve evaṃ mānavido viduḥ .. 32 ..
2.1.d:
अशीतिहस्तमानेन नलिन्या मणिरुच्यते ॥
पञ्चहीनं च प्रस्तावे एवं मानविदो विदुः ॥ 32 ॥
2.1.m: With a measurement of eighty cubits, the circumference of a lotus pond is stated, / and diminished by five in breadth; so know those who understand measurements.

2.1.s:
ṣaṣṭihastena nalinī prastāve turyahīnakam ..
catuḥṣaṣṭihastamitā dīrghikā ca prakīrtitā .. 33 ..
2.1.d:
षष्टिहस्तेन नलिनी प्रस्तावे तुर्यहीनकम् ॥
चतुःषष्टिहस्तमिता दीर्घिका च प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 33 ॥
2.1.m: A lotus pond of sixty cubits is diminished by a fourth in breadth. / An elongated pond is proclaimed to measure sixty-four cubits,

2.1.s: turyahīnaṃ ca prastāve garte mānaṃ na vidyate .. 34 ..
2.1.d: तुर्यहीनं च प्रस्तावे गर्ते मानं न विद्यते ॥ 34 ॥
2.1.m: and diminished by a fourth in breadth; for a ditch, no measurement is found.

2.1.s:
agnau rogo baṃdhunāśaśca yāmyāṃ mṛtyuścograḥ prāpyate rākṣase ca ..
bhītiścogrā prāpyate vāyavīye tasmādetā varjanīyāḥ prayatnāt .. 35 ..
2.1.d:
अग्नौ रोगो बंधुनाशश्च याम्यां मृत्युश्चोग्रः प्राप्यते राक्षसे च ॥
भीतिश्चोग्रा प्राप्यते वायवीये तस्मादेता वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नात् ॥ 35 ॥
2.1.m: In the south-east disease and loss of kinsmen [occur], in the south fierce death is incurred, and in the south-west; / and in the north-west fierce terror is incurred; therefore one must avoid these with effort.

2.1.s:
viprādīnāṃ devatānāṃ samāje merusthāne yatra tatraiva kuryāt ..
nadyāstīre varjayedvā smaśāne taḍāgādvai āśramādīñjanānām .. 36 ..
2.1.d:
विप्रादीनां देवतानां समाजे मेरुस्थाने यत्र तत्रैव कुर्यात् ॥
नद्यास्तीरे वर्जयेद्वा स्मशाने तडागाद्वै आश्रमादीञ्जनानाम् ॥ 36 ॥
2.1.m: In an assembly of brāhmaṇas and others or deities, in a Meru site, one may construct [it] anywhere; / but one should avoid the bank of a river, a cremation ground, or the hermitages of people near a reservoir.

2.1.s:
yadā pratiṣṭhāṃ na karoti mūḍhaḥ prāsādavāpyādiṣu pāpacetāḥ ..
bhayaṃ samāpnoti ca pāpamugraṃ pade'hinā vai vadhabhāgitāṃ vrajet .. 37 ..
2.1.d:
यदा प्रतिष्ठां न करोति मूढः प्रासादवाप्यादिषु पापचेताः ॥
भयं समाप्नोति च पापमुग्रं पदेऽहिना वै वधभागितां व्रजेत् ॥ 37 ॥
2.1.m: When a fool of sinful mind does not perform consecration / for temples, stepwells, and the like, he meets with fear and terrible sin, and at every step he is liable to be killed by a snake.

2.1.s:
yadā tu dīrghāsarasītaḍāgaprāsādakūpādiṣu nirmitāni ..
kurvaṃti cānyāni yadā makhāni bhavaṃti naivāsya phalapradāni ..38..
2.1.d:
यदा तु दीर्घासरसीतडागप्रासादकूपादिषु निर्मितानि ॥
कुर्वंति चान्यानि यदा मखानि भवंति नैवास्य फलप्रदानि ॥38॥
2.1.m: Moreover, when these things are constructed—oblong ponds, lakes, reservoirs, temples, wells, and the like— / and people perform other sacrifices, they do not bestow their fruits upon him.

2.1.s:
yadapratiṣṭheṣu nipānakeṣu prāsādakūpeṣu vanādikeṣu ..
pratiṣṭhite yatphalamāpnuvaṃti phalaṃ tadālpālpakamāhurasya ..39 ..
2.1.d:
यदप्रतिष्ठेषु निपानकेषु प्रासादकूपेषु वनादिकेषु ॥
प्रतिष्ठिते यत्फलमाप्नुवंति फलं तदाल्पाल्पकमाहुरस्य ॥39 ॥
2.1.m: In unconsecrated watering troughs, temples, wells, groves, and the like, / whatever fruit they obtain when consecrated, that fruit they declare to be very trifling indeed.

2.1.s:
tasmātpratiṣṭhāṃ vidhinā jalādeḥ kuryādyatheṣṭaṃ prayato manuṣyaḥ ..
puṇyārjanenaiva dhanena kāle svavittasādhyena śubhāśayena .. 2.1.9.40 ..
2.1.d:
तस्मात्प्रतिष्ठां विधिना जलादेः कुर्याद्यथेष्टं प्रयतो मनुष्यः ॥
पुण्यार्जनेनैव धनेन काले स्ववित्तसाध्येन शुभाशयेन ॥ 2.1.9.40 ॥
2.1.m: Therefore, a self-restrained man should perform the consecration of water and the rest according to rule, as desired, / with wealth earned solely through merit, at the proper time, accomplished by his own means, and with auspicious intent.

2.1.s:
prasāde mṛnmayaṃ puṇyaṃ mayaitatkathitaṃ dvijāḥ ..
tasmāccaturguṇaṃ proktaṃ tṛṇakāṣṭhamaye tathā .. 41 ..
2.1.d:
प्रसादे मृन्मयं पुण्यं मयैतत्कथितं द्विजाः ॥
तस्माच्चतुर्गुणं प्रोक्तं तृणकाष्ठमये तथा ॥ 41 ॥
2.1.m: The merit of a temple made of earth has been told by me, O twice-born; / four times that is declared for one made of grass and wood.

2.1.s:
tṛṇamaye śatamayaṃ tadardhaṃ navavalkale ..
tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ kṛte dārumaye bhavet.. 42 ..
2.1.d:
तृणमये शतमयं तदर्धं नववल्कले ॥
तस्माद्दशगुणं प्रोक्तं कृते दारुमये भवेत्॥ 42 ॥
2.1.m: One made of grass has a hundredfold [fruit], and half of that one of fresh bark; / ten times that is declared to result when made of wood.

2.1.s:
tato daśaguṇaṃ proktamiṣṭikāracite śubhe ..
tasmācchataguṇaṃ śaile sahasraṃ tāmraraupyake .. 43 ..
2.1.d:
ततो दशगुणं प्रोक्तमिष्टिकारचिते शुभे ॥
तस्माच्छतगुणं शैले सहस्रं ताम्ररौप्यके ॥ 43 ॥
2.1.m: Ten times that is declared when auspiciously constructed of brick; / a hundred times that for stone, a thousandfold for copper and silver,

2.1.s:
tataśca śatasāhasraṃ sauvarṇe dvijasattamāḥ ..
anaṃtaphalamāpnoti ratnādi racite tathā .. 44 ..
2.1.d:
ततश्च शतसाहस्रं सौवर्णे द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
अनंतफलमाप्नोति रत्नादि रचिते तथा ॥ 44 ॥
2.1.m: and a hundred thousand times for one of gold, O best of the twice-born; / and he obtains endless fruit when it is constructed of jewels and the like.

2.1.s:
yadatītaṃ bhaviṣyacca kulānāmayutaṃ naraḥ ..
viṣṇulokaṃ nayatyāśu kārayitvā harergṛham.. 45 ..
2.1.d:
यदतीतं भविष्यच्च कुलानामयुतं नरः ॥
विष्णुलोकं नयत्याशु कारयित्वा हरेर्गृहम्॥ 45 ॥
2.1.m: Ten thousand families, past and future, / a man quickly leads to the world of Viṣṇu by having a house built for Hari.

2.1.s:
kaniṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kārayitvā harergṛham ..
ardhaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ mokṣaṃ ca labhate kramāt .. 46 ..
2.1.d:
कनिष्ठं मध्यमं श्रेष्ठं कारयित्वा हरेर्गृहम् ॥
अर्धं च वैष्णवं लोकं मोक्षं च लभते क्रमात् ॥ 46 ॥
2.1.m: Having caused a small, middling, or superior house to be made for Hari, / he obtains half, the world of Viṣṇu, and liberation, respectively.

2.1.s:
hastānāṃ poḍaśairyāvatprasthe syātkarahīnakam..
tṛṇavaṃśamaye mānaṃ madhyaṃ cārkakaraṃ bhavet .. 47 ..
2.1.d:
हस्तानां पोडशैर्यावत्प्रस्थे स्यात्करहीनकम्॥
तृणवंशमये मानं मध्यं चार्ककरं भवेत् ॥ 47 ॥
2.1.m: In a [temple] made of grass and bamboo, the measure should be up to sixteen cubits, less one cubit in width; / the middling should be twelve cubits.

2.1.s:
kaniṣṭhaṃ tārahastaṃ syāduttamaṃ paṃcaviṃśatiḥ ..
sarvottamaṃ ca dvātriṃśaccatuṣkoṇe mahāphalam .. 48 ..
2.1.d:
कनिष्ठं तारहस्तं स्यादुत्तमं पंचविंशतिः ॥
सर्वोत्तमं च द्वात्रिंशच्चतुष्कोणे महाफलम् ॥ 48 ॥
2.1.m: The smallest should be eight cubits, the best twenty-five; / and the supreme among all is thirty-two, yielding great fruit when four-cornered.

2.1.s:
puradvāraṃ ca kartavyaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃ bhavet ..
aṣṭakoṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ tripuraṃ ca kalau yuge .. 49 ..
2.1.d:
पुरद्वारं च कर्तव्यं चतुरस्रं समं भवेत् ॥
अष्टकोणं न कर्तव्यं त्रिपुरं च कलौ युगे ॥ 49 ॥
2.1.m: The city gate should be made four-sided and even; / in the Kali age one should not make it eight-cornered or three-walled.

2.1.s:
suraveśmani yāvaṃto dvijendrāḥ paramāṇavaḥ ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate .. 2.1.9.50 ..
2.1.d:
सुरवेश्मनि यावंतो द्विजेन्द्राः परमाणवः ॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥ 2.1.9.50 ॥
2.1.m: As many atoms as there are in the abode of the god, O lords of the twice-born, / for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the heavenly world.

2.1.s:
karturdaśaguṇaṃ proktamāpānaparipālakaḥ ..
patitānyuddharedyastu sa sarvaṃ phalamaśnute .. 51 ..
2.1.d:
कर्तुर्दशगुणं प्रोक्तमापानपरिपालकः ॥
पतितान्युद्धरेद्यस्तु स सर्वं फलमश्नुते ॥ 51 ॥
2.1.m: Ten times the [fruit of the] builder is declared for the guardian of the watering-station; / and he who restores what has fallen enjoys the entire fruit.

2.1.s:
patitaṃ patamānaṃ ca tathārddhasphuṭitaṃ tathā ..
samuddhṛtya harerveśma dviguṇaṃ phalamāpnuyāt .. 52 ..
2.1.d:
पतितं पतमानं च तथार्द्धस्फुटितं तथा ॥
समुद्धृत्य हरेर्वेश्म द्विगुणं फलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 52 ॥
2.1.m: Having restored a house of Hari that is fallen, or falling, / or half-cracked, he shall obtain twice the fruit.

2.1.s:
patitasya tu yaḥ kartā patamānasya rakṣitā ..
viṣṇoradhitalasyaiva mānavaḥ svargabhāgbhavet .. 53 ..
2.1.d:
पतितस्य तु यः कर्ता पतमानस्य रक्षिता ॥
विष्णोरधितलस्यैव मानवः स्वर्गभाग्भवेत् ॥ 53 ॥
2.1.m: He who repairs what has fallen or protects what is falling / of the pedestal of Viṣṇu, that man becomes a sharer in heaven.

2.1.s:
yaḥ kuryādviṣṇuprāsādaṃ jyotirliṃgasya vā kvacit ..
sūryasyāpi viriṃceśca durgāyāḥ śrīdharasya ca .. 54 ..
2.1.d:
यः कुर्याद्विष्णुप्रासादं ज्योतिर्लिंगस्य वा क्वचित् ॥
सूर्यस्यापि विरिंचेश्च दुर्गायाः श्रीधरस्य च ॥ 54 ॥
2.1.m: He who builds anywhere a temple to Viṣṇu or to a liṅga of light, / or to Sūrya, to Viriñci, to Durgā, or to Śrīdhara,

2.1.s:
svayaṃ svakulamuddhṛtya kalpakoṭiṃ vaseddivi ..
svargādbhraṣṭo bhavedrājā dhanī pūjyatamopi vā .. 55 ..
2.1.d:
स्वयं स्वकुलमुद्धृत्य कल्पकोटिं वसेद्दिवि ॥
स्वर्गाद्भ्रष्टो भवेद्राजा धनी पूज्यतमोपि वा ॥ 55 ॥
2.1.m: having raised up his own lineage, he lives in heaven for ten million kalpas; / fallen from heaven, he becomes a king, wealthy or most venerable.

2.1.s:
devīliṃgeṣu yonau vā kṛtvā devakulaṃ naraḥ ..
smaratvaṃ prāpnuyālloke pūjito divi sarvadā .. 56 ..
2.1.d:
देवीलिंगेषु योनौ वा कृत्वा देवकुलं नरः ॥
स्मरत्वं प्राप्नुयाल्लोके पूजितो दिवि सर्वदा ॥ 56 ॥
2.1.m: A man who builds a temple over liṅgas or yonis of the Goddess / attains the state of Smara in the world, worshipped in heaven forever.

2.1.s:
prāvṛṭkāle sthitaṃ toyamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ..
śaratkālasthitaṃ toyaṃ yajñatoyādviśiṣyate .. 57 ..
2.1.d:
प्रावृट्काले स्थितं तोयमग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥
शरत्कालस्थितं तोयं यज्ञतोयाद्विशिष्यते ॥ 57 ॥
2.1.m: Water remaining during the rainy season obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma; / water remaining in the autumn season is superior to the water of sacrifice.

2.1.s:
nidāghakāle pānīyaṃ yasya tiṣṭhati vāpinaḥ ..
svargaṃ gacchetsa narakaṃ na kadācidavāpnuyāt .. 58 ..
2.1.d:
निदाघकाले पानीयं यस्य तिष्ठति वापिनः ॥
स्वर्गं गच्छेत्स नरकं न कदाचिदवाप्नुयात् ॥ 58 ॥
2.1.m: The owner of a reservoir whose water remains in the summer season / goes to heaven; he shall never go to hell.

2.1.s:
ekāhaṃ tu sthitaṃ toyaṃ pṛthivyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
kulāni tārayettasya sapta sapta parāṇi ca .. 59 ..
2.1.d:
एकाहं तु स्थितं तोयं पृथिव्यां द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
कुलानि तारयेत्तस्य सप्त सप्त पराणि च ॥ 59 ॥
2.1.m: If water remains on the earth for even a single day, O best of the twice-born, / it redeems seven and seven further lineages of his.

2.1.s:
pūrvaṃ pitṛkule sapta tadvanmātṛkule dvijāḥ ..
caturdaśamidaṃ jñeyaṃ śatalekhaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu .. 2.1.9.60 ..
2.1.d:
पूर्वं पितृकुले सप्त तद्वन्मातृकुले द्विजाः ॥
चतुर्दशमिदं ज्ञेयं शतलेखं ततः शृणु ॥ 2.1.9.60 ॥
2.1.m: Seven previously in the father's lineage, and likewise in the mother's lineage, O twice-born; / this should be known as fourteen; now hear the list of one hundred:

2.1.s:
piturūrdhvaṃ kulaṃ viṃśaṃ māturūrdhva kulaṃ tathā ..
tadvatparaṃ vijānīyādbhāryāyāḥ paṃca eva ca .. 61 ..
2.1.d:
पितुरूर्ध्वं कुलं विंशं मातुरूर्ध्व कुलं तथा ॥
तद्वत्परं विजानीयाद्भार्यायाः पंच एव च ॥ 61 ॥
2.1.m: Twenty lineages above the father, and likewise twenty lineages above the mother; / similarly one should know further, and five of the wife,

2.1.s:
paṃca vai mātṛtaścāsya piturmātāmahe kule ..
paṃca paṃca vijānīyānmāturmātāmahasya ca .. 62 ..
2.1.d:
पंच वै मातृतश्चास्य पितुर्मातामहे कुले ॥
पंच पंच विजानीयान्मातुर्मातामहस्य च ॥ 62 ॥
2.1.m: five on his mother's side, five in the lineage of the father's maternal grandfather, / and one should know five each of the mother's maternal grandfather,

2.1.s:
guroḥ pitṛkule paṃca tasya mātṛkule tathā ..
ācāryasya kule dvaṃdvaṃ daśarājakulasya ca .. 63 ..
2.1.d:
गुरोः पितृकुले पंच तस्य मातृकुले तथा ॥
आचार्यस्य कुले द्वंद्वं दशराजकुलस्य च ॥ 63 ॥
2.1.m: five in the guru's paternal lineage and likewise in his maternal lineage, / two in the lineage of the ācārya, and ten of the king's lineage,

2.1.s:
rājño mātāmahakule paṃca caiva prakīrtitāḥ ..
ekottaraṃ śatakulaṃ parisaṃkhyātameva ca ..64..
2.1.d:
राज्ञो मातामहकुले पंच चैव प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
एकोत्तरं शतकुलं परिसंख्यातमेव च ॥64॥
2.1.m: and five are proclaimed in the maternal grandfather's lineage of the king; / thus one hundred and one lineages are enumerated.

2.1.s:
ātmanā saha vipreṃdrā uddhāraḥ saṃmataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
kuryāddevārcanaṃ tīrthe svavimukte daśārṇave ..65..
2.1.d:
आत्मना सह विप्रेंद्रा उद्धारः संमतः स्मृतः ॥
कुर्याद्देवार्चनं तीर्थे स्वविमुक्ते दशार्णवे ॥65॥
2.1.m: Together with oneself, O lords of the twice-born, the redemption is acknowledged by tradition; / one should worship the deity at a sacred bathing place, in self-liberation, or at Daśārṇava.

2.1.s:
samuddharetkulaśataṃ śṛṇu viṃśakulaṃ dvija ..
paṃca paṃca ca pitrośca piturmātāmahasya ca .. 66 ..
2.1.d:
समुद्धरेत्कुलशतं शृणु विंशकुलं द्विज ॥
पंच पंच च पित्रोश्च पितुर्मातामहस्य च ॥ 66 ॥
2.1.m: He redeems one hundred lineages; hear [now] of the twenty lineages, O twice-born: / five each of the parents and of the father's maternal grandfather,

2.1.s:
māturmātāmahasyaiva jātiṃ dvaṃdvamudāhṛtam..
guroḥ saṃtānake dvaṃdvaṃ tadvadyādavasāttvatau ..67..
2.1.d:
मातुर्मातामहस्यैव जातिं द्वंद्वमुदाहृतम्॥
गुरोः संतानके द्वंद्वं तद्वद्यादवसात्त्वतौ ॥67॥
2.1.m: and for the mother's maternal grandfather, two births are stated; / two in the offspring of the guru, likewise the Yādava and Sāttvata,

2.1.s:
parapakṣasya caikaṃ syādekaviṃśaṃ kulaṃ kramāt..
pānīyametatsakalaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram.. .. 68 ..
2.1.d:
परपक्षस्य चैकं स्यादेकविंशं कुलं क्रमात्॥
पानीयमेतत्सकलं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्॥ ॥ 68 ॥
2.1.m: and there would be one for the other side, making the twenty-first lineage in succession. / Water is this entire triple world with all that moves and is still.

2.1.s:
pānīyena vinā vṛttirloke nāstīti karhicit..
vārasvasthaṃ puṣpakhaṃḍaṃ toye patati yāvati ..69..
2.1.d:
पानीयेन विना वृत्तिर्लोके नास्तीति कर्हिचित्॥
वारस्वस्थं पुष्पखंडं तोये पतति यावति ॥69॥
2.1.m: Without water there is no subsistence whatsoever in the world; / as long as a cluster of flowers thrown at the appointed time remains fallen in the water,

2.1.s:
tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge cānte brahmatvamāpnuyāt ..
tasmāttoyopari gṛhaṃ prasādopari varjayet..2.1.9.70..
2.1.d:
तावत्कालं वसेत्स्वर्गे चान्ते ब्रह्मत्वमाप्नुयात् ॥
तस्मात्तोयोपरि गृहं प्रसादोपरि वर्जयेत्॥2.1.9.70॥
2.1.m: for that long he dwells in heaven, and in the end he attains identity with Brahman; / therefore one should avoid a house over water or over a temple.

2.1.s:
sūryaraśmiyutaṃ yadvai tattoyaṃ tu viniṃdatam..
caṃdraraśmivihīnaṃ yannāmṛtatvāya kalpate ..71..
2.1.d:
सूर्यरश्मियुतं यद्वै तत्तोयं तु विनिंदतम्॥
चंद्ररश्मिविहीनं यन्नामृतत्वाय कल्पते ॥71॥
2.1.m: Water that is touched by the rays of the sun is censured; / that which is devoid of the rays of the moon does not lead to immortality.

2.1.s:
tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ kuṃḍe tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ hrade..
devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryādavimuktaphalaṃ śubham ..72..
2.1.d:
तस्माद्दशगुणं कुंडे तस्माद्दशगुणं ह्रदे॥
देवानां स्थापनं कुर्यादविमुक्तफलं शुभम् ॥72॥
2.1.m: Ten times that in a reservoir, ten times that in a lake; / one should establish the gods, which yields the auspicious fruit of Avimukta.

2.1.s:
susthitaṃ duḥsthitaṃ vāpi śivaliṃgaṃ na cālayet ..
cālanādrauravaṃ yāti na svargaṃ na ca svargabhāk ..73..
2.1.d:
सुस्थितं दुःस्थितं वापि शिवलिंगं न चालयेत् ॥
चालनाद्रौरवं याति न स्वर्गं न च स्वर्गभाक् ॥73॥
2.1.m: A Śivaliṅga, whether well situated or poorly situated, one must not move; / by moving it, one goes to Raurava, neither to heaven nor sharing in heaven.

2.1.s:
ucchannagaragrāme sthānatyāge ca viplave ..
punaḥ saṃsāradharmeṇa sthāpayedavicārayan..74..
2.1.d:
उच्छन्नगरग्रामे स्थानत्यागे च विप्लवे ॥
पुनः संसारधर्मेण स्थापयेदविचारयन्॥74॥
2.1.m: In a ruined town or village, in abandonment of a site, or in a catastrophe, / one should reinstall it according to the rule of worldly life, without hesitation.

2.1.s:
bāhudaṃtādipratimā viṣṇoścānyasya sattamāḥ..
na cālayetsthāpite ca vipravṛkṣaṃ na cālayet ..4..
2.1.d:
बाहुदंतादिप्रतिमा विष्णोश्चान्यस्य सत्तमाः॥
न चालयेत्स्थापिते च विप्रवृक्षं न चालयेत् ॥4॥
2.1.m: An image of Viṣṇu or another [deity] with arms, teeth, and the like, O good ones, / one must not move when installed, nor must one move a sacred fig tree.

2.1.s:
keśavaṃ harivṛkṣaṃ ca madhūkaṃ kiṃśukaṃ tathā..
nākāle sthāpayejjātu cālanādbrahmahā bhaveta..76..
2.1.d:
केशवं हरिवृक्षं च मधूकं किंशुकं तथा॥
नाकाले स्थापयेज्जातु चालनाद्ब्रह्महा भवेत॥76॥
2.1.m: Keśava, the sacred fig tree, the madhūka, and the kiṃśuka / one should never install at an improper time; from moving them one becomes a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

2.1.s:
devālayasya purataḥ kuryātpuṣkariṇī dvijāḥ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ samāje ca rājadvāre catuṣpathe..77..
2.1.d:
देवालयस्य पुरतः कुर्यात्पुष्करिणी द्विजाः॥
ब्राह्मणानां समाजे च राजद्वारे चतुष्पथे॥77॥
2.1.m: In front of a temple one should make a lotus pool, O twice-born, / as well as in an assembly of brāhmaṇas, at the royal gate, and at crossroads.

2.1.s:
devātheṃ brāhmaṇārthe ca mukhaṃ kuryācca sarvataḥ ..
paścime puṣṭikāmaṃ tu uttare sarvakāmadam .. 78 ..
2.1.d:
देवाथें ब्राह्मणार्थे च मुखं कुर्याच्च सर्वतः ॥
पश्चिमे पुष्टिकामं तु उत्तरे सर्वकामदम् ॥ 78 ॥
2.1.m: For the sake of the gods and for the sake of brāhmaṇas, one should make an entrance on all sides; / on the west for one desiring prosperity, but on the north it grants all desires.

2.1.s:
yāmye svārthaṃ na kurvīta koṇe tu narakaṃ bhavet ..
mukhaṃ prakalpayenmadhye keciduttaralaṃghanam .. 79 ..
2.1.d:
याम्ये स्वार्थं न कुर्वीत कोणे तु नरकं भवेत् ॥
मुखं प्रकल्पयेन्मध्ये केचिदुत्तरलंघनम् ॥ 79 ॥
2.1.m: On the south one should not make it for one's own sake, but at a corner it leads to hell; / one should fashion the entrance in the middle, though some [allow] passing through the north.

2.1.s:
kuryāddakṣiṇapūrve tu arkahastapramāṇataḥ ..
taḍāge tu phalāhastaṃ hastikaṃ hrāsayetkramāt .. 2.1.9.80 ..
2.1.d:
कुर्याद्दक्षिणपूर्वे तु अर्कहस्तप्रमाणतः ॥
तडागे तु फलाहस्तं हस्तिकं ह्रासयेत्क्रमात् ॥ 2.1.9.80 ॥
2.1.m: One should make [it] in the south-east with a measure of twelve cubits. / In a pond, however, one should gradually decrease [it] cubit by cubit.

2.1.s:
tṛpye hastaṃ nalinyādāvato hīnaṃ na kārayet ..
gartatṛṇaṃ kalāhastaṃ taḍāge'tra pracakṣyate .. 81 ..
2.1.d:
तृप्ये हस्तं नलिन्यादावतो हीनं न कारयेत् ॥
गर्ततृणं कलाहस्तं तडागेऽत्र प्रचक्ष्यते ॥ 81 ॥
2.1.m: In a lotus-pond and the like, [it should measure] a cubit at satisfaction; one should not make it smaller than that. / The ditch-grass in this pond is declared to be sixteen cubits.

2.1.s:
hīne hīnataraṃ kuryāddhastamānena hrāsayet ..
yūpastathā khādira eva kāryaḥ śraiparṇiko dhātrisamudbhavaśca ..
mānastathā ṣoḍaśahastasammito ratnātsagaṇḍīyugakāmayojitaiḥ .. 82 ..
2.1.d:
हीने हीनतरं कुर्याद्धस्तमानेन ह्रासयेत् ॥
यूपस्तथा खादिर एव कार्यः श्रैपर्णिको धात्रिसमुद्भवश्च ॥
मानस्तथा षोडशहस्तसम्मितो रत्नात्सगण्डीयुगकामयोजितैः ॥ 82 ॥
2.1.m: In a smaller one, one should make it still smaller, reducing it by the measure of a cubit. / A sacrificial post should likewise be made of khadira wood, śrīparṇikā, or produced from dhātrī, / and its measure is considered sixteen cubits, arranged with gems, joints, pairs, and desires.

2.1.s:
ānāhabhagne ca bhavecca tasya viṃśāṃ gulo dviguṇo madhyagaśca ..
madhyeṃ'gulaiśca hīnaḥ kāryaḥ śubhadaḥ sarvadā syāt .. 83 ..
2.1.d:
आनाहभग्ने च भवेच्च तस्य विंशां गुलो द्विगुणो मध्यगश्च ॥
मध्येंऽगुलैश्च हीनः कार्यः शुभदः सर्वदा स्यात् ॥ 83 ॥
2.1.m: Its circumference, when divided, should be twenty angulas, doubled in the middle; / and diminished by angulas in the middle, it should be made such that it always bestows auspiciousness.

2.1.s:
evaṃvidhaścaiva taḍāgayūpo madhye tathā ṣoḍaśahastasaṃmitaḥ ..
kūpe ca yūpopyatha hastamātrastataścaturhastamitaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 84 ..
2.1.d:
एवंविधश्चैव तडागयूपो मध्ये तथा षोडशहस्तसंमितः ॥
कूपे च यूपोप्यथ हस्तमात्रस्ततश्चतुर्हस्तमितः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 84 ॥
2.1.m: And such is the sacrificial post for a pond, considered to be sixteen cubits in the middle. / For a well, the sacrificial post is merely one cubit, and thereafter it is proclaimed to measure four cubits.

2.1.s:
ārāmayoge'pyatha maṇḍape ca kāryaścaturhastamito'tha yūpaḥ ..
saṃpūrṇamāne kathitaṃ pramāṇaṃ hīne tu hīnaṃ pravadaṃti tajjñāḥ ..
hastadvayaṃ prāpitavyaṃ taḍāge hastaḥ sārdhaḥ puṣkariṇyāṃ praropaḥ ..85..
2.1.d:
आरामयोगेऽप्यथ मण्डपे च कार्यश्चतुर्हस्तमितोऽथ यूपः ॥
संपूर्णमाने कथितं प्रमाणं हीने तु हीनं प्रवदंति तज्ज्ञाः ॥
हस्तद्वयं प्रापितव्यं तडागे हस्तः सार्धः पुष्करिण्यां प्ररोपः ॥85॥
2.1.m: In the laying out of a pleasure-grove and in a pavilion, the sacrificial post is to be made measuring four cubits. / The measure has been stated for the full size; for a smaller one, those skilled in this declare a smaller [measure]. / Two cubits are to be inserted in a pond, and the planting in a reservoir is one cubit and a half.

2.1.s:
prādeśaṃ vai hastamānaṃ kūpayūpasya ropataḥ ..
na kuryājjalamagnaṃ ca yūpaṃ sarvatra sattamāḥ .. 86 ..
2.1.d:
प्रादेशं वै हस्तमानं कूपयूपस्य रोपतः ॥
न कुर्याज्जलमग्नं च यूपं सर्वत्र सत्तमाः ॥ 86 ॥
2.1.m: A span indeed is the measure of a cubit for the planting of the sacrificial post for a well. / O best of men, one should never make the sacrificial post submerged in water.

2.1.s:
taḍāge cāpi ārāme sthāpayecca jalopari ..
hastamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ syānmānenānena dāpayet ..
vāpyāṃ garte puṣkariṇyāṃ prakuryājjalasaṃmitam .. 87 ..
2.1.d:
तडागे चापि आरामे स्थापयेच्च जलोपरि ॥
हस्तमर्धं तदर्धं स्यान्मानेनानेन दापयेत् ॥
वाप्यां गर्ते पुष्करिण्यां प्रकुर्याज्जलसंमितम् ॥ 87 ॥
2.1.m: In a pond and also in a pleasure-grove, one should erect it above the water. / A cubit, or half of that, or half of that it should be; one should set it up according to this measure. / In a step-well, a ditch, or a reservoir, one should make it level with the water.

2.1.s:
yāvatpratolīgatareṇusaṃgasaṃkhyāgaṇo no jaratāmupaiti ..
tāvatsureśaḥ suralokavāsī prāsādakṛjjātu na jāyate hi ..88..
2.1.d:
यावत्प्रतोलीगतरेणुसंगसंख्यागणो नो जरतामुपैति ॥
तावत्सुरेशः सुरलोकवासी प्रासादकृज्जातु न जायते हि ॥88॥
2.1.m: As long as the host of dust-particles gathered in the main street does not grow old, / for so long does the builder of a temple dwell in the world of the gods as a lord of the gods, never indeed being reborn.

2.1.s:
kiṃ vā vācyaḥ puṣkariṇyā prabhāvaḥ kartā yaḥ syādvāruṇo brahmalokāt ..
yāvatkālo bāhumātroddhatā syād dṛṣṭiḥproktā na nivartetkadācit .. 89 ..
2.1.d:
किं वा वाच्यः पुष्करिण्या प्रभावः कर्ता यः स्याद्वारुणो ब्रह्मलोकात् ॥
यावत्कालो बाहुमात्रोद्धता स्याद् दृष्टिःप्रोक्ता न निवर्तेत्कदाचित् ॥ 89 ॥
2.1.m: What indeed can be said of the power of a reservoir? Its maker goes from the world of Brahmā to the domain of Varuṇa. / As long as the sight [of it] is raised to the measure of an arm, it is proclaimed that he shall never return [to mundane existence].

2.1.s:
lakṣaikamārāmamayottamaḥ syānmadhyaṃ tadardhaṃ ca kaniṣṭhamānam ..
tadardhaṃ vā praśastaṃ tadananyaṃ munayo vadaṃti ..
vinārjunairbadaraiḥ śailukaiśca hīnaṃ kuryācchānalaiḥ pātilaiśca .. 2.1.9.90 ..
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi prathamabhāge pūrtanirṇayo nāma navamo' dhyāyaḥ .. 9 ...
pūrtanirṇayavarṇanam
2.1.d:
लक्षैकमाराममयोत्तमः स्यान्मध्यं तदर्धं च कनिष्ठमानम् ॥
तदर्धं वा प्रशस्तं तदनन्यं मुनयो वदंति ॥
विनार्जुनैर्बदरैः शैलुकैश्च हीनं कुर्याच्छानलैः पातिलैश्च ॥ 2.1.9.90 ॥
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे मध्यमपर्वणि प्रथमभागे पूर्तनिर्णयो नाम नवमो' ध्यायः ॥ 9 ॥।
पूर्तनिर्णयवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
An excellent pleasure-grove consists of one hundred thousand [trees]; the medium is half of that, and the lowest measure / is half of that, or it is praised as having no other [like it]—so the sages say. / One should make it lacking without arjuna, jujube, śailuka, chānala, and pātila trees.
Thus ends the ninth chapter, named 'The Determination of Public Works', in the first part of the Madhyamaparvan in the glorious and great Bhaviṣyapurāṇa.
Description of the determination of public works.

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śodhayetprathamaṃ bhūmiṃ mitāṃ kṛtvā tato dvijāḥ ..
daśahastena daṇḍena pañcahastena vā punaḥ .. 1 ..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
शोधयेत्प्रथमं भूमिं मितां कृत्वा ततो द्विजाः ॥
दशहस्तेन दण्डेन पञ्चहस्तेन वा पुनः ॥ 1 ॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / First, O twice-born ones, one should purify the ground after having measured it / with a staff of ten cubits or of five cubits.

2.1.s:
vāhayetsadā vṛṣabhaistaḍāgārthe'pi bhūmikām ..
devāgārasya yā bhūmiḥ śvetaiśca vṛṣabhairapi .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
वाहयेत्सदा वृषभैस्तडागार्थेऽपि भूमिकाम् ॥
देवागारस्य या भूमिः श्वेतैश्च वृषभैरपि ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: One should always plough the ground for a pond with bulls, / and the ground for a temple with white bulls.

2.1.s:
yā bhūmirgrahayāgārthe tanna vāhairapi spṛśet ..
ārāmārthe kṛṣṇavṛṣaiḥ kṛṣārthakhananairapi .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
या भूमिर्ग्रहयागार्थे तन्न वाहैरपि स्पृशेत् ॥
आरामार्थे कृष्णवृषैः कृषार्थखननैरपि ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: The ground meant for a planetary sacrifice one should not touch even with draught animals; / for a pleasure-grove, with black bulls, even with diggings for cultivation.

2.1.s:
vāhayettridinaṃ viprāḥ pañcavrīhīṃśca vāpayet ..
devapakṣe saptaguṇa ārāmakaraṇe guṇaḥ .. 4 ..
2.1.d:
वाहयेत्त्रिदिनं विप्राः पञ्चव्रीहींश्च वापयेत् ॥
देवपक्षे सप्तगुण आरामकरणे गुणः ॥ 4 ॥
2.1.m: One should plough for three days, O brāhmaṇas, and sow five kinds of grains. / In the case of the gods, the merit is sevenfold, as is the merit in the making of a pleasure-grove.

2.1.s:
mudgamāṣau dhānya tilāḥ śyāmākaśceti pañcamaḥ ..
masūraśca kalāyaśca saptavrīhigaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 5 ..
2.1.d:
मुद्गमाषौ धान्य तिलाः श्यामाकश्चेति पञ्चमः ॥
मसूरश्च कलायश्च सप्तव्रीहिगणः स्मृतः ॥ 5 ॥
2.1.m: Mung bean, black gram, barley, sesame, and barnyard millet as the fifth, / lentil, and pea: this is remembered as the group of seven grains.

2.1.s:
sarṣapaśca kalāyaśca mudgo māṣaścaturthakaḥ ..
vrīhitrayaṃ māṣamudgau śyāmāko mahiṣo gaṇaḥ .. 6 ..
2.1.d:
सर्षपश्च कलायश्च मुद्गो माषश्चतुर्थकः ॥
व्रीहित्रयं माषमुद्गौ श्यामाको महिषो गणः ॥ 6 ॥
2.1.m: Mustard, pea, mung bean, black gram as the fourth; / the triad of rice grains, black gram, mung bean, barnyard millet, and wild rice form a group.

2.1.s:
suvarṇamṛttikā grāhyā varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ ..
bilvavṛkṣairiyaṃ kuryādyūpaśūnadhvaje dine ..7..
2.1.d:
सुवर्णमृत्तिका ग्राह्या वर्णानामनुपूर्वशः ॥
बिल्ववृक्षैरियं कुर्याद्यूपशूनध्वजे दिने ॥7॥
2.1.m: Golden soil is to be accepted in succession for the social classes. / One should perform this with bilva trees on a day of the sacrificial post, the dog, and the banner.

2.1.s:
aratnimātraṃ vijñeyaṃ praśastaṃ yaṣṭihastakam ..
ūrṇāsūtramayīṃ mūrtiṃ kṛtvā kuryāccatuṣṭayam .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
अरत्निमात्रं विज्ञेयं प्रशस्तं यष्टिहस्तकम् ॥
ऊर्णासूत्रमयीं मूर्तिं कृत्वा कुर्याच्चतुष्टयम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: It should be known as merely a cubit; a staff of a cubit is praised. / Having made an image of woollen thread, one should make a set of four.

2.1.s:
kṣīradārugartayutaṃ dvādaśāṃgulameva ca ..
jvālayettilatailena tathā keśarajena vā. .. 9 ..
2.1.d:
क्षीरदारुगर्तयुतं द्वादशांगुलमेव च ॥
ज्वालयेत्तिलतैलेन तथा केशरजेन वा॥। 9 ॥
2.1.m: Endowed with a pit of milky wood and measuring twelve angulas, / one should kindle it with sesame oil or with saffron oil.

2.1.s:
pūrvadikpraṇave siddhiḥ paścimāśāgatiḥ śubhā ..
maraṇe dakṣiṇāyāṃ ca hāniḥ syāduttare sthite .. 2.1.10.10 ..
2.1.d:
पूर्वदिक्प्रणवे सिद्धिः पश्चिमाशागतिः शुभा ॥
मरणे दक्षिणायां च हानिः स्यादुत्तरे स्थिते ॥ 2.1.10.10 ॥
2.1.m: With the syllable Om in the eastern direction there is success; movement toward the western direction is auspicious; / in the southern direction there is death; and loss occurs when it is situated in the north.

2.1.s:
kalpe vipatkaraṃ vidyāttathā caiva ca diggate ..
nārasiṃhena manunā cāgniṃ prajvālya dāpayet .. 11 ..
2.1.d:
कल्पे विपत्करं विद्यात्तथा चैव च दिग्गते ॥
नारसिंहेन मनुना चाग्निं प्रज्वाल्य दापयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
2.1.m: In an eon, one should know that it causes calamity, and likewise when it goes into a [cardinal] direction. / Having kindled the fire with the mantra of Narasiṃha, one should offer [it].

2.1.s:
māse ghaṭe tathā māsaṃ kuryādbhūmiparigraham ..
sūtrayetkīlayetpaścānmahāmāne dvijottamāḥ .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
मासे घटे तथा मासं कुर्याद्भूमिपरिग्रहम् ॥
सूत्रयेत्कीलयेत्पश्चान्महामाने द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: In the month when the sun is in Aquarius, one should make the acquisition of land for a month. / Afterwards, O best of the twice-born, one should demarcate it with cord and drive stakes according to the great measure.

2.1.s:
tato vāstubaliṃ dadyātkhanitraṃ paripūjayet ..
ābrahmanniti mantreṇa khanayenmadhyadeśataḥ .. 13 ..
2.1.d:
ततो वास्तुबलिं दद्यात्खनित्रं परिपूजयेत् ॥
आब्रह्मन्निति मन्त्रेण खनयेन्मध्यदेशतः ॥ 13 ॥
2.1.m: Then one should offer the vāstubali and worship the spade. / With the mantra beginning with 'ā brahman', one should have it dug out from the middle region.

2.1.s:
ājyena madhuyuktena gātramekaṃ pralepayet ..
svarṇatoyaistathā ratnatoyaiḥ snātvā pralepayet .. 14 ..
2.1.d:
आज्येन मधुयुक्तेन गात्रमेकं प्रलेपयेत् ॥
स्वर्णतोयैस्तथा रत्नतोयैः स्नात्वा प्रलेपयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
2.1.m: One should smear one limb with clarified butter mixed with honey. / Having bathed with water containing gold and water containing gems, one should smear [it].

2.1.s:
īśānābhimukhenaiva kūpapakṣe vidurbudhāḥ ..
akṛtvā vāstuyāgaṃ ca yastaḍāgaṃ samutsṛjet .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
ईशानाभिमुखेनैव कूपपक्षे विदुर्बुधाः ॥
अकृत्वा वास्तुयागं च यस्तडागं समुत्सृजेत् ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: Facing the north-east, the wise know [this rule] in the matter of a well. / Whoever should dedicate a pond without having performed the vāstu sacrifice,

2.1.s:
tasya vaivasvato rājā dharmasyārdhaṃ nikṛntati ..
prāsāde ca tathārāme mahākūpe tathaiva ca .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
तस्य वैवस्वतो राजा धर्मस्यार्धं निकृन्तति ॥
प्रासादे च तथारामे महाकूपे तथैव च ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: King Vaivasvata cuts away half of his merit. / In a temple, and likewise in a pleasure-grove, and in a great well,

2.1.s:
gṛhāraṃbhe ca vipreṃdrā dadyādvāstu baliṃ tataḥ ..
śālaiśca khādiraiścaiva palāśaiḥ keśarasya ca .17..
2.1.d:
गृहारंभे च विप्रेंद्रा दद्याद्वास्तु बलिं ततः ॥
शालैश्च खादिरैश्चैव पलाशैः केशरस्य च .17॥
2.1.m: and at the commencement of a house, O lords of brāhmaṇas, one should then offer the vāstubali. / From śāla, khadira, palāśa, keśara,

2.1.s:
bilvasya bakulasyaiva kalau yūpaḥ praśasyate ..
śunā cakrodarakṛtaṃ tatpārśve tu dhvajadvayam .. 18 ..
2.1.d:
बिल्वस्य बकुलस्यैव कलौ यूपः प्रशस्यते ॥
शुना चक्रोदरकृतं तत्पार्श्वे तु ध्वजद्वयम् ॥ 18 ॥
2.1.m: bilva, and bakula, the sacrificial post is praised in the Kali age. / A pair of banners should be made by its sides, fashioned like a dog with a wheel in the belly.

2.1.s:
sarpākārastaḍāge ca kūpe kumbhākṛtirbhavet ..
ārāme padmapuṣpābhaśchatrakārastu maṃḍale ..19..
2.1.d:
सर्पाकारस्तडागे च कूपे कुम्भाकृतिर्भवेत् ॥
आरामे पद्मपुष्पाभश्छत्रकारस्तु मंडले ॥19॥
2.1.m: For a pond, it should have the shape of a serpent; for a well, the shape of a jar; / in a pleasure-grove, resembling a lotus flower; and shaped like an umbrella in a circular design.

2.1.s:
kuryācchunākṛtiṃ setau viṣṇugehe gadākṛtim ..
aśvākāraṃ cāśvamedhe naramedhe narākṛtim ..2.1.10.20..
2.1.d:
कुर्याच्छुनाकृतिं सेतौ विष्णुगेहे गदाकृतिम् ॥
अश्वाकारं चाश्वमेधे नरमेधे नराकृतिम् ॥2.1.10.20॥
2.1.m: One should make it in the shape of a dog on a dam, and in the shape of a mace in a temple of Viṣṇu; / in the shape of a horse at an aśvamedha, and in the shape of a man at a naramedha;

2.1.s:
goyāge ca vṛṣākāraṃ gṛhayāge dhvajākṛtim ..
śmaśānagopracārārthaṃ caityavṛkṣālayottamāḥ .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
गोयागे च वृषाकारं गृहयागे ध्वजाकृतिम् ॥
श्मशानगोप्रचारार्थं चैत्यवृक्षालयोत्तमाः ॥ 21 ॥
2.1.m: in the shape of a bull at a cow sacrifice, and in the shape of a banner at a house sacrifice; / for a cremation ground and pasture for cows, O best ones, in the shrines of sacred trees;

2.1.s:
cakrākāro lakṣahome koṭihome halākṛtiḥ ..
nakṣatrāṇi tathā mūlaṃ śasyate drumaropaṇe .. 22 ..
2.1.d:
चक्राकारो लक्षहोमे कोटिहोमे हलाकृतिः ॥
नक्षत्राणि तथा मूलं शस्यते द्रुमरोपणे ॥ 22 ॥
2.1.m: in the shape of a wheel at a lakṣahoma, and in the shape of a plough at a koṭihoma. / The asterisms as well as Mūla are praised in the planting of trees.

2.1.s:
evaṃ śasyoditāṃ bhūmiṃ śuddhāṃ pūrvaplavānvitām ..
parigṛhya yajeddevaṃ vanapālaṃ śikhidhvajam ..23..
2.1.d:
एवं शस्योदितां भूमिं शुद्धां पूर्वप्लवान्विताम् ॥
परिगृह्य यजेद्देवं वनपालं शिखिध्वजम् ॥23॥
2.1.m: Having thus taken possession of the pure land praised for crops, sloping towards the east, / one should worship the forest-guardian god who has a peacock banner,

2.1.s:
somaṃ ca nāgarājānaṃ tato bījaṃ suśodhayet ..
ānayeddhārayetpaścādraudratāpena tāpayet.. ..24..
2.1.d:
सोमं च नागराजानं ततो बीजं सुशोधयेत् ॥
आनयेद्धारयेत्पश्चाद्रौद्रतापेन तापयेत्॥ ॥24॥
2.1.m: and Soma, and the king of serpents. Then one should thoroughly purify the seed; / one should bring it, hold it, and afterwards heat it in the fierce heat [of the sun].

2.1.s:
dinadvayāṃtare caiva maṃtraiśca parimaṃtrayet ..
garbhādhānaṃ tataḥ kuryādviṣṇumaṃtraṃ japaṃstridhā .. 25 ..
2.1.d:
दिनद्वयांतरे चैव मंत्रैश्च परिमंत्रयेत् ॥
गर्भाधानं ततः कुर्याद्विष्णुमंत्रं जपंस्त्रिधा ॥ 25 ॥
2.1.m: Within an interval of two days, one should consecrate it with mantras. / Then one should perform the rite of conception, reciting the mantra of Viṣṇu three times.

2.1.s:
evamasyeti maṃtreṇa tridhā japtvā vimārjayet ..
dehi meti ca maṃtreṇa saṃprokṣya daśavāriṇā ..26..
2.1.d:
एवमस्येति मंत्रेण त्रिधा जप्त्वा विमार्जयेत् ॥
देहि मेति च मंत्रेण संप्रोक्ष्य दशवारिणा ॥26॥
2.1.m: Having recited three times with the mantra beginning with 'evam asya', one should wipe it off; / and having sprinkled it with ten waters with the mantra beginning with 'dehi me',

2.1.s:
ityagṛhītamanunā pañcadhā parimaṃtritam ..
tryaṃbakeneti maṃtreṇa bījamāropayettataḥ .. 27 ..
2.1.d:
इत्यगृहीतमनुना पञ्चधा परिमंत्रितम् ॥
त्र्यंबकेनेति मंत्रेण बीजमारोपयेत्ततः ॥ 27 ॥
2.1.m: consecrated fivefold with the mantra beginning with 'ity agṛhīta', / one should then plant the seed with the mantra beginning with 'tryambakena'.

2.1.s:
bhāryāmṛtumatīṃ snātvā pañcame'hani sattamāḥ ..
utsaṃge sthāpayitvā ca cumbayenmaṃtrayettataḥ .. 28 ..
2.1.d:
भार्यामृतुमतीं स्नात्वा पञ्चमेऽहनि सत्तमाः ॥
उत्संगे स्थापयित्वा च चुम्बयेन्मंत्रयेत्ततः ॥ 28 ॥
2.1.m: When one's wife has bathed after her menstrual period on the fifth day, O best of men, / having placed her on one's lap, one should kiss her and then consecrate her with mantras.

2.1.s:
evaṃ vṛkṣasya saṃskāramadhye'pi tvanugacchati ..
tena putratvamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 29 ..
2.1.d:
एवं वृक्षस्य संस्कारमध्येऽपि त्वनुगच्छति ॥
तेन पुत्रत्वमाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 29 ॥
2.1.m: In this way, one also performs the consecration of a tree; / through that, it attains the status of a son—there should be no doubt about this.

2.1.s:
tulasyā bījamādāya vaiṣṇavarkṣe dvijo'hani ..
khānayedapi gomūtrabiṃdutoyaiḥ prasecayet .. 2.1.10.30 ..
2.1.d:
तुलस्या बीजमादाय वैष्णवर्क्षे द्विजोऽहनि ॥
खानयेदपि गोमूत्रबिंदुतोयैः प्रसेचयेत् ॥ 2.1.10.30 ॥
2.1.m: Taking a seed of tulasī on a day under the Vaiṣṇava constellation, a twice-born should dig [a pit] / and sprinkle it with water mixed with drops of cow urine.

2.1.s:
etāṃ tu svargamāpnoti sitakuṃbhe nipātayet ..
ekarātraṃ paristhāpya tata āropayedbhuvi .. 31 ..
2.1.d:
एतां तु स्वर्गमाप्नोति सितकुंभे निपातयेत् ॥
एकरात्रं परिस्थाप्य तत आरोपयेद्भुवि ॥ 31 ॥
2.1.m: He attains heaven through this. He should place [the seed] into a white jar, / keep it there for one night, and then plant it in the earth.

2.1.s:
avidhau kūpavāpyādau khanane sūyate kvacit ..
kurvaṃti sahakārādiropaṇaṃ ye narādhamāḥ ..
labhaṃte na phalaṃ teṣāmiha cābhyetyadhogatim .. 32 ..
2.1.d:
अविधौ कूपवाप्यादौ खनने सूयते क्वचित् ॥
कुर्वंति सहकारादिरोपणं ये नराधमाः ॥
लभंते न फलं तेषामिह चाभ्येत्यधोगतिम् ॥ 32 ॥
2.1.m: When digging a well, tank, or the like is undertaken without following the rules, it sometimes brings forth [ill]; / those vile men who plant mangoes and other trees [irregularly] / obtain no fruit from them, and in this world go to ruin.

2.1.s:
nadītīre śmaśāne ca svagṛhasya ca dakṣiṇe ..
tulasīropaṇaṃ kṛtvā yāti kartā yamālayam .. 33 ..
2.1.d:
नदीतीरे श्मशाने च स्वगृहस्य च दक्षिणे ॥
तुलसीरोपणं कृत्वा याति कर्ता यमालयम् ॥ 33 ॥
2.1.m: Having planted tulasī on a riverbank, in a cremation ground, / or to the south of one's own house, the performer goes to Yama's abode.

2.1.s:
patrapuṣpaphalānāṃ ca rajoreṇusamāgamāḥ ..
poṣayaṃti ca pitaraṃ pratyahaṃ pratikarmaṇi .. 34 ..
2.1.d:
पत्रपुष्पफलानां च रजोरेणुसमागमाः ॥
पोषयंति च पितरं प्रत्यहं प्रतिकर्मणि ॥ 34 ॥
2.1.m: The gatherings of pollen and dust of the leaves, flowers, and fruits / nourish the ancestors day by day in every rite.

2.1.s:
yastu vṛkṣaṃ prakurute chāyāpuṣpaphalopagam ..
pathi devālaye cāpi pāpāttārayate pitṝn..
kīrtiśca mānuṣe loke pratyabhyeti śubhaṃ phalam .. 35 ..
2.1.d:
यस्तु वृक्षं प्रकुरुते छायापुष्पफलोपगम् ॥
पथि देवालये चापि पापात्तारयते पितॄन्॥
कीर्तिश्च मानुषे लोके प्रत्यभ्येति शुभं फलम् ॥ 35 ॥
2.1.m: He who plants a tree that yields shade, flowers, and fruits / along a road or in a temple delivers his ancestors from sin; / fame comes to him in the world of mortals, and an auspicious fruit.

2.1.s:
atītānāgatāścātaḥ pitṝnsa svargato dvijāḥ..
tārayedvṛkṣaropī ca tasmādvṛkṣaṃ praropayeta ..36..
2.1.d:
अतीतानागताश्चातः पितॄन्स स्वर्गतो द्विजाः॥
तारयेद्वृक्षरोपी च तस्माद्वृक्षं प्ररोपयेत ॥36॥
2.1.m: Therefore, O twice-born ones, he who plants a tree delivers his ancestors / of the past and the future, from heaven; therefore one should plant a tree.

2.1.s:
aputrasya hi putrattvaṃ pādapā iha kurvate ..
yatnenāpi ca vipreṃdrā aśvatthāropaṇaṃ kuru .. 37 ..
2.1.d:
अपुत्रस्य हि पुत्रत्त्वं पादपा इह कुर्वते ॥
यत्नेनापि च विप्रेंद्रा अश्वत्थारोपणं कुरु ॥ 37 ॥
2.1.m: For in this world trees perform the function of a son for a childless man; / with effort, O best of brahmins, plant an aśvattha tree.

2.1.s:
śataiḥ putrasahasrāṇāmeka eva viśiṣyate ..
kāmena ropayedviprā ekadvitriprasaṃkhyayā .. 38 ..
2.1.d:
शतैः पुत्रसहस्राणामेक एव विशिष्यते ॥
कामेन रोपयेद्विप्रा एकद्वित्रिप्रसंख्यया ॥ 38 ॥
2.1.m: One alone is distinguished above hundreds and thousands of sons; / with desire, O brahmins, one should plant [them] to the number of one, two, or three.

2.1.s:
muktihetuḥ sahasrāṇāṃ lakṣakoṭīni yāni ca ..
dhanī cāśvatthavṛkṣe ca aśokaḥ śokanāśanaḥ ..39..
2.1.d:
मुक्तिहेतुः सहस्राणां लक्षकोटीनि यानि च ॥
धनी चाश्वत्थवृक्षे च अशोकः शोकनाशनः ॥39॥
2.1.m: It is the cause of liberation for thousands, hundred thousands, and millions; / and [one becomes] wealthy by an aśvattha tree; the aśoka destroys sorrow.

2.1.s:
plakṣo bhāryāpradaścaiva bilva āyuṣyadaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
dhanaprado jaṃbu vṛkṣo brahmadaḥ plakṣavṛkṣakaḥ .. 2.1.10.40 ..
2.1.d:
प्लक्षो भार्याप्रदश्चैव बिल्व आयुष्यदः स्मृतः ॥
धनप्रदो जंबु वृक्षो ब्रह्मदः प्लक्षवृक्षकः ॥ 2.1.10.40 ॥
2.1.m: The plakṣa bestows a wife, and the bilva is said to grant longevity; / the jambu tree grants wealth, and the plakṣa tree grants Brahman.

2.1.s:
tiṃdukātkulavṛddhiḥ syāddāḍimī kāminīpradaḥ ..
bakulo vaṃjulaścaiva pāpahā balabuddhidaḥ .. 41 ..
2.1.d:
तिंदुकात्कुलवृद्धिः स्याद्दाडिमी कामिनीप्रदः ॥
बकुलो वंजुलश्चैव पापहा बलबुद्धिदः ॥ 41 ॥
2.1.m: From the tinduka comes increase of lineage, the pomegranate grants a loving woman; / the bakula and the vañjula remove sin and grant strength and intellect.

2.1.s:
svargapradā dhātakī syādvaṭo mokṣapradāyakaḥ ..
sahakāraḥ kāmaprado guvākaḥ siddhimādiśet .. 42 ..
2.1.d:
स्वर्गप्रदा धातकी स्याद्वटो मोक्षप्रदायकः ॥
सहकारः कामप्रदो गुवाकः सिद्धिमादिशेत् ॥ 42 ॥
2.1.m: The dhātakī bestows heaven, the banyan tree gives liberation; / the mango grants desires, and the betel nut tree indicates attainment.

2.1.s:
sarvaśasyaṃ balabale madhuke cārjune tathā ..
kadaṃbe vipulā kīrtistiṃtiḍī dharmadūṣikaḥ .. 43 ..
2.1.d:
सर्वशस्यं बलबले मधुके चार्जुने तथा ॥
कदंबे विपुला कीर्तिस्तिंतिडी धर्मदूषिकः ॥ 43 ॥
2.1.m: All grain [is produced] when strength and weakness are in the madhuka and arjuna; / abundant fame comes from the kadamba, while the tamarind ruins dharma.

2.1.s:
jīvaṃtyā rogaśāṃtiḥ syātkeśaraḥ śatrumardanaḥ ..
dhanapradaścaiva vaṭo vaṭaḥ śvetavaṭastathā .. 44 ..
2.1.d:
जीवंत्या रोगशांतिः स्यात्केशरः शत्रुमर्दनः ॥
धनप्रदश्चैव वटो वटः श्वेतवटस्तथा ॥ 44 ॥
2.1.m: From the jīvantī comes appeasement of disease, the keśara crushes enemies; / and the banyan tree grants wealth, both the [common] banyan and the white banyan.

2.1.s:
panase maṃdabuddhiḥ syātkali vṛkṣaḥ śriyaṃ haret ..
kalivṛkṣaṃ ca śākhoṭa udarāvartakaṃ tathā .. 45 ..
2.1.d:
पनसे मंदबुद्धिः स्यात्कलि वृक्षः श्रियं हरेत् ॥
कलिवृक्षं च शाखोट उदरावर्तकं तथा ॥ 45 ॥
2.1.m: From the jackfruit tree dull-wittedness arises; the kali tree takes away prosperity; / both the kali tree and the śākhoṭa cause gastric troubles.

2.1.s:
tathā ca markaṭīnīparopaṇātsaṃtatikṣayaḥ ..
śiṃśapāṃ cārjunaṃ caiva jayaṃtī haya mārakān ..
śrīvṛkṣaṃ kiṃśukaṃ caiva ropaṇātsvargamādiśet .. 46 ..
2.1.d:
तथा च मर्कटीनीपरोपणात्संततिक्षयः ॥
शिंशपां चार्जुनं चैव जयंती हय मारकान् ॥
श्रीवृक्षं किंशुकं चैव रोपणात्स्वर्गमादिशेत् ॥ 46 ॥
2.1.m: And likewise, from planting the markaṭī and nīpa comes destruction of offspring; / from planting the śiṃśapā, arjuna, jayantī, oleander, / bilva, and kiṃśuka, heaven is declared.

2.1.s:
na pūrvāṃ ropayejjātu samidhaṃ kaṃṭakīdrumam ..
kuśaṃ padmaṃ jalajānāṃ ropaṇāddurgatiṃ vrajet .. 45 ..
2.1.d:
न पूर्वां रोपयेज्जातु समिधं कंटकीद्रुमम् ॥
कुशं पद्मं जलजानां रोपणाद्दुर्गतिं व्रजेत् ॥ 45 ॥
2.1.m: One should never plant sacrificial firewood or a thorny tree in the east; / from planting kuśa grass, lotus, and water-plants, one goes to misfortune.

2.1.s:
maṃdāre kulahāniḥ syācchālmale śukabuddhimān ..
niṃbe paśuvināśaḥ syācchatrāke kulapāṃsalaḥ .. 48 ..
2.1.d:
मंदारे कुलहानिः स्याच्छाल्मले शुकबुद्धिमान् ॥
निंबे पशुविनाशः स्याच्छत्राके कुलपांसलः ॥ 48 ॥
2.1.m: By the mandāra there is loss of lineage; by the silk-cotton tree one has the intellect of a parrot; / by the neem tree there is destruction of cattle; by the mushroom one defiles the family.

2.1.s:
utpanne kulapātaḥ syā tpaśoreva kṣayo bhavet ..
śatruvṛddhiḥ kākanāde balapūge hataśriyaḥ .. 49 ..
2.1.d:
उत्पन्ने कुलपातः स्या त्पशोरेव क्षयो भवेत् ॥
शत्रुवृद्धिः काकनादे बलपूगे हतश्रियः ॥ 49 ॥
2.1.m: When it springs up, there is the fall of the family and destruction of cattle; / by the kākanāda enemies multiply, and by the balapūga prosperity is destroyed.

2.1.s:
vinā kratau viruddhaśca na siṃhaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
kratau hi syādviruddhaśca prāpnuyānnarakākṛtim .. 2.1.10.50 ..
2.1.d:
विना क्रतौ विरुद्धश्च न सिंहं द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
क्रतौ हि स्याद्विरुद्धश्च प्राप्नुयान्नरकाकृतिम् ॥ 2.1.10.50 ॥
2.1.m: Outside of a sacrifice it is forbidden, and [so is] the lion, O best of brahmins; / for if one is opposed to a sacrifice, he would take the form of hell.

2.1.s:
sahakārasahasrāttu variṣṭhaṃ dhātakīdvayam ..
tasmāccaiva sahasrāddhi pāṭalaikā viśiṣyate .. 51 ..
2.1.d:
सहकारसहस्रात्तु वरिष्ठं धातकीद्वयम् ॥
तस्माच्चैव सहस्राद्धि पाटलैका विशिष्यते ॥ 51 ॥
2.1.m: Two dhātakīs are superior to a thousand mangoes; / and one pāṭalā is distinguished above a thousand of those.

2.1.s:
pāṭalānāṃ śatātpaścādekaraktavaṭo bhavet ..
vaṭānāṃ dvisahasrācca paṃcakaṃ nāgakeśaram .. 52 ..
2.1.d:
पाटलानां शतात्पश्चादेकरक्तवटो भवेत् ॥
वटानां द्विसहस्राच्च पंचकं नागकेशरम् ॥ 52 ॥
2.1.m: After a hundred pāṭalās comes a single red banyan; / and five nāgakeśaras are [superior to] two thousand banyans.

2.1.s:
tasmādvariṣṭhaḥ śrīvṛkṣo jaṃbūvṛkṣaḥ praśasyate ..
tasmāddhimavato jñeyaḥ śrīparṇīvṛkṣa uttamaḥ .. 53 ..
2.1.d:
तस्माद्वरिष्ठः श्रीवृक्षो जंबूवृक्षः प्रशस्यते ॥
तस्माद्धिमवतो ज्ञेयः श्रीपर्णीवृक्ष उत्तमः ॥ 53 ॥
2.1.m: Superior to that is the bilva tree, and the jambu tree is praised; / superior even to that of the Himavat, the śrīparṇī tree is known as supreme.

2.1.s:
tiṃdukasya trayaścaiva jaṃbūvṛkṣasya paṃcakam ..
kadaṃbārjunavṛkṣasya nārikerasya ca trayam ..
evamuktvā sa dharmātmā kārayetkīdṛśaṃ balam .. 54 ..
2.1.d:
तिंदुकस्य त्रयश्चैव जंबूवृक्षस्य पंचकम् ॥
कदंबार्जुनवृक्षस्य नारिकेरस्य च त्रयम् ॥
एवमुक्त्वा स धर्मात्मा कारयेत्कीदृशं बलम् ॥ 54 ॥
2.1.m: Three tindukas and five jambu trees, / three kadambas, arjunas, and coconut trees— / having spoken thus, what kind of strength would that righteous one bring about?

2.1.s:
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca ..
svargabhogaṃ samaśnāti vidhivaddrumaropaṇe .. 55 ..
2.1.d:
कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि कल्पकोटिशतानि च ॥
स्वर्गभोगं समश्नाति विधिवद्द्रुमरोपणे ॥ 55 ॥
2.1.m: For thousands of millions of kalpas and hundreds of millions of kalpas / he enjoys the pleasures of heaven upon planting trees according to rule.

2.1.s:
janmatrayādikaṃ pāpaṃ vināśya svargamādiśet ..
śataropī ca brahmatvaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ ca sahasrake .. 56 ..
2.1.d:
जन्मत्रयादिकं पापं विनाश्य स्वर्गमादिशेत् ॥
शतरोपी च ब्रह्मत्वं विष्णुत्वं च सहस्रके ॥ 56 ॥
2.1.m: Having destroyed the sin of three births and more, [the rite] directs him to heaven; / the planter of a hundred [attains] the state of Brahmā, and the state of Viṣṇu for a thousand.

2.1.s:
tulasīropaṇāccaitra ādhivyādhiyuto bhavet ..
vaiśākhe kīrtimāpnoti jyeṣṭhe tu maraṇaṃ vrajet .. 57 ..
2.1.d:
तुलसीरोपणाच्चैत्र आधिव्याधियुतो भवेत् ॥
वैशाखे कीर्तिमाप्नोति ज्येष्ठे तु मरणं व्रजेत् ॥ 57 ॥
2.1.m: From planting tulasī in Caitra, one becomes afflicted with mental anxiety and bodily disease; / in Vaiśākha he gains fame, but in Jyeṣṭha he goes to death.

2.1.s:
āṣāḍhe kīrtimāpnoti śrāvaṇe paramāṃ gatim ..
bhādre dhanāgamaścaiva āśvine kārtike kṣayaḥ ..
tulasī trividhā loke kṛte śvetā praśasyate .. 58 ..
2.1.d:
आषाढे कीर्तिमाप्नोति श्रावणे परमां गतिम् ॥
भाद्रे धनागमश्चैव आश्विने कार्तिके क्षयः ॥
तुलसी त्रिविधा लोके कृते श्वेता प्रशस्यते ॥ 58 ॥
2.1.m: In Āṣāḍha he gains fame, in Śrāvaṇa the supreme goal; / in Bhādra comes arrival of wealth, and in Āśvina and Kārtika destruction; / tulasī is of three kinds in the world: the white is praised in the Kṛta [Yuga].

2.1.s:
kiṃcicchedaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādaśvatthasya vaṭasya ca ..
śrīvṛkṣasya ca vipreṃdrāḥ sa bhavedbrahmaghātakaḥ .. 59 ..
2.1.d:
किंचिच्छेदं च यः कुर्यादश्वत्थस्य वटस्य च ॥
श्रीवृक्षस्य च विप्रेंद्राः स भवेद्ब्रह्मघातकः ॥ 59 ॥
2.1.m: Whoever makes even a small cut to an aśvattha or a banyan tree, / or to a bilva tree, O best of brahmins, becomes a slayer of a brahmin.

2.1.s:
mūlacchedena vipreṃdrāḥ kulapāto bhavedanu ..
vṛkṣacchedī bhavenmūka ādhivyādhiśataṃ bhajet ..
sāyaṃ prātaśca gharmāṃte śītakāle dināṃtare .. 2.1.10.60 ..
2.1.d:
मूलच्छेदेन विप्रेंद्राः कुलपातो भवेदनु ॥
वृक्षच्छेदी भवेन्मूक आधिव्याधिशतं भजेत् ॥
सायं प्रातश्च घर्मांते शीतकाले दिनांतरे ॥ 2.1.10.60 ॥
2.1.m: By cutting the root, O best of brahmins, the downfall of the family immediately follows; / the cutter of a tree becomes mute and suffers a hundred anxieties and diseases / in the evening and morning, at the end of summer, in the cold season, and from day to day.

2.1.s:
phalamāmakulatthaśca māṣo mudgāstilā yavāḥ ..
nṛtyagītapayaḥkeśaphalapuṣpaprado bhavet .. 61 ..
2.1.d:
फलमामकुलत्थश्च माषो मुद्गास्तिला यवाः ॥
नृत्यगीतपयःकेशफलपुष्पप्रदो भवेत् ॥ 61 ॥
2.1.m: Fruit, raw horse-gram, black gram, green gram, sesame, and barley / grant dance, song, milk, hair, fruit, and flowers.

2.1.s:
avikākasakṛccūrṇaṃ yavacūrṇāni yāni ca ..
gomāṃsamudakaṃ caiva saptarātraṃ nidhāpayet .. 62 ..
2.1.d:
अविकाकसकृच्चूर्णं यवचूर्णानि यानि च ॥
गोमांसमुदकं चैव सप्तरात्रं निधापयेत् ॥ 62 ॥
2.1.m: Powder of sheep and crow dung, whatever barley powders there are, / and beef and water—one should keep [together] for seven nights.

2.1.s:
tamekaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣpādivṛddhidam ..
rohimatsyasya pittāni dhānyākaṃ tatra sthāpayet .. 63 ..
2.1.d:
तमेकं सर्ववृक्षाणां फलपुष्पादिवृद्धिदम् ॥
रोहिमत्स्यस्य पित्तानि धान्याकं तत्र स्थापयेत् ॥ 63 ॥
2.1.m: That single mixture causes increase of fruit, flowers, and the like for all trees; / one should place therein the bile of a rohi fish and coriander.

2.1.s:
tenodakādisekaśca kṛto vai vṛddhimādiśet ..
tittiḍībījamādāya ikṣudaṃḍena mardayet ..64..
2.1.d:
तेनोदकादिसेकश्च कृतो वै वृद्धिमादिशेत् ॥
तित्तिडीबीजमादाय इक्षुदंडेन मर्दयेत् ॥64॥
2.1.m: Sprinkling performed with that [and] water indeed causes increase; / taking seeds of tamarind, one should crush them with a sugarcane stalk.

2.1.s:
tenāśoke prasekaḥ syātsahakārasya vṛddhimān ..
nālikerodakaṃ caiva mākṣikaiḥ saha secayet .. 65 ..
2.1.d:
तेनाशोके प्रसेकः स्यात्सहकारस्य वृद्धिमान् ॥
नालिकेरोदकं चैव माक्षिकैः सह सेचयेत् ॥ 65 ॥
2.1.m: By that, sprinkling an aśoka causes the growth of a mango tree; / and one should sprinkle coconut water along with honey.

2.1.s:
dohadaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ pūgādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
daśaśirābījayutādabhiṣekācca jīvati .. 66 ..
2.1.d:
दोहदं सर्ववृक्षाणां पूगादीनां विशेषतः ॥
दशशिराबीजयुतादभिषेकाच्च जीवति ॥ 66 ॥
2.1.m: This is the fertilizer for all trees, especially for betel nut trees and the like; / and from an aspersion with ten-veined seeds it revives.

2.1.s:
prākprasūtirgavādīnāṃ chāgādimahiṣasya ca ..
jarāsu toyaṃ vṛkṣāgre sthāpayedavicārayan .. 67 ..
2.1.d:
प्राक्प्रसूतिर्गवादीनां छागादिमहिषस्य च ॥
जरासु तोयं वृक्षाग्रे स्थापयेदविचारयन् ॥ 67 ॥
2.1.m: The first delivery of cows and the like, of goats and the like, and of buffalo— / without hesitation one should place the water of their afterbirths on the top of the tree.

2.1.s:
parasya sahakārasya phalaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ..
meṣasya ca vitālasya yavāgūṃ ca samāharet .. 68 ..
2.1.d:
परस्य सहकारस्य फलं स्यान्नात्र संशयः ॥
मेषस्य च वितालस्य यवागूं च समाहरेत् ॥ 68 ॥
2.1.m: The fruit of another mango tree will come forth, there is no doubt about this; / and one should collect the gruel of a ram and of a vitāla.

2.1.s:
tatra māsaiḥ sarṣapaiśca pūrayenmardayettataḥ ..
guvākavṛkṣakaṃ deva gharṣayenmardayettribhiḥ .. 69 ..
2.1.d:
तत्र मासैः सर्षपैश्च पूरयेन्मर्दयेत्ततः ॥
गुवाकवृक्षकं देव घर्षयेन्मर्दयेत्त्रिभिः ॥ 69 ॥
2.1.m: Therein he should fill with black gram and mustard seeds and then crush them; / O divine one, one should rub and pound a betel nut tree with the three [ingredients].

2.1.s:
mṛto'pi jīvayecchīghraṃ mriyamāṇo'pi jīvati ..
niṃbapatraṃ yogapatraṃ śatāvaripunarnavām .. 2.1.10.70 ..
2.1.d:
मृतोऽपि जीवयेच्छीघ्रं म्रियमाणोऽपि जीवति ॥
निंबपत्रं योगपत्रं शतावरिपुनर्नवाम् ॥ 2.1.10.70 ॥
2.1.m: Even if dead, it revives quickly; even when dying, it revives: / neem leaf, yogapatra, śatāvarī, and punarnavā.

2.1.s:
kṣīrikātāmrakaiḥ patrairdhūmaṃ dadyāddinatrayam ..
sahakārasya mūlena kīṭa rodho na jāyate .. 71 ..
2.1.d:
क्षीरिकाताम्रकैः पत्रैर्धूमं दद्याद्दिनत्रयम् ॥
सहकारस्य मूलेन कीट रोधो न जायते ॥ 71 ॥
2.1.m: One should fumigate for three days with leaves of the kṣīrikā and copper-colored [leaves]; / with the root of the fragrant mango tree, no obstruction by insects occurs.

2.1.s:
tataḥ prādhānyato vakṣye drumāṇāṃ dohado'nyathā ..
matsyodakena siktena āmrāṇāṃ vṛddhiriṣyate .. 72 ..
2.1.d:
ततः प्राधान्यतो वक्ष्ये द्रुमाणां दोहदोऽन्यथा ॥
मत्स्योदकेन सिक्तेन आम्राणां वृद्धिरिष्यते ॥ 72 ॥
2.1.m: Next, I shall explain the pregnancy-longing [fertilization] of trees according to importance; otherwise: / with sprinkling of fish-water, growth of mangoes is desired.

2.1.s:
pakvāmraṃ rudhiraṃ caiva dāḍimānāṃ praśasyate ..
yavodakaṃ sagomāṃsaṃ ketakīnāṃ praśasyate .. 73 ..
2.1.d:
पक्वाम्रं रुधिरं चैव दाडिमानां प्रशस्यते ॥
यवोदकं सगोमांसं केतकीनां प्रशस्यते ॥ 73 ॥
2.1.m: Ripe mango and blood are commended for pomegranates; / barley-water with beef is commended for ketakī plants.

2.1.s:
kṣīrake balavṛddhiḥ syāttiṃdukaḥ karamardakaḥ ..
māṃsapūti rasāmajjā śokatāle guvākake .. 74 ..
2.1.d:
क्षीरके बलवृद्धिः स्यात्तिंदुकः करमर्दकः ॥
मांसपूति रसामज्जा शोकताले गुवाकके ॥ 74 ॥
2.1.m: There is increase of vigor in the kṣīraka tree, the tinduka, and the karamardaka; / putrid meat broth and marrow [are commended] for the aśoka, palmyra, and areca palms.

2.1.s:
sapūtimāṃsaṃ saghṛtaṃ nālikerasya rohitam ..
madhuyaṣṭyudakaiḥ sekātsāmānyaṃ nihitaṃ bhavet .. 75 ..
2.1.d:
सपूतिमांसं सघृतं नालिकेरस्य रोहितम् ॥
मधुयष्ट्युदकैः सेकात्सामान्यं निहितं भवेत् ॥ 75 ॥
2.1.m: With putrid meat and with ghee, the growth of the coconut tree [is promoted]; / by watering with liquorice-water, general [nourishment] will be established.

2.1.s:
kapitthabilvayoḥ sekaṃ guḍatoyena secayet ..
jātīnāṃ mallikānāṃ ca kuṃdānāṃ raṃtikasya ca .. 76 ..
2.1.d:
कपित्थबिल्वयोः सेकं गुडतोयेन सेचयेत् ॥
जातीनां मल्लिकानां च कुंदानां रंतिकस्य च ॥ 76 ॥
2.1.m: One should water the wood-apple and bilva trees with jaggery-water; / for jātī, mallikā, kunda, and rantika flowers,

2.1.s:
gaṃdhatoyasitakaraṃ sarpanirmokadhūpakam ..
kūrmamāṃsamannarasaṃ viḍaṃgasya ca puṣpakam .. 77 ..
2.1.d:
गंधतोयसितकरं सर्पनिर्मोकधूपकम् ॥
कूर्ममांसमन्नरसं विडंगस्य च पुष्पकम् ॥ 77 ॥
2.1.m: [one should provide] fragrant water that produces whiteness and incense made of serpent-slough, / turtle meat, the juice of cooked food, and the blossom of viḍaṅga.

2.1.s:
rathyāvṛkṣe pratiṣṭhāpya phalavāñjāyate tataḥ ..
vātasarpasya nirmokaṃ tagarājagavasya ca .. 78 ..
2.1.d:
रथ्यावृक्षे प्रतिष्ठाप्य फलवाञ्जायते ततः ॥
वातसर्पस्य निर्मोकं तगराजगवस्य च ॥ 78 ॥
2.1.m: Fixing it on a roadside tree, it then becomes fruitful. / The slough of a vātasarpa, tagara, and the ajagava,

2.1.s:
dadyāddhūpaṃ dhānyamadhye dhānyavṛddhiśca jāyate ..
mayūrapatramādāyacchāgaromāṇi sapta vai .. 79 ..
2.1.d:
दद्याद्धूपं धान्यमध्ये धान्यवृद्धिश्च जायते ॥
मयूरपत्रमादायच्छागरोमाणि सप्त वै ॥ 79 ॥
2.1.m: one should offer as incense amidst grain, and an increase of grain occurs. / Taking a peacock feather and seven hairs of a goat,

2.1.s:
eraṃḍatailayogena dadyāddhūpaṃ niśāgame ..
hiṃgukusumasaṃyogānmūṣikāṇāṃ parinyaset .. 2.1.10.80 ..
2.1.d:
एरंडतैलयोगेन दद्याद्धूपं निशागमे ॥
हिंगुकुसुमसंयोगान्मूषिकाणां परिन्यसेत् ॥ 2.1.10.80 ॥
2.1.m: one should give fumigation at the arrival of night with the addition of castor oil; / by the combination of asafoetida and flowers, one should apply [it] against mice.

2.1.s:
kariviṣṭhāmṛcchaviṣṭhāṃ kṛttikāyāṃ samāharet ..
niśātoye prasekaḥ syāttatkṣātramūlakaṃ haret .. 81 ..
2.1.d:
करिविष्ठामृच्छविष्ठां कृत्तिकायां समाहरेत् ॥
निशातोये प्रसेकः स्यात्तत्क्षात्रमूलकं हरेत् ॥ 81 ॥
2.1.m: One should collect elephant dung and earth-dung on [the asterism of] Kṛttikā; / there should be sprinkling with turmeric water; it removes that alkali root.

2.1.s:
aśvatthamūle daśahastamātraṃ kṣetraṃ pavitraṃ puruṣottamasya ..
aśvatthacchāyāsalilasya madhye viśeṣato vai tripathaiva gaṃgā .. 82 ..
2.1.d:
अश्वत्थमूले दशहस्तमात्रं क्षेत्रं पवित्रं पुरुषोत्तमस्य ॥
अश्वत्थच्छायासलिलस्य मध्ये विशेषतो वै त्रिपथैव गंगा ॥ 82 ॥
2.1.m: At the root of an aśvattha tree, a ground of merely ten cubits is pure, belonging to Puruṣottama; / in the midst of the water within the shade of an aśvattha tree, it is especially the three-pathed Gaṅgā herself.

2.1.s:
bāhuviṃśāṃtare ropetsahakāraṃ sa dharmavit ..
kalāhastāṃtaraṃ dhātrī bakulaṃ vaṃjulaṃ tathā .. 83 ..
2.1.d:
बाहुविंशांतरे रोपेत्सहकारं स धर्मवित् ॥
कलाहस्तांतरं धात्री बकुलं वंजुलं तथा ॥ 83 ॥
2.1.m: At a distance of twenty arms, the knower of dharma should plant the fragrant mango; / at an interval of four cubits, the dhātrī, the bakula, and the vanjula;

2.1.s:
śraiparṇikaṃ ca punnāgaṃ śrīvṛkṣaṃ dviguṇaṃ tarau ..
haste śailamaye caiva uttamaṃ mānamīritam .. 84 ..
2.1.d:
श्रैपर्णिकं च पुन्नागं श्रीवृक्षं द्विगुणं तरौ ॥
हस्ते शैलमये चैव उत्तमं मानमीरितम् ॥ 84 ॥
2.1.m: the śraiparṇikā, the punnāga, and the śrīvṛkṣa at double that for a tree; / on rocky ground, [this] cubit measure has been declared excellent.

2.1.s:
śaileṣṭakādiracite caturhaste tu saṃmite ..
vāpyādīnāṃ tu kūpānāmekavṛkṣādikasya ca .. 85 ..
2.1.d:
शैलेष्टकादिरचिते चतुर्हस्ते तु संमिते ॥
वाप्यादीनां तु कूपानामेकवृक्षादिकस्य च ॥ 85 ॥
2.1.m: For [waterworks] constructed of stones, bricks, and so forth, measured at four cubits, / of reservoirs and wells, and of a single tree and the like,

2.1.s:
śrīviṣṇorvṛkṣapakṣe ca varuṇeṣṭaṃ ca kūpake ..
gaṇeśaṃ pūjayetkumbhaṃ dikpālāṃśca viśeṣataḥ .. 86 ..
2.1.d:
श्रीविष्णोर्वृक्षपक्षे च वरुणेष्टं च कूपके ॥
गणेशं पूजयेत्कुम्भं दिक्पालांश्च विशेषतः ॥ 86 ॥
2.1.m: [the rite belongs] to the side of the tree for glorious Viṣṇu, and for a well it is dear to Varuṇa. / One should worship Gaṇeśa, the water-jar, and especially the guardians of the directions.

2.1.s:
agnikāryaṃ vinā kuryātprakuryācca satāṃ gatim ..
śrutvā kṛtiṃ vidhānena anyeṣāṃ vā tathodbhavam .. 87 ..
2.1.d:
अग्निकार्यं विना कुर्यात्प्रकुर्याच्च सतां गतिम् ॥
श्रुत्वा कृतिं विधानेन अन्येषां वा तथोद्भवम् ॥ 87 ॥
2.1.m: One may perform [it] without a fire ritual, or one may arrange the path of the virtuous, / having heard the ritual according to the rule, or likewise the emergence of others.

2.1.s:
anyeṣāṃ caiva vṛkṣe ca tathā ca tulasīvane ..
kumbhe vanaspatiḥ sthāpyaḥ pūjayeddhomayettataḥ.. 88 ..
2.1.d:
अन्येषां चैव वृक्षे च तथा च तुलसीवने ॥
कुम्भे वनस्पतिः स्थाप्यः पूजयेद्धोमयेत्ततः॥ 88 ॥
2.1.m: And for other trees as well, and likewise in a grove of tulasī, / the lord of the forest is to be established in a pot; then one should worship and offer oblations.

2.1.s:
vṛkṣānvānena saṃskṛtya vāsobhirabhiveṣṭayet ..
śucyamānamidaṃ jñeyamanyeṣāṃ vā tathodbhavam .. 89 ..
2.1.d:
वृक्षान्वानेन संस्कृत्य वासोभिरभिवेष्टयेत् ॥
शुच्यमानमिदं ज्ञेयमन्येषां वा तथोद्भवम् ॥ 89 ॥
2.1.m: Having consecrated the trees with weaving, one should wrap them with garments; / this should be known as being purified, or likewise the emergence of others.

2.1.s:
tulasyāḥ sahakārasya brahmavṛkṣasya caiva hi ..
aśvatthasya vaṭasyaiva svarṇatāmatha vedhayet .. 2.1.10.90 .. ..
tantrātmakapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
2.1.d:
तुलस्याः सहकारस्य ब्रह्मवृक्षस्य चैव हि ॥
अश्वत्थस्य वटस्यैव स्वर्णतामथ वेधयेत् ॥ 2.1.10.90 ॥ ॥
तन्त्रात्मकप्रतिष्ठावर्णनम्
2.1.m:
One should pierce the golden quality of the tulasī, the fragrant mango, / the tree of Brahmā, the aśvattha, and the banyan.
Description of the Consecration According to Tantra

2.1.s:
.. .. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha taṃtravidhiṃ vakṣye purāṇeṣvapi gīyate ..
tantre caiva pratiṣṭhāṃ ca kuryātpuṇyatame'hani..1..
2.1.d:
॥ ॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अथ तंत्रविधिं वक्ष्ये पुराणेष्वपि गीयते ॥
तन्त्रे चैव प्रतिष्ठां च कुर्यात्पुण्यतमेऽहनि॥1॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / Now I shall declare the ritual of tantra; it is also sung in the Purāṇas; / and one should perform the consecration according to tantra on the most auspicious day.

2.1.s:
śatavṛkṣakṣudravṛkṣe daśadvādaśa vṛkṣake ..
dṛṣṭimātrāṃtare setau kūpayāge samutsṛjet ..2..
2.1.d:
शतवृक्षक्षुद्रवृक्षे दशद्वादश वृक्षके ॥
दृष्टिमात्रांतरे सेतौ कूपयागे समुत्सृजेत् ॥2॥
2.1.m: For a hundred trees, small trees, or ten or twelve trees, / or at a bridge within mere sight, one should dedicate them at the sacrifice for a well.

2.1.s:
na kūpamutsṛjejjātu vṛkṣayāge kathaṃcana ..
tulasīvanayāge tu na cānyaṃ yāgamācaret .. 3 ...
2.1.d:
न कूपमुत्सृजेज्जातु वृक्षयागे कथंचन ॥
तुलसीवनयागे तु न चान्यं यागमाचरेत् ॥ 3 ॥।
2.1.m: One should never dedicate a well at a tree-sacrifice in any way; / and at a sacrifice for a tulasī grove, one should not perform another sacrifice.

2.1.s:
taḍāgayāge setvādīnna cārāme kadācana ..
na setuṃ devayāge tu taḍāgaṃ na samutsṛjet ..4..
2.1.d:
तडागयागे सेत्वादीन्न चारामे कदाचन ॥
न सेतुं देवयागे तु तडागं न समुत्सृजेत् ॥4॥
2.1.m: At a sacrifice for a reservoir, [one should not dedicate] bridges and the like, nor ever in a pleasure-garden; / one should not dedicate a bridge at a sacrifice for the gods, nor a reservoir.

2.1.s:
taṃtre śrāddhaṃ pṛthaṅnāsti karturbhede pṛthagbhavet ..
śivaliṃgasthāpanāyāṃ na cānyaddevasthāpanam ..5..
2.1.d:
तंत्रे श्राद्धं पृथङ्नास्ति कर्तुर्भेदे पृथग्भवेत् ॥
शिवलिंगस्थापनायां न चान्यद्देवस्थापनम् ॥5॥
2.1.m: In a tantra, a separate ancestral rite does not exist; with a change of the agent, it would be separate; / at the installation of a liṅga of Śiva, there is no installation of any other deity.

2.1.s:
svadeśe varjayettaṃ taṃ svatantreṇa vidhīyate ..
viparīte kṛte cāpi āyuḥkṣaya iti smṛtiḥ ..6..
2.1.d:
स्वदेशे वर्जयेत्तं तं स्वतन्त्रेण विधीयते ॥
विपरीते कृते चापि आयुःक्षय इति स्मृतिः ॥6॥
2.1.m: In one's own region, one should avoid that which is prescribed by another tantra; / and if it is done inversely, it causes the loss of lifespan—such is the tradition.

2.1.s:
taḍāge puṣkariṇyā vā ārāme'pi dvijottamāḥ ..
mānahīne mānapūrṇe daśahaste na dūṣaṇam..7..
2.1.d:
तडागे पुष्करिण्या वा आरामेऽपि द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
मानहीने मानपूर्णे दशहस्ते न दूषणम्॥7॥
2.1.m: O best of the twice-born, in a reservoir, a lotus pool, or even a garden, / whether deficient in measure or full in measure, at ten cubits there is no fault.

2.1.s:
dvisahasrādhikaṃ yatra tatpratiṣṭhāṃ samācaret..
daśa dvādaśavṛkṣe ca ārāme pūrvavaddvijāḥ ..8..
2.1.d:
द्विसहस्राधिकं यत्र तत्प्रतिष्ठां समाचरेत्॥
दश द्वादशवृक्षे च आरामे पूर्ववद्द्विजाः ॥8॥
2.1.m: Where it is more than two thousand [measures], there one should perform its consecration; / and for ten or twelve trees in an orchard, O twice-born, [it is] as before.

2.1.s:
pratiṣṭhāṃ bilvavṛkṣe ca anyathā karṇavedhanam ..
kuryāddohadadānaṃ ca tatra nirmaṃthanādikam ..9..
2.1.d:
प्रतिष्ठां बिल्ववृक्षे च अन्यथा कर्णवेधनम् ॥
कुर्याद्दोहददानं च तत्र निर्मंथनादिकम् ॥9॥
2.1.m: At the consecration for a bilva tree, or otherwise at ear-piercing, / one should perform the offering for pregnancy-longing, and there churning and so forth.

2.1.s:
anaṃtaraṃ pradātavyā lājā mūrdhnyakṣatādikam .. 2.1.11.10 .. ..
pratimālakṣaṇavarṇanam
2.1.d:
अनंतरं प्रदातव्या लाजा मूर्ध्न्यक्षतादिकम् ॥ 2.1.11.10 ॥ ॥
प्रतिमालक्षणवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
Immediately afterward, parched grain, unbroken rice, and the like are to be offered on the crown of the head.
Description of the Characteristics of an Image

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
pratimālakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yathāśāstramataṃ dvijāḥ ..
pratimāṃ lakṣaṇairhīnāṃ gṛhītāṃ naiva pūjayet .. 1 ..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रतिमालक्षणं वक्ष्ये यथाशास्त्रमतं द्विजाः ॥
प्रतिमां लक्षणैर्हीनां गृहीतां नैव पूजयेत् ॥ 1 ॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / I shall declare the characteristics of an image according to the view of the treatises, O twice-born; / one must not worship an image accepted [if it is] devoid of the [proper] characteristics.

2.1.s:
śailajā dārujā tāmrī mṛdbhavā sarvakāmadā ..
ekahastā dvihastā vā sārdhahastā tathāpi vā .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
शैलजा दारुजा ताम्री मृद्भवा सर्वकामदा ॥
एकहस्ता द्विहस्ता वा सार्धहस्ता तथापि वा ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: Born of stone, born of wood, made of copper, or produced from clay, it grants all desires; / whether one cubit, two cubits, or even one and a half cubits,

2.1.s:
prāsādamānamathavā athavā sarvalakṣaṇam ..
aṣṭāṃgulotsedhakaṃ ca na gehe'rcayetkṛtī .. 3 ..
2.1.d:
प्रासादमानमथवा अथवा सर्वलक्षणम् ॥
अष्टांगुलोत्सेधकं च न गेहेऽर्चयेत्कृती ॥ 3 ॥
2.1.m: or the measure of the temple, or endowed with all the characteristics; / a wise man should not worship in the house one having an elevation of eight digits.

2.1.s:
devāgārasya yaddvāraṃ tasmādaṣṭāṃgulena tu ..
tribhāgapiṃḍikā kāryā dvau bhāgau pratimā bhavet .. 4 ..
2.1.d:
देवागारस्य यद्द्वारं तस्मादष्टांगुलेन तु ॥
त्रिभागपिंडिका कार्या द्वौ भागौ प्रतिमा भवेत् ॥ 4 ॥
2.1.m: Relative to the door of the shrine of the deity, by eight digits from that, / the pedestal should be made of one third, [and] the image should be two parts.

2.1.s:
aṃgulaṃ vai bhavedvṛddhiraśītiścaturuttarā..
vistāramānataḥ kāryaṃ vadanaṃ dvādaśāṃgulam .. 5 ..
2.1.d:
अंगुलं वै भवेद्वृद्धिरशीतिश्चतुरुत्तरा॥
विस्तारमानतः कार्यं वदनं द्वादशांगुलम् ॥ 5 ॥
2.1.m: The increase should indeed be one digit, up to eighty-four; / according to the measure of width, the face should be made twelve digits.

2.1.s:
mukhatribhāge cibukaṃ lalāṭaṃ nāsikāṃ tathā ..
karṇau nāsikayā grīvātulyau vā niyatau tu yau .. 6 ..
2.1.d:
मुखत्रिभागे चिबुकं ललाटं नासिकां तथा ॥
कर्णौ नासिकया ग्रीवातुल्यौ वा नियतौ तु यौ ॥ 6 ॥
2.1.m: In the three parts of the face are the chin, forehead, and likewise the nose; / the two ears are equal to the nose, or the neck, which are fixed.

2.1.s:
nayane dvyaṃgule syātāṃ tribhāgā tārakā bhavet ..
tṛtīyatārakābhāge śubhadṛṣṭiṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 7 ..
2.1.d:
नयने द्व्यंगुले स्यातां त्रिभागा तारका भवेत् ॥
तृतीयतारकाभागे शुभदृष्टिं विचक्षणः ॥ 7 ॥
2.1.m: The two eyes should be two digits; the pupil should be a third part; / in the third part of the pupil, the expert [places] the auspicious gaze.

2.1.s:
lalāṭamastakagrīvaṃ kuryāttatsamameva tu ..
pariṇāhastu śiraso bhaveddvātriṃśadaṃgulaḥ .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
ललाटमस्तकग्रीवं कुर्यात्तत्सममेव तु ॥
परिणाहस्तु शिरसो भवेद्द्वात्रिंशदंगुलः ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: One should make the forehead, head, and neck indeed equal to that; / and the circumference of the head should be thirty-two digits.

2.1.s:
tulyau nāsikayā grīvā mukhena hṛdayāṃtaram ..
atha vistārapaṃktistu tato'rdhaṃ tu kaṭiḥ sadā .. 9 ..
2.1.d:
तुल्यौ नासिकया ग्रीवा मुखेन हृदयांतरम् ॥
अथ विस्तारपंक्तिस्तु ततोऽर्धं तु कटिः सदा ॥ 9 ॥
2.1.m: Equal to the nose is the neck; the chest interval is equal to the face; / now, the width of the row [of shoulders] is [fixed], and the waist is always half of that.

2.1.s:
bāhū ca bāhutulyau ca ūrū jaṃghe ca jāghanam ..
gulphāvasthnastu pādaḥ syāddhāṭitaścaturaṃgulaḥ ..
ṣaḍaṃgulastu vistārastulyāṃguṣṭhoṃ'gulatrayam .. 2.1.12.10 ..
2.1.d:
बाहू च बाहुतुल्यौ च ऊरू जंघे च जाघनम् ॥
गुल्फावस्थ्नस्तु पादः स्याद्धाटितश्चतुरंगुलः ॥
षडंगुलस्तु विस्तारस्तुल्यांगुष्ठोंऽगुलत्रयम् ॥ 2.1.12.10 ॥
2.1.m: The two arms are equal to [each other's] arms, the two thighs, two shanks, and the hips; / the foot from the ankle bone should be laid out as four digits, / but its width is six digits, with the big toe equal at three digits.

2.1.s:
pradeśinī ca tattulyā hīnā śeṣānnakhānakham ..
caturdaśāṃgulaḥ pādasyāyāmaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 11 ..
2.1.d:
प्रदेशिनी च तत्तुल्या हीना शेषान्नखानखम् ॥
चतुर्दशांगुलः पादस्यायामः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 11 ॥
2.1.m: And the foretoe is equal to that; the remaining ones diminish nail by nail; / the length of the foot is proclaimed to be fourteen digits.

2.1.s:
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktā sā pūjyā pratimā śubhā ..
adharoṣṭhastathaivorubhrūlalāṭamanīṣikam .. 12 ..
2.1.d:
एवं लक्षणसंयुक्ता सा पूज्या प्रतिमा शुभा ॥
अधरोष्ठस्तथैवोरुभ्रूललाटमनीषिकम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.1.m: Endowed with such characteristics, that auspicious image is to be worshipped: / the lower lip, and likewise the thigh, eyebrow, forehead, [made according to] intellect.

2.1.s:
gaṃḍaṃ ca niyataṃ mūrtau kuryādaṃgasamunnateḥ ..
viśālanayanastāmrapado vāyatalocanaḥ .. 13 ..
2.1.d:
गंडं च नियतं मूर्तौ कुर्यादंगसमुन्नतेः ॥
विशालनयनस्ताम्रपदो वायतलोचनः ॥ 13 ॥
2.1.m: And on the icon, the wise man should unfailingly make the cheek proportionate to the elevation of the body, / [having] wide eyes, red-tinted feet, or long eyes.

2.1.s:
savitānala patrasya cāruvidyādharastathā ..
vatsaprokto'timukuṭaḥ kaṭakāṃgadahāravān .. 14 ..
2.1.d:
सवितानल पत्रस्य चारुविद्याधरस्तथा ॥
वत्सप्रोक्तोऽतिमुकुटः कटकांगदहारवान् ॥ 14 ॥
2.1.m: [An image of] Savitṛ, having the radiance of fire, with handsome Vidyādharas, / declared by the sage Vatsa, with a towering diadem, wearing bracelets, armlets, and necklaces,

2.1.s:
abhyaṃgapadabandhādi sāmānyenopaśobhi ca ..
suprabhāmaṃḍalā cāru vicitramaṇikuṇḍalā .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
अभ्यंगपदबन्धादि सामान्येनोपशोभि च ॥
सुप्रभामंडला चारु विचित्रमणिकुण्डला ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: and generally adorned with anointings, foot-bindings, and the like, / possessing a splendid halo, wearing charming earrings of diverse gems,

2.1.s:
karābhyāṃ kāṃcanīṃ mālāṃ prodvahaṃtīṃ śiroruhān..
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kārayedvihitapradām .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
कराभ्यां कांचनीं मालां प्रोद्वहंतीं शिरोरुहान्॥
एवं लक्षणसंपन्नां कारयेद्विहितप्रदाम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: raising a golden garland with both hands [above] the hair on the head — / one should make [her], endowed with such characteristics, granting what is prescribed.

2.1.s:
susnigdhāṃ varadāṃ saumyāṃ dvitīyāśramiṇāmimām ..
navatālo bhavedviṣṇurvāsudevastritālakaḥ .. 17 ..
2.1.d:
सुस्निग्धां वरदां सौम्यां द्वितीयाश्रमिणामिमाम् ॥
नवतालो भवेद्विष्णुर्वासुदेवस्त्रितालकः ॥ 17 ॥
2.1.m: Very glossy, bestowing boons, gentle, this [image is] for householders. / Viṣṇu should be nine tālas, [and] Vāsudeva three tālas.

2.1.s:
nṛsiṃhaḥ pañcatālaḥ syāddhayagrīvastu paṃcamaḥ ..
nārāyaṇaścāṣṭatālo maheśaḥ pañcatālakaḥ .. 18 ..
2.1.d:
नृसिंहः पञ्चतालः स्याद्धयग्रीवस्तु पंचमः ॥
नारायणश्चाष्टतालो महेशः पञ्चतालकः ॥ 18 ॥
2.1.m: Nṛsiṃha should be five tālas, and Hayagrīva fifth; / Nārāyaṇa eight tālas, and Maheśa five tālas.

2.1.s:
navatālā bhaveddurgā lakṣmīścaiva tritālikā ..
vāṇīṃ tritālikāṃ vidyātsavitā saptatālakaḥ .. 19 ..
2.1.d:
नवताला भवेद्दुर्गा लक्ष्मीश्चैव त्रितालिका ॥
वाणीं त्रितालिकां विद्यात्सविता सप्ततालकः ॥ 19 ॥
2.1.m: Durgā should be nine tālas, and Lakṣmī indeed three tālas; / one should know Vāṇī to be three tālas, [and] Savitṛ seven tālas.

2.1.s:
dakṣiṇe vāsudevasya kare cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
śaṃkho bhavecca tadadho vāmārdhe tasya vai gadā .. 2.1.12.20 ..
2.1.d:
दक्षिणे वासुदेवस्य करे चक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
शंखो भवेच्च तदधो वामार्धे तस्य वै गदा ॥ 2.1.12.20 ॥
2.1.m: The discus is established in Vāsudeva's right hand; / the conch should be below it, and indeed the club in his left half.

2.1.s:
tadadhaśca bhavetpadmaṃ śrīvatsenopaśobhitam ..
savye'rdhe tārakāsyaṃ ca trinetramubhayātmakam .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
तदधश्च भवेत्पद्मं श्रीवत्सेनोपशोभितम् ॥
सव्येऽर्धे तारकास्यं च त्रिनेत्रमुभयात्मकम् ॥ 21 ॥
2.1.m: Below that should be the lotus, adorned with the Śrīvatsa; / and in the left half, having the pupil in the face, three-eyed, partaking of both natures.

2.1.s:
pārśve nalinasiṃhau dvau subhadrāṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset ..
rukmiṇī vāmabhāge ca tadadhastāddivīṃdrakam .. 22 ..
2.1.d:
पार्श्वे नलिनसिंहौ द्वौ सुभद्रां दक्षिणे न्यसेत् ॥
रुक्मिणी वामभागे च तदधस्ताद्दिवींद्रकम् ॥ 22 ॥
2.1.m: At the flanks are two: a lotus and a lion; one should place Subhadrā on the right, / Rukmiṇī on the left side, and beneath that the lord of heaven.

2.1.s:
kṛtāṃjalipuṭasthaśca nāradaḥ kapilastathā ..
dharmādharmāvubhau pārśve kartavyau sragviṇāṃ varau .. 23 ..
2.1.d:
कृतांजलिपुटस्थश्च नारदः कपिलस्तथा ॥
धर्माधर्मावुभौ पार्श्वे कर्तव्यौ स्रग्विणां वरौ ॥ 23 ॥
2.1.m: Nārada and Kapila stand with cupped hands folded; / both Dharma and Adharma should be made on either side, foremost among those wearing garlands.

2.1.s:
yadugraṃ vāsudevasya tathā nārāyaṇasya ca ..
vaiparītyaṃ vijānīyānmādhavānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 24 ..
2.1.d:
यदुग्रं वासुदेवस्य तथा नारायणस्य च ॥
वैपरीत्यं विजानीयान्माधवानां तथैव च ॥ 24 ॥
2.1.m: Whatever is terrible of Vāsudeva, and likewise of Nārāyaṇa, / one should know to be inverted; and likewise of the forms of Mādhava.

2.1.s:
tīrthe girau taḍāge ca samīpe sthāpayetsudhīḥ ..
nagaragrāmamadhye vā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃsadi .. 25 ..
2.1.d:
तीर्थे गिरौ तडागे च समीपे स्थापयेत्सुधीः ॥
