2.1.m: In an ayutahoma, they should perform it without indulging in excessive elaboration. / Likewise, eight officiating priests multiplied by ten in a ninefold sacrifice;

2.1.s:
kartavyāḥ śaktitastadvaccatvāro'pi vimatsarāḥ ..
tameva pūjayedbrahmā dvau vā trīnvā yathāvidhi .. 32 ..
2.1.d:
कर्तव्याः शक्तितस्तद्वच्चत्वारोऽपि विमत्सराः ॥
तमेव पूजयेद्ब्रह्मा द्वौ वा त्रीन्वा यथाविधि ॥ 32 ॥
2.1.m: or, according to capacity, four free from malice should be engaged. / The Brahman priest should worship that very one, or two or three according to rule.

2.1.s:
ekamapyarcayedbrahmā sahasre tvekabrāhmaṇam ..
dakṣiṇābhiḥ prayatnena nirvahedalpavittavān .. 33 ..
2.1.d:
एकमप्यर्चयेद्ब्रह्मा सहस्रे त्वेकब्राह्मणम् ॥
दक्षिणाभिः प्रयत्नेन निर्वहेदल्पवित्तवान् ॥ 33 ॥
2.1.m: In a thousand [oblations], the Brahman priest should worship even a single Brahmin. / A man of small means should carry it out with effort by paying sacrificial fees.

2.1.s:
lakṣahomastu kartavyo yadā vittaṃ bhavettadā ..
yataḥ sarvamavāpnoti kuryātkāmavidhānataḥ .. 34 ..
2.1.d:
लक्षहोमस्तु कर्तव्यो यदा वित्तं भवेत्तदा ॥
यतः सर्वमवाप्नोति कुर्यात्कामविधानतः ॥ 34 ॥
2.1.m: A lakṣahoma, however, should be performed when wealth is available, / because he attains everything; he should perform it according to the rule of desire.

2.1.s:
pūjyate śivaloke ca vasvādityamarudgaṇaiḥ ..
yāvatkalpaśatānyaṣṭāvaṃte mokṣamavāpnuyāt .. 35 ..
2.1.d:
पूज्यते शिवलोके च वस्वादित्यमरुद्गणैः ॥
यावत्कल्पशतान्यष्टावंते मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 35 ॥
2.1.m: He is worshipped in the world of Śiva by the Vasus, Ādityas, and the hosts of Maruts / for eight hundred kalpas, and in the end he attains liberation.

2.1.s:
akāmo yastvimaṃ kuryāllakṣahomaṃ yathāvidhi ..
śatakāmamavāpnoti padaṃ cānaṃtyamaśnute .. 36 ..
2.1.d:
अकामो यस्त्विमं कुर्याल्लक्षहोमं यथाविधि ॥
शतकाममवाप्नोति पदं चानंत्यमश्नुते ॥ 36 ॥
2.1.m: Whoever, free from selfish desire, performs this lakṣahoma according to rule, / obtains a hundred desires and reaches an imperishable state.

2.1.s:
putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam ..
bhāryāthīṃ labhate bhāryāṃ kumārī ca śubhaṃ patim .. 37 ..
2.1.d:
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रं धनार्थी लभते धनम् ॥
भार्याथीं लभते भार्यां कुमारी च शुभं पतिम् ॥ 37 ॥
2.1.m: One desiring a son obtains a son; one desiring wealth obtains wealth; / one desiring a wife obtains a wife, and an unmarried maiden [obtains] an auspicious husband.

2.1.s:
bhraṣṭarājyastathā rājyaṃ śrīkāmaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt ..
yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ sarvaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam .. 38 ..
2.1.d:
भ्रष्टराज्यस्तथा राज्यं श्रीकामः श्रियमाप्नुयात् ॥
यं यं कामयते कामं सर्वं प्राप्नोति पुष्कलम् ॥ 38 ॥
2.1.m: One fallen from kingship obtains his kingdom, and one desiring prosperity obtains prosperity. / Whatever desire he desires, he attains it all in abundance.

2.1.s:
niṣkāmaḥ kurute yastu paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ..
tasmācchataguṇaḥ proktaḥ koṭihomaḥ svayaṃbhuvā .. 39 ..
2.1.d:
निष्कामः कुरुते यस्तु परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति ॥
तस्माच्छतगुणः प्रोक्तः कोटिहोमः स्वयंभुवा ॥ 39 ॥
2.1.m: Whoever performs it without desire reaches the highest Brahman. / Therefore, the koṭihoma was declared by the Self-born to be a hundred times superior.

2.1.s:
ācārya eva hotā syādbrāhmaṇānāmasaṃbhave ..
na yojayedekameva cāyute homakarmaṇi .. 2.1.20.40 ..
2.1.d:
आचार्य एव होता स्याद्ब्राह्मणानामसंभवे ॥
न योजयेदेकमेव चायुते होमकर्मणि ॥ 2.1.20.40 ॥
2.1.m: The ācārya himself may be the hotṛ in the absence of Brahmins. / One should not employ only one in the offering rite of ten thousand [oblations].

2.1.s:
darbhāsane'to na kuśe tṛṇe pattre tvace'pi ca ..
pāṣāṇe mṛttikāyāṃ ca na ca vastrāsane kvacit .. 41 ..
2.1.d:
दर्भासनेऽतो न कुशे तृणे पत्त्रे त्वचेऽपि च ॥
पाषाणे मृत्तिकायां च न च वस्त्रासने क्वचित् ॥ 41 ॥
2.1.m: Therefore, not on a seat of darbha, nor of kuśa, grass, leaves, or bark; / nor on stone or earth, nor ever on a cloth seat.

2.1.s:
tatra dārumayaṃ kuryādāgamaṃ bhajate dvijaḥ ..
dānaṃ dadyācca homāṃte pūrṇādau ca yathā bhavet .. 42 ..
2.1.d:
तत्र दारुमयं कुर्यादागमं भजते द्विजः ॥
दानं दद्याच्च होमांते पूर्णादौ च यथा भवेत् ॥ 42 ॥
2.1.m: There, the twice-born should make a wooden seat, adhering to traditional teaching. / And he should give gifts at the end of the oblation and at the full offering, as appropriate.

2.1.s:
dvijasaṃskārakāryeṣu pūrṇādau cāpi dakṣiṇā ..
maṃtropāsanakāryeṣu somayāgāśvamedhake .. 43 .. ..
maṇḍalavidhivarṇanam
2.1.d:
द्विजसंस्कारकार्येषु पूर्णादौ चापि दक्षिणा ॥
मंत्रोपासनकार्येषु सोमयागाश्वमेधके ॥ 43 ॥ ॥
मण्डलविधिवर्णनम्
2.1.m:
In the rites of the sacraments of the twice-born, and at the full offering, a sacrificial fee [is given]; / in the practices of mantra-worship, and in the Soma sacrifice and the horse sacrifice.
Description of the Rules for Mandalas

2.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
athāto maṃḍalaṃ vakṣye purāṇeṣu yathoditam ..
yadadhīnā bhavetsiddhistasmātkuryātsamāhitaḥ .. 1 ..
2.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातो मंडलं वक्ष्ये पुराणेषु यथोदितम् ॥
यदधीना भवेत्सिद्धिस्तस्मात्कुर्यात्समाहितः ॥ 1 ॥
2.1.m: Sūta said: / Now I shall explain the mandala as spoken in the Purāṇas, / upon which success depends; therefore, one should make it with concentration.

2.1.s:
devāḥ padmāsanasthāśca bhaviṣyaṃti vasaṃti ca ..
vinābjaṃ nārcayeddevīmarcite yakṣiṇī haret .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
देवाः पद्मासनस्थाश्च भविष्यंति वसंति च ॥
विनाब्जं नार्चयेद्देवीमर्चिते यक्षिणी हरेत् ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m: The gods will be seated and dwell on lotus seats. / Without a lotus, one must not worship the goddess; if worshipped [otherwise], a yakṣiṇī snatches it away.

2.1.s:
ato maṃḍalavicchedaṃ yasmāddaśaguṇaṃ bhavet ..
rajaḥsādhye śataguṇaṃ kevale dviguṇaṃ phalam .. 3..
2.1.d:
अतो मंडलविच्छेदं यस्माद्दशगुणं भवेत् ॥
रजःसाध्ये शतगुणं केवले द्विगुणं फलम् ॥ 3॥
2.1.m: Hence, drawing a mandala yields tenfold [merit]; / executed with coloured powder, a hundredfold; simply drawn, twofold the fruit.

2.1.s:
triśataṃ vaṃdane sādhye sahasraṃ ca rajo'ṣṭakam ..
rajobhiḥ ṣoḍaśairbiṃbaṃ śataṃśatamanaṃtakam .. 4 ..
2.1.d:
त्रिशतं वंदने साध्ये सहस्रं च रजोऽष्टकम् ॥
रजोभिः षोडशैर्बिंबं शतंशतमनंतकम् ॥ 4 ॥
2.1.m: In paying homage it yields three hundredfold, and with eight powders, a thousandfold. / A design made with sixteen powders yields a hundred upon a hundred, endless [merit].

2.1.s:
yantre maṇau śālagrāme pratimāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
mahālaye mahāyonau raktaliṃge ca sādhikam .. 5 ..
2.1.d:
यन्त्रे मणौ शालग्रामे प्रतिमायां विशेषतः ॥
महालये महायोनौ रक्तलिंगे च साधिकम् ॥ 5 ॥
2.1.m: Especially on a yantra, a gem, a Śālagrāma stone, an image, / a Mahālaya, a Mahāyoni, and on a red liṅga, it is superior.

2.1.s:
rajoyuktaṃ likhedyastu pūjākārye vibhūtaye ..
karaṇādiphalaṃ yasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet ..6..
2.1.d:
रजोयुक्तं लिखेद्यस्तु पूजाकार्ये विभूतये ॥
करणादिफलं यस्मात्तस्मात्तत्परिवर्जयेत् ॥6॥
2.1.m: Whoever draws it with powders for prosperity in a worship ritual— / since [otherwise] the fruit of the action is lost, he should therefore avoid that.

2.1.s:
caturasraṃ navaṃ vyūhaṃ krauṃcaprāṇaṃ catu rvidham ..
kāmabījaṃ vajranābhaṃ vighnarājaṃ gajāhvayam .. 7 ..
2.1.d:
चतुरस्रं नवं व्यूहं क्रौंचप्राणं चतु र्विधम् ॥
कामबीजं वज्रनाभं विघ्नराजं गजाह्वयम् ॥ 7 ॥
2.1.m: The fourfold Caturasra, Navavyūha, and Krauñcaprāṇa, / the Kāmabīja, Vajranābha, Vighnarāja, and Gajasaṃjña,

2.1.s:
pārijātaṃ caṃdrabiṃbaṃ sūryakāṃtaṃ ca śekharam ..
śatapatraṃ sahasrāraṃ navanābhaṃ ca muṣṭikam .. .. 8 ..
2.1.d:
पारिजातं चंद्रबिंबं सूर्यकांतं च शेखरम् ॥
शतपत्रं सहस्रारं नवनाभं च मुष्टिकम् ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
2.1.m: the Pārijāta, Candrabimba, Sūryakānta, and Śekhara, / the Śatapatra, Sahasrāra, Navanābha, and Muṣṭika,

2.1.s:
paṃcābjaṃ caiva mainākaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca puṣkaram ..
aṣṭāsraṃ caiva śrībiṃbaṃ ṣaḍasraṃ tryasrameva tu ..9..
2.1.d:
पंचाब्जं चैव मैनाकं कामराजं च पुष्करम् ॥
अष्टास्रं चैव श्रीबिंबं षडस्रं त्र्यस्रमेव तु ॥9॥
2.1.m: the Pañcābja, Maināka, Kāmarāja, and Puṣkara, / the octagonal, the Śrībimba, the hexagonal, and the triangular.

2.1.s:
catvāriṃśattathā paṃcasvādhikaṃ parisaṃkhyayā ..
caturasraṃ navavyūḍhaṃ vaiṣṇave yāgakarmaṇi .. 2.1.21.10 ..
2.1.d:
चत्वारिंशत्तथा पंचस्वाधिकं परिसंख्यया ॥
चतुरस्रं नवव्यूढं वैष्णवे यागकर्मणि ॥ 2.1.21.10 ॥
2.1.m: In counting, they are forty-five in total. / In a sacrifice to Viṣṇu, the Caturasra and the Navavyūḍha [are prescribed].

2.1.s:
praśastaṃ cāpi gomedhe krauṃcaṃ ghrāṇaṃ caturvidham ..
subhadraṃ cāśvamedhe ca naramedhe narāsanam .. 11 ..
2.1.d:
प्रशस्तं चापि गोमेधे क्रौंचं घ्राणं चतुर्विधम् ॥
सुभद्रं चाश्वमेधे च नरमेधे नरासनम् ॥ 11 ॥
2.1.m: In a cattle sacrifice, Krauñcaprāṇa of four types is recommended; / Subhadra in a horse sacrifice, and Narāsana in a human sacrifice.

2.1.s:
sarvatra sarvatobhadraṃ caturasraṃ subhadrakam ..
kāmarājaṃ tathā tryasramaṣṭāsraṃ ca ṣaḍasrakam ..12..
2.1.d:
सर्वत्र सर्वतोभद्रं चतुरस्रं सुभद्रकम् ॥
कामराजं तथा त्र्यस्रमष्टास्रं च षडस्रकम् ॥12॥
2.1.m: Everywhere the Sarvatobhadra, Caturasra, and Subhadra [are suitable], / and likewise Kāmarāja, the triangular, the octagonal, and the hexagonal.

2.1.s:
śaktānāṃ kāmapakṣe ca paṃcasiṃhāsanaṃ mahat ..
dhyānācale merupṛṣṭhaṃ maṇimuktācaleṣvapi .. 13 ..
2.1.d:
शक्तानां कामपक्षे च पंचसिंहासनं महत् ॥
ध्यानाचले मेरुपृष्ठं मणिमुक्ताचलेष्वपि ॥ 13 ॥
2.1.m: For capable persons on the side of desire, the great Pañcasiṃhāsana [is prescribed]. / On Dhyānācala, Merupṛṣṭha, and also on the mountains of jewels and pearls,

2.1.s:
sahasraṃ śatapatraṃ ca annadāne tilācale ..
harivallabhaṃ rājasūye somayāgeṣu śasyate .. 14 ..
2.1.d:
सहस्रं शतपत्रं च अन्नदाने तिलाचले ॥
हरिवल्लभं राजसूये सोमयागेषु शस्यते ॥ 14 ॥
2.1.m: the Sahasra and Śatapatra [are used] in gifts of food and the mountain of sesame seeds; / Harivallabha is praised in the Rājasūya and in Soma sacrifices.

2.1.s:
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ subhadraṃ ca sarvatobhadrameva ca ..
jalāśayapratiṣṭhāyāṃ vighnarājaṃ praśasyate .. 15 ..
2.1.d:
प्रतिष्ठायां सुभद्रं च सर्वतोभद्रमेव च ॥
जलाशयप्रतिष्ठायां विघ्नराजं प्रशस्यते ॥ 15 ॥
2.1.m: In consecration rites, Subhadra and Sarvatobhadra [are praised], / and in the consecration of a water reservoir, Vighnarāja is recommended.

2.1.s:
ghaṭaprasthāpane caiva gajāhvaṃ turagāsanam ..
śatapatraṃ lakṣahome ayute caturasrakam .. 16 ..
2.1.d:
घटप्रस्थापने चैव गजाह्वं तुरगासनम् ॥
शतपत्रं लक्षहोमे अयुते चतुरस्रकम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.1.m: In the installation of the pitcher, the Gajasaṃjña and Turagāsana [are prescribed]; / the Śatapatra in a lakṣahoma, and the Caturasra in an ayuta.

2.1.s:
yasya yajñasya yadbiṃbaṃ tattu tenaiva yojayet ..
ito'nyathā bhaveddoṣo viparīteṣvadhogatiḥ .. 17 ..
2.1.d:
यस्य यज्ञस्य यद्बिंबं तत्तु तेनैव योजयेत् ॥
इतोऽन्यथा भवेद्दोषो विपरीतेष्वधोगतिः ॥ 17 ॥
2.1.m: Whatever design belongs to whatever sacrifice, one should employ that very one. / Any deviation from this is a defect; in contrary practice, there is a downfall.

2.1.s:
dvihastā caturasrā ca vedikā parikīrtitā ..
caturaṃgulocchrāyamitā ṣaḍaṃgulā hyathāpi vā ..18..
2.1.d:
द्विहस्ता चतुरस्रा च वेदिका परिकीर्तिता ॥
चतुरंगुलोच्छ्रायमिता षडंगुला ह्यथापि वा ॥18॥
2.1.m: A square altar is prescribed, measuring two cubits, / four finger-breadths in height, or else six finger-breadths.

2.1.s:
ṣaḍaṃgulā navavyūhe vardhayedyajñakovidaḥ ..
ekāṃgulasamutsedhaḥ kartavyassusamāhitaiḥ.. ... 19 ..
2.1.d:
षडंगुला नवव्यूहे वर्धयेद्यज्ञकोविदः ॥
एकांगुलसमुत्सेधः कर्तव्यस्सुसमाहितैः॥ ॥। 19 ॥
2.1.m: In the Navavyūha, an expert in sacrifice should increase it by six finger-breadths. / Those who are well-concentrated should make the elevation one finger-breadth.

2.1.s:
krauṃcaprāṇe turyahastaṃ muṣṭihastaṃ samucchritam ..
madhyadvaye hīnakaraṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ tryaṃgulādhikam .. 2.1.21.20 ..
2.1.d:
क्रौंचप्राणे तुर्यहस्तं मुष्टिहस्तं समुच्छ्रितम् ॥
मध्यद्वये हीनकरं कनिष्ठं त्र्यंगुलाधिकम् ॥ 2.1.21.20 ॥
2.1.m: In the Krauñcaprāṇa, it is raised by a quarter of a cubit or a fist-cubit; / in the two middles, it is diminished by a cubit; the lowest is increased by three finger-breadths.

2.1.s:
kuryāddvitrikramāddhīnamucchrāye dvijasattamāḥ ..
pārijātaṃ caṃdrabiṃbaṃ sūryakāṃtaṃ ca śekharam .. 21 ..
2.1.d:
कुर्याद्द्वित्रिक्रमाद्धीनमुच्छ्राये द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
पारिजातं चंद्रबिंबं सूर्यकांतं च शेखरम् ॥ 21 ॥
2.1.m: O best of the twice-born, one should make it diminished in height by degrees of two or three: / [the altars called] the Pārijāta, the lunar disc (Candrabimba), the Sūryakānta, and the Śekhara.

2.1.s:
grahāṇāṃ pauṣṭike pakṣe bāhyagrāmādisādhane ..
niyojayettatratatra vedikācakrakatrayam .. 22 ..
2.1.d:
ग्रहाणां पौष्टिके पक्षे बाह्यग्रामादिसाधने ॥
नियोजयेत्तत्रतत्र वेदिकाचक्रकत्रयम् ॥ 22 ॥
2.1.m: In the rite for the planets producing nourishment, and in rites of accomplishment outside villages and the like, / one should arrange three circular platforms there in each place.

2.1.s:
prathame muṣṭihastaḥ syātsaṃpūrṇe śeṣamānakaiḥ ..
navalābhe ca paṃcābjaṃ karatrayamudāhṛtam .. 23 ..
2.1.d:
प्रथमे मुष्टिहस्तः स्यात्संपूर्णे शेषमानकैः ॥
नवलाभे च पंचाब्जं करत्रयमुदाहृतम् ॥ 23 ॥
2.1.m: In the first there should be a fist-cubit; in the complete one, with the remaining measurements; / and in the acquisition of nine [parts], five lotuses and three cubits are proclaimed.

2.1.s:
śeṣā caiva variṣṭhā ca lavalī bhitti vedikā ..
vijñeyā dvijaśārdūlā yathākāmyeṣu yojayet .. 24 ..
2.1.d:
शेषा चैव वरिष्ठा च लवली भित्ति वेदिका ॥
विज्ञेया द्विजशार्दूला यथाकाम्येषु योजयेत् ॥ 24 ॥
2.1.m: The Śeṣā, the Variṣṭhā, and the Lavali-wall platform / are to be understood, O tigers among the twice-born, and one should employ them in elective rites as desired.

2.1.s:
ayathāvyatyaye doṣastasmādyatnena sādhayet ..
daśahaste cāṣṭahaste aṣṭahaste ca ṣoḍaśam ..25..
2.1.d:
अयथाव्यत्यये दोषस्तस्माद्यत्नेन साधयेत् ॥
दशहस्ते चाष्टहस्ते अष्टहस्ते च षोडशम् ॥25॥
2.1.m: There is a flaw if done otherwise or inverted; therefore one should accomplish it with care. / In ten cubits and in eight cubits, and in an eight-cubit [area] sixteen [parts],

2.1.s:
muṣṭibāhuñca prādeśaṃ vardhayetṣoḍaśāṃśake ..
hastotsedhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ hīne hīnaṃ ca hrāsayet .. 26 ..
2.1.d:
मुष्टिबाहुञ्च प्रादेशं वर्धयेत्षोडशांशके ॥
हस्तोत्सेधं च कर्तव्यं हीने हीनं च ह्रासयेत् ॥ 26 ॥
2.1.m: One should increase by a fist, a forearm, and a span at the sixteenth part. / The height is to be made one cubit; and when decreased, one should reduce it lower.

2.1.s:
darpaṇākārakaṃ kuryādyāgake śāṃti karmaṇi ..
hīnaṃ kuryātprayatnena vaprākāraṃ paristave .. 27 ..
2.1.d:
दर्पणाकारकं कुर्याद्यागके शांति कर्मणि ॥
हीनं कुर्यात्प्रयत्नेन वप्राकारं परिस्तवे ॥ 27 ॥
2.1.m: One should make it mirror-shaped in a sacrifice performed for pacification; / one should carefully make it diminished, resembling an earthen mound, in hymns of praise.

2.1.s:
niśāraṇairgomayaiśca vedikāṃ ca pralepayet ..
svarṇaratnamayaistoyairabhiṣicya kuśodakaiḥ .. .. 28 ..
2.1.d:
निशारणैर्गोमयैश्च वेदिकां च प्रलेपयेत् ॥
स्वर्णरत्नमयैस्तोयैरभिषिच्य कुशोदकैः ॥ ॥ 28 ॥
2.1.m: And one should plaster the platform with night-gathered cow dung, / having sprinkled it with waters containing gold and jewels, and with kuśa-water.

2.1.s:
hīnavīryagavānāṃ ca purīṣaṃ dhenukaṃ tathā ..
kapilāyāśca yatnena kuṃḍamaṃḍalalepane .. 29 ..
2.1.d:
हीनवीर्यगवानां च पुरीषं धेनुकं तथा ॥
कपिलायाश्च यत्नेन कुंडमंडललेपने ॥ 29 ॥
2.1.m: One must carefully avoid the dung of cows of diminished vigour, of milk-calves, / and of a brown cow, in plastering the sacrificial pit and the maṇḍala

2.1.s:
varjayetsarvayāgeṣu sthaṃḍileṣu prayatnataḥ ..
vinā sūtraiḥ kīlake na maṃḍale naiva sūtrayet .. 2.1.21.30 ..
2.1.d:
वर्जयेत्सर्वयागेषु स्थंडिलेषु प्रयत्नतः ॥
विना सूत्रैः कीलके न मंडले नैव सूत्रयेत् ॥ 2.1.21.30 ॥
2.1.m: In all sacrifices on sacrificial grounds, with effort. / Without lines and pegs, one must not draw the lines upon the maṇḍala.

2.1.s:
tasmātprayatnataḥ kāryaṃ yatsūtraṃ yacca kīlakam ..
arkahastamitaṃ sūtraṃ mṛdu lākṣāmayaṃ tathā .. 31 ..
2.1.d:
तस्मात्प्रयत्नतः कार्यं यत्सूत्रं यच्च कीलकम् ॥
अर्कहस्तमितं सूत्रं मृदु लाक्षामयं तथा ॥ 31 ॥
2.1.m: Therefore, with care, what is cord and what is peg must be prepared: / a cord twelve cubits long, soft, and treated with red lac;

2.1.s:
pītakāryasrajaṃ caiva kīlakaṃ svarṇanirmitam ..
raupyatāmramayaṃ kuryādvaiṣṇave yāgakarmaṇi .. 32 ..
2.1.d:
पीतकार्यस्रजं चैव कीलकं स्वर्णनिर्मितम् ॥
रौप्यताम्रमयं कुर्याद्वैष्णवे यागकर्मणि ॥ 32 ॥
2.1.m: A garland made of yellow flowers, and a peg fashioned of gold; / or one may make it of silver or copper in a sacrificial rite for Viṣṇu.

2.1.s:
gaṇanāyake supraśastaṃ śaiṣepāmārgameva ca ..
grahapakṣe tatheśasya kacchapasya dvijottamāḥ .. 33 ..
2.1.d:
गणनायके सुप्रशस्तं शैषेपामार्गमेव च ॥
ग्रहपक्षे तथेशस्य कच्छपस्य द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 33 ॥
2.1.m: In [a rite for] the Lord of Gaṇas, and in [a rite for] Śaṣa, [wood of] the apāmārga is praised as best; / likewise, O best of the twice-born, in the planetary side, [and in rites] of Īśa and of Kacchapa.

2.1.s:
ṣoḍaśe cārkahaste ca tatra nemiyutaṃ bhavet .. 34 ..
viṣayānukramaṇikā
atha dvitīyaṃ madhyamaparva .. 2 ..
2.1.d:
षोडशे चार्कहस्ते च तत्र नेमियुतं भवेत् ॥ 34 ॥
विषयानुक्रमणिका
अथ द्वितीयं मध्यमपर्व ॥ 2 ॥
2.1.m:
And in the sixteen- and twelve-cubit [altars], there it should be provided with a rim.

2.1.d:
1 191 मंगलाचरणम्, भविष्यपुराणप्रशंसा, धर्मस्वरूपवर्णनम् श्लो। 39
2 191 विराड् ब्रह्माण्डेत्पत्तिविस्तारवर्णनम् श्लो- 27
3 192 स्वर्गपातालाद्यूर्ध्वाधोलोकवर्णनम् श्लो। 26
4 192 भूर्लोकविस्तारविनिर्णयपुरःसरं ज्योतिश्चक्रवर्णनम् श्लो। 43
5 193 त्रैवर्णिकप्रशंसायां शह्मणलक्षणब्राह्मणकर्तव्यवर्णनम् श्लो, 92

9 199 अंतर्वेदिबहिर्वेदिप्रमाणादिवर्णनपूर्वकं पूर्तकर्मनिरूपणम् श्लो। 90
10 आरामकर्मविविधवृक्षारोपणविधिवर्णनम् श्लो। 90
11 203 कूपवापीतडागप्रतिष्ठासु विशेषविधिवर्णनम् श्लो, 10
12 203 प्रतिदेवताप्रतिमालक्षणवर्णनम् श्लो, 28
13 203 कर्मविशेषपरत्वेन विविधविधिकुण्डनिर्णयवर्णनम् श्लो, 41

2.1.m:
1 [p.] 191: Auspicious invocation, praise of the Bhaviṣyapurāṇa, description of the nature of dharma: 39 verses.
2 [p.] 191: Description of the origin and extent of the cosmic Puruṣa and the universe: 27 verses.
3 [p.] 192: Description of the upper and lower worlds such as heaven and the netherworlds: 26 verses.
4 [p.] 192: Description of the circle of luminaries preceded by the determination of the extent of the terrestrial world: 43 verses.
5 [p.] 193: In the praise of the three upper classes, description of the marks of a brāhmaṇa and the duties of a brāhmaṇa: 92 verses.
6 [p.] 195: Description of the greatness of a brāhmaṇa and the virtues of a guru: 26 verses.
7 [p.] 196: Description of the greatness of worship and hearing of the Purāṇas and Itihāsas: 25 verses.
8 [p.] 198: Description of the greatness of the ancillary texts following the divisions of the Purāṇas and Itihāsas: 46 verses.
9 [p.] 199: Exposition of charitable public works preceded by the description of the measures of the inner altar and outer altar: 90 verses.
10: Description of the rules for planting various trees for orchard-making: 90 verses.
11 [p.] 203: Description of special rules for the consecration of wells, stepwells, and ponds: 10 verses.
12 [p.] 203: Description of the characteristics of the images of each deity: 28 verses.
13 [p.] 203: Description of the determination of diverse kinds of sacrificial pits according to particular rites: 41 verses.
14 [p.] 204: Description of the measures and numbers of oblations and homas according to particular sacrifices: 21 verses.
15 [p.] 205: Description of the authoritative opinion on the consecration of the sacrificial pit, and description of the eighteen consecrations of the sacrificial pit: 35 verses.
16 [p.] 205: Description of the sixteen modes of service at the conclusion of regular and occasional homas: 24 verses.
17 [p.] 206: Description of the names of fire in specific rites preceded by the description of the three types of sacrifice: 16 verses.
18 [p.] 206: Description of the measures of substances intended for the homa: 23 verses.
19 [p.] 207: Description of the determination for constructing sruva and darvī ladles and vessels: 18 verses.
20 [p.] 207: Description of the determination of the full-offering homa, description of the number of brāhmaṇas according to the rite, and description of the fruits of sacrifices performed according to rule: 43 verses.
21 [p.] 208: Description of the construction of various kinds of maṇḍalas according to deity and according to rite: 34 verses.
(Thus ends the first part.)
